papers.title: MobiInfer: Accelerating On-Device GUI Agents with Workload-Aware Inference
papers.abstract: Mobile GUI agents assist users in executing phone tasks through iterative observe-reason-act loops. However, deploy ing multimodal GUI agents directly on smartphones is challenging due to strict end-to-end latency requirements and significant memory overhead. We observe that GUI-agent work loads exhibit recurring workflows and structured I/O: their prompts contain reusable context, while their outputs follow fixed schemas with phase-dependent predictability. Based on this observation, we present MobiInfer, a workload-aware inference engine for on-device multimodal GUI agents. MobiInfer combines trajectory-aware prefix reuse, phase-indexed vocabulary specialization, and schema-guided speculative decoding to eliminate redundant prefill computation and reduce structured-generation overhead. We implement MobiInfer on top of MNN and evaluate it on AndroidWorld and a real world dataset using three real Android devices. Across the four model-benchmark settings, MobiInfer achieves average speedups of 2.6x in prefill and 2.5x in decoding, reduces end-to-end task latency by 2.4x on average, and cuts total deployment storage by 30%, while limiting task-success degradation to less than one percentage point.

translation.title: MobiInfer：基于负载感知推理加速端侧GUI智能体
translation.abstract: 移动GUI智能体通过迭代的观察-推理-行动循环协助用户完成手机任务。然而，由于严格的端到端延迟要求和显著的内存开销，将多模态GUI智能体直接部署在智能手机上极具挑战。我们观察到GUI智能体负载呈现出重复性工作流和结构化I/O：其提示包含可复用的上下文，而其输出遵循固定模式且具有随阶段变化的可预测性。基于这一观察，我们提出MobiInfer，一个面向端侧多模态GUI智能体的负载感知推理引擎。MobiInfer结合轨迹感知的前缀复用、阶段索引的词表特化和模式引导的投机解码，以消除冗余的prefill计算并降低结构化生成的开销。我们在MNN之上实现MobiInfer，并在AndroidWorld和一个真实世界数据集上使用三台真实Android设备进行评估。在四个模型-基准设置中，MobiInfer平均实现2.6倍的prefill加速和2.5倍的解码加速，端到端任务延迟平均降低2.4倍，总部署存储减少30%，同时将任务成功率下降限制在一个百分点以内。
translation.brief: 针对多模态GUI智能体在手机端部署的延迟与内存问题，提出利用工作流重复性和结构化输出的负载感知推理引擎，通过前缀复用、词表特化和投机解码加速推理。

papers.title: Emergent Low-Dimensional Topological Dynamics Dictate Generalization and Escape Mechanics in Billion-Parameter Neural Networks
papers.abstract: The remarkable generalization of modern over-parameterized neural networks defies classical statistical learning bounds. Here we establish that optimization trajectories in billion-parameter models do not sample the ambient dimension $\mathbb{R}^N$ homogeneously; instead, they are dynamically constrained to a low-dimensional execution submanifold $\mathcal{M}_{\text{exec}}$ (with empirically observed effective dimension $d_{\text{eff}} \le 12$). By equipping the parameter space with a regularized Hessian metric $g_{ij} = \nabla_i \nabla_j L + \epsilon \delta_{ij}$ and analyzing stochastic Langevin diffusion on loss sublevel sets, we derive a rigorous Topological Generalization Bound grounded in projected subspace persistent homology. Furthermore, by linking Morse index transitions to Betti number annihilation ($\beta_1 \to 0$), we formulate an exact mathematical mechanism for exponential escape from strict saddles under anisotropic noise. We validate our framework across 80+ architectures (ResNets, Vision Transformers, and 7B LLMs). To bridge theoretical topology with computational feasibility, we resolve the curse of dimensionality by computing projected persistent homology proxies via randomized Lanczos iterations restricted strictly within active Hessian subspaces. Building upon this mathematical foundation, we introduce Topological-Adaptive Optimization (Top-SGD and Top-AdamW)---a family of wrapper algorithms that dynamically modulate learning rates using active curvature signatures. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate a 14.1\% reduction in total wall-clock training time on ImageNet with all computational and memory overheads fully accounted for. Code is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: 涌现的低维拓扑动力学决定十亿参数神经网络的泛化与逃逸机制
translation.abstract: 现代过参数化神经网络卓越的泛化能力超越了经典统计学习界。本文证明，十亿参数模型中的优化轨迹并非在环境维度$\mathbb{R}^N$中均匀采样，而是被动力学约束在一个低维执行子流形$\mathcal{M}_{\text{exec}}$上（经验观察到的有效维度$d_{\text{eff}} \le 12$）。通过为参数空间赋予正则化Hessian度量$g_{ij} = \nabla_i \nabla_j L + \epsilon \delta_{ij}$，并分析损失次水平集上的随机Langevin扩散，我们基于投影子空间持续同调推导出严格的拓扑泛化界。此外，通过将Morse指标跃迁与Betti数湮灭（$\beta_1 \to 0$）联系起来，我们给出了各向异性噪声下从严格鞍点指数逃逸的精确数学机制。我们在80多种架构（ResNet、Vision Transformer和7B LLM）上验证了该框架。为弥合理论拓扑与计算可行性之间的鸿沟，我们通过严格限制在活跃Hessian子空间内的随机Lanczos迭代计算投影持续同调代理，解决了维度灾难。在此数学基础上，我们提出拓扑自适应优化（Top-SGD和Top-AdamW）——一类利用活跃曲率签名动态调节学习率的包装算法。大量基准测试表明，在ImageNet上总训练时间（wall-clock）减少14.1%，且所有计算和内存开销均已计入。代码已在https URL公开。
translation.brief: 针对过参数化网络泛化缺乏理论解释的问题，提出优化轨迹受限于低维执行子流形的拓扑分析框架，并据此设计利用曲率签名动态调节学习率的优化算法。

papers.title: Relic and Gumi: Governing Memory, Safety, and Continuity in Diegetic Relational Agents
papers.abstract: Longitudinal relational agents rely on memory for continuity, but remembering can lead to intrusion, clinical overconfidence, emotional manipulation, and opacity. We present Relic, a governance architecture for diegetic relational agents, and Gumi, a subject-specific companion agent initialized and governed through Relic. The architecture separates what the system can observe, what researchers can review, what Gumi can remember, and what Gumi can say. We describe three mechanisms. Relic represents sensitive safety signals as researcher-facing governance objects rather than user-facing explanations or agent memories. Shared Continuity Memory organizes relational markers around subject-confirmed wording, corrections, explicit follow-up permissions, and recall limits. We specify a runtime mediation layer for delivery, proactivity, session identity, output transformation, and platform allowlists; adoption across live paths remains partial. These mechanisms aim to preserve relational continuity without turning Gumi into a clinical assistant, mood tracker, general-purpose assistant, or opaque profiling system. We contribute the architecture, object model, researcher workbench design, and a proposed evaluation framework for governed relational memory. An exploratory pilot involved the author as P1 and one external participant as P2. Weekly self-reports from P1 and researcher-led interviews with P2 provide descriptive observations of early use and perceived naturalness. The pilot does not support claims about clinical efficacy, diagnosis, therapeutic outcomes, general usability, or deployment safety. Relic provides research infrastructure intended to make relational memory, safety constraints, and agent behavior inspectable and testable.

translation.title: Relic与Gumi：叙事型关系智能体中的记忆、安全与连续性治理
translation.abstract: 长期关系智能体依赖记忆实现连续性，但记忆可能导致侵入、临床上的过度自信、情感操纵和不透明。我们提出Relic——一个面向叙事型关系智能体的治理架构，以及Gumi——一个通过Relic初始化和治理的特定主体陪伴智能体。该架构区分了系统可观察的内容、研究者可审查的内容、Gumi可记住的内容和Gumi可说的内容。我们描述了三种机制：Relic将敏感安全信号表示为面向研究者的治理对象，而非面向用户的解释或智能体记忆；共享连续性记忆围绕主体确认的措辞、更正、明确的后续许可和召回限制来组织关系标记；我们为投递、主动性、会话身份、输出转换和平台白名单指定了运行时中介层，但其在实际路径中的采用仍不完整。这些机制旨在保持关系连续性，同时避免Gumi变成临床助手、情绪追踪器、通用助手或不透明的画像系统。我们贡献了该架构、对象模型、研究者工作台设计以及一个面向受治理关系记忆的评估框架。一项探索性试点由作者作为P1和一名外部参与者作为P2参与；P1的每周自我报告和研究者主导的P2访谈提供了对早期使用和感知自然度的描述性观察。该试点不支持关于临床疗效、诊断、治疗结果、通用可用性或部署安全性的主张。Relic提供的研究基础设施旨在使关系记忆、安全约束和智能体行为可检查、可测试。
translation.brief: 针对关系智能体记忆带来的侵入、不透明等风险，提出将安全信号作为治理对象、分离观察/审查/记忆/表达权限的治理架构Relic及其陪伴智能体Gumi。

papers.title: Does Country Matter? Evaluating Geographic Sensitivity of Large Language Models in Zero-Shot Chronic Kidney Disease Screening
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show strong zero-shot reasoning capabilities, yet their sensitivity to prompt context raises questions about reliability in deployment. This study investigates whether geographic context embedded in prompts influences LLM-based chronic kidney disease (CKD) screening, independent of any change in patient features. Using a community-based CKD dataset from Bangladesh (284 participants with 112 CKD and 172 non-CKD), we systematically varied the country attribute across 25 global contexts while holding all clinical inputs constant, and evaluated two open-weight LLMs (Qwen3 8B and Mistral 7B). Experiments were conducted on a common-correct subset of 156 participants for whom both models produced correct baseline predictions. Results show that non-CKD predictions were highly stable across geographic contexts, with both models maintaining consistent non-CKD predictions in nearly all settings. In contrast, CKD-positive predictions were considerably more sensitive. For Qwen3, CKD prediction dropped from a baseline of 65 to as low as 50 across country contexts, while Mistral showed smaller but non-negligible variation. Country contexts did not group according to known epidemiological or healthcare similarities; instead, groupings appear to reflect how country tokens are internally represented within each model. These findings demonstrate that geographic tokens can systematically shift clinical screening outcomes despite identical patient inputs, with implications for the deployment of LLM-based decision support in diverse healthcare settings.

translation.title: 国家重要吗？评估大语言模型在零样本慢性肾病筛查中的地理敏感性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的零样本推理能力，但其对提示上下文的敏感性引发了部署可靠性的疑问。本研究调查提示中嵌入的地理上下文是否会影响基于LLM的慢性肾病（CKD）筛查，且独立于患者特征的任何变化。使用来自孟加拉国的社区CKD数据集（284名参与者，其中112名CKD、172名非CKD），我们在保持所有临床输入不变的情况下，系统地将国家属性在25个全球上下文中变化，并评估了两个开源权重LLM（Qwen3 8B和Mistral 7B）。实验在两个模型基线预测均正确的156名参与者的共同正确子集上进行。结果显示，非CKD预测在地理上下文中高度稳定，两个模型在几乎所有设置中都保持一致的非CKD预测。相比之下，CKD阳性预测则敏感得多：Qwen3的CKD预测从基线的65降至不同国家上下文下的最低50，Mistral的波动较小但不可忽略。国家上下文并未按已知的流行病学或医疗保健相似性聚类；相反，聚类似乎反映了国家token在各模型内部的表示方式。这些发现表明，尽管患者输入完全相同，地理token仍可系统性地改变临床筛查结果，这对LLM决策支持在多元医疗环境中的部署具有重要意义。
translation.brief: 针对LLM临床筛查中提示地理上下文的影响，通过在固定患者特征下变换国家属性的系统实验，揭示地理token会系统性偏移CKD筛查结果。

papers.title: MeshRT: Compile-Time Governed Wafer-Scale Runtime for Low-Latency High-Throughput Inference
papers.abstract: Wafer-scale accelerators promise ultra-low-latency AI inference, but current system stacks still carry an unsustainably high cost premium. The reason is that many current and emerging inference techniques, such as batching and MoE, introduce runtime dynamism that existing wafer-scale systems cannot support efficiently. As a result, they must choose between two unsatisfactory options: accept suboptimal latency, or preserve low latency by restricting dynamic techniques, thereby limiting the models they can support and reducing aggregate throughput. This tradeoff significantly increases the cost of low-latency serving. We present MeshRT, the first wafer-scale system to achieve both ultra-low latency and high throughput for LLM inference. MeshRT achieves this via a novel system architecture, which we call compile-time governance of runtime dynamism. This architecture features new system abstractions and mechanisms that enable MeshRT to compile dynamic events arising from LLM inference directly into per-core schedules, enabling asynchronous and decentralized execution with low runtime overhead. Implemented on a commodity wafer-scale accelerator, MeshRT preserves ultra-low latency while improving throughput by up to 56$\times$ over the state-of-the-art system for wafer-scale accelerators. Against measured single-instance SGLang results on H200, MeshRT achieves 4.5-7.0$\times$ lower latency. Under ideal linear scaling of those GPU measurements to an approximately power-matched H200 cluster, MeshRT achieves 1.7-13.0$\times$ higher decode system throughput in the low-latency regime.

translation.title: MeshRT：编译时治理的晶圆级运行时，实现低延迟高吞吐推理
translation.abstract: 晶圆级加速器有望实现超低延迟AI推理，但当前系统栈仍带有不可持续的高成本溢价。原因在于许多现有和新兴的推理技术（如批处理和MoE）引入了运行时动态性，而现有晶圆级系统无法高效支持。因此它们必须在两个不理想选项之间抉择：接受次优延迟，或通过限制动态技术来保持低延迟，从而限制可支持的模型并降低总吞吐。这种权衡显著增加了低延迟服务的成本。我们提出MeshRT，首个为LLM推理同时实现超低延迟和高吞吐的晶圆级系统。MeshRT通过一种新颖的系统架构实现这一目标，我们称之为运行时动态性的编译时治理。该架构具有新的系统抽象和机制，使MeshRT能够将LLM推理产生的动态事件直接编译为每核调度，实现低运行时开销的异步去中心化执行。MeshRT在商用晶圆级加速器上实现，在保持超低延迟的同时，吞吐量相比最先进的晶圆级加速器系统提升高达56倍。与在H200上实测的单实例SGLang结果相比，MeshRT延迟降低4.5-7.0倍。在将这些GPU测量值理想线性扩展到功耗近似匹配的H200集群的情况下，MeshRT在低延迟 regime 下解码系统吞吐量提升1.7-13.0倍。
translation.brief: 针对晶圆级加速器无法高效支持批处理、MoE等运行时动态性的问题，提出编译时治理架构，将动态事件编译为每核调度以同时实现超低延迟与高吞吐。

papers.title: MorphSched: Workload-Aware Adaptive Scheduler Generation for Linux
papers.abstract: Modern Linux scheduling increasingly requires workload-specific policies to meet the dynamic performance needs of heterogeneous applications. The recent sched_ext framework enables custom BPF schedulers, but building practical policies still requires coordinating Rust user-space control logic, BPF scheduling callbacks, generated user-kernel interfaces, and strict eBPF verifier constraints. This paper presents MorphSched, an LLM-driven system for synthesizing complete Rust+BPF sched_ext schedulers. MorphSched profiles target workloads under Linux EEVDF to construct dynamic, workload-specific optimization objectives, and uses a scaffold-constrained generation pipeline to translate scheduling intent into deployable scheduler implementations. To improve synthesis reliability, MorphSched separates implementation repair from strategy search: verifier, build, and runtime failures are handled through a DAG-structured repair process, while performance feedback is accumulated in an evolutionary memory pool to refine high-level scheduling strategies across iterations. We evaluate MorphSched across 120 machine/workload/interferer configurations on a real Linux kernel. The generated schedulers compile, pass eBPF verification, load successfully, and remain stable throughout our benchmark runs without manual edits to generated scheduler source code. Across these configurations, MorphSched improves the primary foreground metric over EEVDF by 26.5% on average and up to 87.3%. In selected comparisons, the generated schedulers are also competitive with representative hand-written sched_ext schedulers. These results show that scaffold-constrained, system-grounded LLM generation can be a practical tool for exploring workload-specific Linux scheduling policies.

translation.title: MorphSched：面向 Linux 的工作负载感知自适应调度器生成
translation.abstract: 现代 Linux 调度日益需要针对特定工作负载的策略，以满足异构应用动态的性能需求。近期的 sched_ext 框架支持自定义 BPF 调度器，但构建实用策略仍需协调 Rust 用户态控制逻辑、BPF 调度回调、生成的用户-内核接口以及严格的 eBPF 验证器约束。本文提出 MorphSched，一个由 LLM 驱动、用于合成完整 Rust+BPF sched_ext 调度器的系统。MorphSched 在 Linux EEVDF 下对目标工作负载进行剖析，构建动态的、工作负载特定的优化目标，并使用脚手架约束的生成流水线将调度意图转化为可部署的调度器实现。为提高合成的可靠性，MorphSched 将实现修复与策略搜索分离：验证器、构建和运行时故障通过 DAG 结构的修复流程处理，而性能反馈则累积在进化记忆池中，以在迭代间不断改进高层调度策略。我们在真实 Linux 内核上跨 120 种机器/工作负载/干扰配置评估 MorphSched。生成的调度器可编译、通过 eBPF 验证、成功加载，并在整个基准测试运行中保持稳定，无需对生成的调度器源代码进行任何手动修改。在这些配置中，MorphSched 相比 EEVDF 将主要前台指标平均提升 26.5%，最高提升 87.3%。在部分对比中，生成的调度器也具有与代表性手写 sched_ext 调度器相当的竞争力。这些结果表明，脚手架约束、以系统为基础的 LLM 生成可以成为探索工作负载特定 Linux 调度策略的实用工具。
translation.brief: 针对为特定工作负载自动生成可部署 Linux 调度器的难题，提出 MorphSched，通过工作负载剖析构建优化目标，并采用脚手架约束的 LLM 生成流水线与修复/策略搜索分离机制来合成 Rust+BPF sched_ext 调度器。

papers.title: Aegis OS: A Transactional Multi-Tenant Operating System Runtime for Eliminating Authorization Fatigue in Autonomous Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Autonomous coding agents such as Google Antigravity (agy), Anthropic Claude Code (claude), and OpenAI Codex CLI (codex) execute multi-step software engineering workflows on workstations and cloud hosts. Existing agent environments face a Security-Autonomy Dilemma: operators must choose between per-action confirmation prompts, which interrupt workflows on 45%-57% of tool calls and induce authorization fatigue, or unconfined execution (--yolo / --dangerously-skip-permissions), which exposes host files, SSH/cloud credentials, and API tokens to prompt injection and hallucination risks. Furthermore, concurrent agents editing a shared working tree clobber one another's changes, while passing large artifacts inline through LLM context windows incurs high token overhead. We present Aegis OS (aegis-os), a transactional, multi-tenant Agent Operating System Runtime in Rust exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Google Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol. Aegis OS shifts the authorization boundary from individual tool calls to transactional workspace boundaries. Each agent runs inside a kernel-enforced OS sandbox (macOS Seatbelt and Linux Bubblewrap with default-deny --tmpfs $HOME isolation and a Unix-socket egress bridge) backed by a Copy-on-Write (CoW) shadow workspace (APFS clonefile; single-open Linux FICLONE reflinks), an identity-pinned HTTP Egress Proxy with L7 method/path-scoped secret injection and outbound DLP, and an A2A IPC bus with Content-Addressable Storage (CAS). Across 1,500 controlled calls and 28,087 real calls across 52 coding-agent sessions, Aegis OS reduces prompts by 94.19%-99.88% (controlled) and 90.7%-97.9% (real sessions, 1.12% IPR), lowers attack success rate across 80 attacks in eight categories from 100.0% to 0.0% on macOS and Linux, clones 1,000-file (78.1 MB) repos in 6.3 ms on APFS and 15.6 ms on btrfs, and catches 10/10 syntactic and semantic merge conflicts.

translation.title: Aegis OS：消除自主编码代理授权疲劳的事务性多租户操作系统运行时
translation.abstract: Google Antigravity (agy)、Anthropic Claude Code (claude) 和 OpenAI Codex CLI (codex) 等自主编码代理在工作站和云主机上执行多步骤软件工程工作流。现有代理环境面临安全-自主困境：运维者必须在逐操作确认提示（会在 45%-57% 的工具调用中打断工作流并引发授权疲劳）与无限制执行（--yolo / --dangerously-skip-permissions，使主机文件、SSH/云凭证和 API 令牌暴露于提示注入和幻觉风险）之间做出选择。此外，并发代理编辑共享工作树会相互覆盖更改，而通过 LLM 上下文窗口内联传递大型工件会带来高昂的 token 开销。我们提出 Aegis OS (aegis-os)，一个用 Rust 实现的事务性多租户代理操作系统运行时，通过 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 和 Google Agent2Agent (A2A) 协议暴露。Aegis OS 将授权边界从单个工具调用转移到事务性工作区边界。每个代理运行在内核强制的 OS 沙箱中（macOS Seatbelt 和 Linux Bubblewrap，默认拒绝的 --tmpfs $HOME 隔离以及 Unix-socket 出口桥接），并由写时复制（CoW）影子工作区（APFS clonefile；Linux 单打开 FICLONE reflinks）、具有 L7 方法/路径范围密钥注入和出站 DLP 的身份绑定 HTTP 出口代理，以及带内容寻址存储（CAS）的 A2A IPC 总线支撑。在 1,500 次受控调用和 52 个编码代理会话中的 28,087 次真实调用中，Aegis OS 将提示减少 94.19%-99.88%（受控）和 90.7%-97.9%（真实会话，1.12% IPR），将八类 80 次攻击的攻击成功率从 100.0% 降至 0.0%（macOS 和 Linux），在 APFS 上 6.3 ms、btrfs 上 15.6 ms 克隆 1,000 文件（78.1 MB）仓库，并捕获 10/10 的语法和语义合并冲突。
translation.brief: 针对自主编码代理在逐操作授权与无限制执行之间的安全-自主困境，提出 Aegis OS，通过将授权边界转移到事务性工作区，结合内核沙箱、CoW 影子工作区、出口代理和 CAS IPC 总线实现安全且低打扰的多租户代理运行时。

papers.title: What Are LLM Agents Actually Learning on Low-Budget Molecular Optimization Benchmarks?
papers.abstract: Recent work reports large gains for LLM agents on low-budget molecular optimization. We measure the contributions of online optimization, retrievable task information, and permissive oracle landscapes. On PMO at 50 oracle calls, a GPT-4o mini agent's sum AUC falls from 14.44 to 4.85 after task names and curated reference compounds are hidden. An identity-blinded condition that states only the oracle form (e.g., similarity to a hidden reference) scores 5.39, while a deterministic retrieval-only baseline with no LLM reaches 12.16 (84% of the full agent). A full 23-task 2x2 ablation and a three-seed replication on eight tasks support this interpretation. On a protein-targeted benchmark with an AutoDock Vina composite oracle, a single-edit random walk is a strong lower bound; across three seeds it obtains composite 0.636 +/- 0.008 and docking improvement -1.11 +/- 0.04 kcal/mol. As a positive control, a retrieval-free population agent exceeds REINVENT at a matched 50-call AUC budget, with its strongest result at 100 calls. These results motivate two inexpensive sanity checks: retrieval-safe PMO prompts and a random-walk floor for docking-based optimization.

translation.title: LLM 智能体在低预算分子优化基准上究竟学到了什么？
translation.abstract: 近期工作报告了 LLM 智能体在低预算分子优化上的巨大收益。我们测量了在线优化、可检索任务信息和宽松的 oracle 景观各自的贡献。在 50 次 oracle 调用的 PMO 上，当任务名称和精选参考化合物被隐藏后，GPT-4o mini 智能体的 sum AUC 从 14.44 降至 4.85。一个仅声明 oracle 形式（如与隐藏参考的相似度）的身份盲化条件得分为 5.39，而一个不使用 LLM 的确定性纯检索基线达到 12.16（完整智能体的 84%）。完整的 23 任务 2x2 消融实验和八任务上的三种子重复实验支持这一解释。在使用 AutoDock Vina 复合 oracle 的蛋白质靶向基准上，单编辑随机游走是一个强下界；跨三个种子，其获得复合 0.636 +/- 0.008 和对接改进 -1.11 +/- 0.04 kcal/mol。作为阳性对照，一个无检索的种群智能体在匹配的 50 次调用 AUC 预算下超过 REINVENT，其最强结果出现在 100 次调用时。这些结果促成了两个廉价的合理性检查：检索安全的 PMO 提示和基于对接优化的随机游走下界。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体在低预算分子优化基准上的收益来源不明的问题，通过消融实验测量在线优化、任务信息检索和宽松 oracle 景观的贡献，并提出检索安全提示和随机游走下界两种合理性检查。

papers.title: Subliminal Learning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon in large language models (LLMs) where a teacher passes a hidden preference to a student through training data unrelated to that preference. We study whether subliminal learning also occurs in vision-language models (VLMs). We finetune a teacher VLM to prefer a specific animal or facial attribute and use a control teacher from the same base model. Both teachers generate numbers for an unrelated visual task involving geometric shapes. Two students initialized from the same base VLM are finetuned on the same images, using numbers generated by either the biased or control teacher. Across VLMs ranging from 2B to 7B parameters, we find that both animal and facial preferences can transfer through this unrelated task. Students trained on biased-teacher outputs select the target more often than control students, with a difference of up to $\sim$10 percentage points in the animal preference task. Transfer can become stronger with more training data and varies with the target preference, model, and how the numbers are generated. Beyond preferences, we show that the biased student's explanations use more of the same words and phrases as the biased teacher's explanations than those of the control student, even when all three models select the same image. These results matter for training VLMs and show that training on unrelated data may change both a VLM's image preferences and how it explains its choices, and that transfer can become stronger with more training samples.

translation.title: 视觉-语言模型中的潜意识学习
translation.abstract: 潜意识学习是大语言模型（LLM）中的一种现象：教师通过与其偏好无关的训练数据将隐藏偏好传递给学生。我们研究潜意识学习是否也发生在视觉-语言模型（VLM）中。我们微调一个教师 VLM 使其偏好特定动物或面部属性，并使用来自同一基础模型的对照教师。两位教师为涉及几何形状的无关视觉任务生成数字。两个从同一基础 VLM 初始化的学生在相同图像上分别使用由偏好教师或对照教师生成的数字进行微调。在参数量从 2B 到 7B 的多个 VLM 上，我们发现动物和面部偏好都可以通过这个无关任务传递。在偏好教师输出上训练的学生比对照学生更常选择目标，在动物偏好任务中差异高达约 10 个百分点。传递可随训练数据增多而增强，并随目标偏好、模型和数字生成方式而变化。除偏好之外，我们还发现偏好学生的解释比对照学生使用更多与偏好教师相同的词汇和短语，即使三个模型选择相同的图像。这些结果对训练 VLM 具有重要意义：在无关数据上训练可能同时改变 VLM 的图像偏好及其解释选择的方式，且传递可随训练样本增多而增强。
translation.brief: 针对潜意识学习是否存在于视觉-语言模型的问题，通过教师-学生微调实验证明 VLM 可经由无关任务的训练数据传递隐藏偏好，且传递强度随数据量增加而增强。

papers.title: SAFTAC: Simulation-Augmented Fine-Tuning of Open-Source LLMs for Analog Circuit Design
papers.abstract: Circuit design for analog integrated circuits (ICs) is challenging because circuit topology, device sizing, and circuit performance are tightly coupled. Existing large language model (LLM)-based methods either rely on inference-time correction around frozen models or train on limited circuit types without directly using simulation outcomes as training signals. A key bottleneck is that existing datasets do not provide sufficient task information for training LLMs on end-to-end specification-conditioned design. To fill this gap, we first construct a large-scale simulation-grounded dataset with 8,626 design tasks across 10 different types of analog circuits, where each task includes a textual description, labeled I/O ports, loading condition, target specifications, a testbench, and a reference netlist. Using this dataset, we present SAFTAC, a simulation-augmented fine-tuning framework that trains LLMs to generate and revise analog circuit design. SAFTAC combines three-stage supervised fine-tuning, which progressively builds the capabilities required for analog circuit design and feedback-guided correction, with simulation feedback-augmented reinforcement fine-tuning, which further optimizes models using simulation-grounded rewards. We evaluate SAFTAC under single-pass generation and two-pass generation with simulation feedback, showing improvements over the strongest closed-source LLM by 15.9% and 7.8%, respectively.

translation.title: SAFTAC：面向模拟电路设计的开源 LLM 仿真增强微调
translation.abstract: 模拟集成电路（IC）的电路设计具有挑战性，因为电路拓扑、器件尺寸和电路性能紧密耦合。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法要么依赖围绕冻结模型的推理时校正，要么在有限的电路类型上训练，而没有直接将仿真结果用作训练信号。一个关键瓶颈是现有数据集无法为训练 LLM 进行端到端的规格条件设计提供足够的任务信息。为填补这一空白，我们首先构建了一个大规模仿真接地数据集，涵盖 10 种不同类型模拟电路的 8,626 个设计任务，每个任务包括文本描述、标注的 I/O 端口、负载条件、目标规格、测试平台和参考网表。基于该数据集，我们提出 SAFTAC，一个仿真增强微调框架，训练 LLM 生成和修订模拟电路设计。SAFTAC 结合了三阶段监督微调（逐步构建模拟电路设计和反馈引导校正所需的能力）与仿真反馈增强的强化微调（使用仿真接地的奖励进一步优化模型）。我们在单次生成和带仿真反馈的两次生成下评估 SAFTAC，分别比最强闭源 LLM 提升 15.9% 和 7.8%。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 在端到端模拟电路规格条件设计上缺乏训练数据的问题，构建大规模仿真接地数据集并提出 SAFTAC 框架，结合三阶段监督微调与仿真反馈增强的强化微调来训练 LLM 生成和修订电路设计。

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Knowing: The Epistemic Limits of LLM-Based Mental Health Inference from Youth Social Media Conversations
papers.abstract: Adolescents increasingly use social media for private conversations, sharing experiences and seeking support. These interactions generate digital traces, prompting efforts to infer mental health and psychosocial states. As large language models become more capable of reasoning about conversations and interpersonal dynamics, a fundamental question remains nonetheless: what can models actually "know" about an individual's psychological experience from what they are able to "see"? We evaluated ten reasoning LLMs using donated Instagram Direct Messages from 80 adolescents with a history of depression or suicidal thoughts and behaviors, comparing predictions with self-reports and analyzing 204 reasoning traces. Models performed better when inferring more observable states than participants' subjective appraisals of social experience, such as perceived social support. Beyond prediction accuracy, our findings highlight the epistemic limits of digital traces for AI design and evaluation: what can be observed, what can reasonably be inferred, and what requires people's own accounts.

translation.title: 看见不等于知晓：基于LLM的青少年社交媒体对话心理健康推断的认知边界
translation.abstract: 青少年越来越多地在社交媒体上进行私人对话，分享经历并寻求支持。这些互动产生了数字痕迹，促使人们尝试推断心理健康与心理社会状态。尽管大语言模型在推理对话和人际动态方面的能力日益增强，但一个根本问题依然存在：模型从其能够"看到"的内容中，究竟能对个体的心理体验"知道"多少？我们使用80名有抑郁史或自杀意念与行为史的青少年捐赠的 Instagram 私信评估了十个推理型 LLM，将预测结果与自我报告进行对比，并分析了204条推理轨迹。模型在推断更可观察的状态时表现更好，而在推断参与者对社会经历的主观评价（如感知到的社会支持）时表现较差。除预测准确性外，我们的发现还凸显了数字痕迹在 AI 设计与评估中的认知边界：什么可以被观察、什么可以被合理推断、什么需要当事人自己的陈述。
translation.brief: 研究LLM从青少年社交媒体对话推断心理状态的能力边界，通过对比模型预测与青少年自我报告来揭示数字痕迹的认知局限。

papers.title: CascadeRec: Deployed Adaptive LLM Compute Allocation for Multi-Tenant Content Recommendation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are attractive rerankers for recommendation. Running an expensive model on every request is costly, and for users with sparse interaction histories it often lowers quality. We present CascadeRec, a two-tier LLM reranking cascade deployed in production at a large financial planning and analysis (FP&A) SaaS provider. It serves content recommendations to enterprise tenants on AWS EKS and GKE. A lightweight Tier-1 model reranks every request. A router escalates only the requests where extra inference-time compute is likely to help, and sends them to a more expensive Tier-2 procedure (self-consistency sampling, multi-path reasoning, or a larger model). The system has run in a production A/B experiment for over a month. Compared with uniform use of the expensive tier, CascadeRec has reduced inference cost by about 10%, with minimal latency impact and no quality regression observed to date. Tenant data cannot be released, so we also evaluate the pipeline on public benchmarks (MovieLens-1M and Amazon-Electronics). Segment-level analysis with paired-bootstrap confidence intervals shows that uniform LLM reranking lowers NDCG@10 for sparse-history users by up to 30%, and its only statistically significant gain appears on the segment with the longest histories. Escalating cold users can make the loss larger instead of repairing it. Which segments benefit from escalation depends on the domain, and this motivates the segment-gated rollout we use in production. We describe the deployment architecture, the measured benefits, and lessons learned, including inter-tenant load imbalance as a driver for cascading and the handling of LLM output-parsing failures at the serving layer.

translation.title: CascadeRec：面向多租户内容推荐的自适应LLM算力分配级联部署
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）是推荐系统中颇具吸引力的重排序器。在每个请求上都运行昂贵模型成本很高，而且对于交互历史稀疏的用户，这往往会降低质量。我们提出 CascadeRec，一个已在某大型财务规划与分析（FP&A）SaaS 提供商生产环境中部署的两级 LLM 重排序级联系统，在 AWS EKS 和 GKE 上为企业租户提供内容推荐。轻量级的一级模型对所有请求进行重排序；路由器仅将额外推理算力可能带来收益的请求升级到更昂贵的二级流程（自洽性采样、多路径推理或更大的模型）。该系统已在生产 A/B 实验中运行超过一个月。与统一使用昂贵层级相比，CascadeRec 将推理成本降低了约10%，延迟影响极小，且迄今未观察到质量回退。由于租户数据无法公开，我们还在公开基准（MovieLens-1M 和 Amazon-Electronics）上评估了该流程。基于配对 bootstrap 置信区间的分段分析显示，统一的 LLM 重排序会使稀疏历史用户的 NDCG@10 下降多达30%，其唯一具有统计显著性的收益出现在历史最长的用户段上。对冷启动用户进行升级反而可能扩大损失而非修复问题。哪些用户段能从升级中受益取决于具体领域，这促使我们在生产中采用分段门控的灰度发布。我们描述了部署架构、实测收益和经验教训，包括租户间负载不均衡作为级联设计的动因，以及服务层对 LLM 输出解析失败的处理。
translation.brief: 提出两级LLM重排序级联系统，用路由器仅将可能受益的请求升级到昂贵模型，以降低推理成本并避免对稀疏历史用户的质量损害。

papers.title: NormGym: Evaluating Normative Competence through Social Interaction
papers.abstract: Normative competence, the ability to infer socially enforced expectations from interaction and adjust behavior accordingly, is essential for agents operating in unfamiliar human communities. Yet existing evaluations largely test whether agents can recognize or apply norms they may already know, rather than whether they can acquire previously unknown norms from social interaction. We introduce NormGym, an interactive benchmark for normative competence in which a newcomer must infer a hidden, arbitrary norm while pursuing its own task in a multi-agent community. Success requires distinguishing what is possible from what is permitted, inferring the norm from observed behavior and sanctions, and applying it in new situations. NormGym contains diverse norms and distinct environments, allowing systematic evaluation of current agents, including large language model (LLM) agents. We find that normative competence remains challenging: the strongest evaluated LLM achieves a joint task-and-compliance success rate of 55.3%. Our analysis reveals that models can sometimes revise their behavior following sanctions for their own actions, but struggle to use other agents' behavior and the sanctions they receive to infer the underlying norm. We further find that fine-tuning models may be insufficient to improve normative competence. These results suggest that current models lack a robust, transferable capability for acquiring normative knowledge through social interaction.

translation.title: NormGym：通过社会互动评估规范能力
translation.abstract: 规范能力，即从互动中推断社会强制执行的期望并相应调整行为的能力，对于在陌生人类社区中运作的智能体至关重要。然而现有评估大多测试智能体能否识别或应用其可能已知的规范，而非能否从社会互动中习得此前未知的规范。我们提出 NormGym，一个规范能力的交互式基准，其中新来者必须在多智能体社区中追求自身任务的同时推断一个隐藏的、任意的规范。成功要求区分什么是可能的与什么是被允许的，从观察到的行为和惩罚中推断规范，并在新情境中应用它。NormGym 包含多样的规范和不同的环境，可对当前智能体（包括大语言模型智能体）进行系统评估。我们发现规范能力仍然具有挑战性：被评估的最强 LLM 的任务与合规联合成功率为55.3%。我们的分析表明，模型有时能在因自身行为受到惩罚后修正行为，但难以利用其他智能体的行为及其所受惩罚来推断潜在规范。我们进一步发现，微调模型可能不足以提升规范能力。这些结果表明，当前模型缺乏通过社会互动习得规范知识的稳健、可迁移的能力。
translation.brief: 提出交互式基准 NormGym，要求智能体在多智能体社区中通过观察行为与惩罚从零推断隐藏规范，以评估其规范习得能力。

papers.title: s$^3$: Simple Scaling of Swarms via Cooperative Multi-agent RL
papers.abstract: Groups can achieve more than individuals in the same amount of time, but only if their members coordinate: they must decide who works on what and what to share. However, this organization in multi-agent systems today usually comes from arbitrary, static harnesses designed a priori without adapting to agent behaviors or task specifications. We ask whether agents can instead learn to organize themselves. We introduce s$^3$, the first multi-agent reinforcement learning method in which agents decide for themselves how long to work alone and when to share findings or read teammates' messages, with no predefined organization or roles. Our s$^3$ agents learn to take different approaches, read each other's work, exhibit emergent roles that complement each other in the swarm, and generalize to bigger teams. We study both coordination, where agents must combine private information, and parallel exploration, where sharing discoveries can make search more efficient. With matched training and inference budgets, s$^3$, swarms evaluated with twice as many agents as in training solve over 25$\times$ more coordination problems than the strongest baseline, and in exploration, communicating agents reduce repeated work by nearly 50% and outperform best-of-N by up to 9.4 percentage points. Rather than being designed in advance, s$^3$ enables organization to emerge from a shared goal. This opens the door to capable systems built from many models that learn to work together.

translation.title: s$^3$: Simple Scaling of Swarms via Cooperative Multi-agent RL

papers.title: LLM-Based Feature Extraction for Multi-Criteria Inventory Classification
papers.abstract: E-commerce supply chains generate large volumes of customer feedback and operational data that remain underutilized in inventory management. Traditional inventory classification techniques such as ABC analysis rely primarily on annual dollar usage, while multi-criteria inventory classification (MCIC) methods extend this but still depend on structured quantitative data and do not utilize unstructured information available in modern supply chains. This paper proposes an LLM-based feature extraction approach that transforms unstructured sources such as customer reviews into quantitative features using vector embeddings and LLM-generated evaluation criteria. The enriched feature set is incorporated into an MCIC framework based on the Hadi-Vencheh model. Experimental results show measurable reclassification effects when customer sentiment signals are included, demonstrating that integrating unstructured data into MCIC can enhance inventory prioritization.

translation.title: 基于LLM的特征提取用于多准则库存分类
translation.abstract: 电商供应链产生大量客户反馈和运营数据，但它们在库存管理中未被充分利用。传统库存分类技术如 ABC 分析主要依赖年度资金使用量，而多准则库存分类（MCIC）方法虽有所扩展，但仍依赖结构化定量数据，未能利用现代供应链中可获得的非结构化信息。本文提出一种基于 LLM 的特征提取方法，利用向量嵌入和 LLM 生成的评估准则，将客户评论等非结构化来源转化为定量特征。丰富后的特征集被纳入基于 Hadi-Vencheh 模型的 MCIC 框架。实验结果表明，纳入客户情感信号会产生可测量的重新分类效应，证明将非结构化数据整合进 MCIC 可以增强库存优先级排序。
translation.brief: 提出用LLM和向量嵌入将客户评论等非结构化数据转化为定量特征，并融入Hadi-Vencheh多准则库存分类框架以改进库存优先级排序。

papers.title: MORTIS: Compiler-Guided KV-Cache Management for LLM Agent Programs
papers.abstract: Existing agent serving systems divide each prompt into a reusable prefix and an opaque suffix, managing the KV-cache at this coarse granularity without distinguishing the components within each part. We observe that prompt components differ in which LLM calls share their values and how long those values remain reusable, a property we term intra-prompt heterogeneity. Our key insight is that, in frameworks that generate prompts from typed LLM function calls, these components correspond to program variables, allowing compiler analysis to recover their sharing patterns and lifetimes. We present MORTIS, a compiler-serving co-design that combines this analysis with runtime observations to improve KV-cache management. MORTIS reorders prompt components to expose additional prefix reuse and uses their predicted reuse and lifetimes to guide cache retention, eviction, and prefetching. Our evaluation shows that MORTIS achieves up to 1.99x job completion time (JCT) speedup and 1.97x throughput improvement over SGLang, with geometric-mean speedups of 1.45x and 1.49x, respectively.

translation.title: MORTIS：面向 LLM Agent 程序的编译器引导 KV-Cache 管理
translation.abstract: 现有的 agent 服务系统将每个 prompt 划分为可复用的前缀和不透明的后缀，并以这种粗粒度管理 KV-cache，而不区分各部分内部的组件。我们观察到 prompt 的各组件在被哪些 LLM 调用共享其值以及这些值可复用多久方面存在差异，我们将这一特性称为 prompt 内异质性。我们的关键洞察是：在从带类型的 LLM 函数调用生成 prompt 的框架中，这些组件对应于程序变量，使编译器分析能够恢复其共享模式和生命周期。我们提出 MORTIS，一种编译器与服务系统协同设计的方法，将上述分析与运行时观测相结合以改进 KV-cache 管理。MORTIS 通过重排 prompt 组件来暴露更多前缀复用机会，并利用预测的复用情况和生命周期来指导缓存的保留、驱逐和预取。评估显示，相比 SGLang，MORTIS 的作业完成时间（JCT）加速最高达 1.99 倍，吞吐量提升最高达 1.97 倍，几何平均加速分别为 1.45 倍和 1.49 倍。
translation.brief: 针对 agent prompt 内部各组件复用特性不同导致的 KV-cache 管理粗粒度问题，利用编译器分析从类型化 LLM 函数调用中恢复组件的共享模式与生命周期，指导缓存的重排、保留、驱逐和预取。

papers.title: Forcing a Letter Suppresses Refusal: Mechanistic Evidence from WMDP
papers.abstract: Safety benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) commonly use multiple-choice question (MCQ) format. However, prior studies documented that MCQ format reduces refusal rates, which may significantly affect the safety behavior of the model. We provide a first mechanistic explanation of this effect on the Weapons of Mass Destruction Proxy (WMDP) dataset across two models - Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B. First, we use the tuned lens technique to show that when processing MCQ the model commits to an answer-letter token very quickly, which is in contrast to the gradual refusal build-up in open-ended formats. Additionally, we observe that activations on the MCQ format lie roughly 3x further from the refusal direction, compared with their open-ended counterparts. Moreover, ablating the attention heads that carry the MCQ format answer increases the refusal, which is a direct evidence that the MCQ answer-selection competes with refusal. These findings indicate that MCQ safety scores primarily measure knowledge capabilities and do not assess the safety-mechanisms.

translation.title: 强制选择字母会抑制拒答：来自 WMDP 的机制性证据
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的安全基准通常采用多选题（MCQ）格式。然而，已有研究表明 MCQ 格式会降低拒答率，这可能显著影响模型的安全行为。我们在大规模杀伤性武器代理（WMDP）数据集上，针对 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen3-8B 两个模型首次提供了这一效应的机制性解释。首先，我们使用 tuned lens 技术表明，模型在处理 MCQ 时会很快确定答案字母 token，这与开放式格式中拒答的逐步形成形成对比。此外，我们观察到 MCQ 格式下的激活值距离拒答方向约为开放式格式的 3 倍。而且，消融携带 MCQ 格式答案的注意力头会增加拒答，这直接证明 MCQ 的答案选择与拒答机制相互竞争。这些发现表明，MCQ 安全分数主要衡量知识能力，而无法评估安全机制。
translation.brief: 针对 MCQ 格式降低 LLM 拒答率的现象，通过 tuned lens、激活方向分析和注意力头消融在 WMDP 数据集上给出机制性解释：答案字母选择与拒答机制相互竞争。

papers.title: Aspect-wise Pairwise Tournaments for Test-Time Selection
papers.abstract: Scaling test-time compute has proven highly effective at improving LLM reasoning. A popular method is best-of-n sampling, where a model generates many candidate solutions and one is selected. This motivates the question: how can we select the best candidate? When humans make choices, we find it more natural to compare two options than judge each in isolation. Additionally, when the options become complex, we like to judge the options one aspect at a time, such as comparing two job candidates on experience, communication, etc. In the test-time setting, candidate solutions should be judged in the same way. Here we introduce Aspect-wise Pairwise Tournaments (APT), which verifies by comparison and compares by aspect. Each matchup of a single elimination tournament is decided by a vote over multiple off-the-shelf aspect verifiers, each expressing a pairwise preference along its own aspect. Across five domains and three generator LLMs, APT improves over binary multi-aspect approval, self-consistency and reward model verification, with the largest gains on open-ended tasks. We find that both components matter; neither binary approval over the same aspects nor a generic pairwise judge at a matched budget matches APT. Because aspects are specified in natural language, APT also lets users steer selection toward properties they care about, better aligning with user preferences without needing to regenerate solutions. No component is trained, so APT transfers to new domains by simply rewriting prompts.

translation.title: 面向测试时选择的分方面两两锦标赛
translation.abstract: 扩展测试时计算已被证明对提升 LLM 推理非常有效。一种流行方法是 best-of-n 采样，即模型生成多个候选解并从中选出一个。这引出了一个问题：如何选出最佳候选？人类做选择时，比较两个选项比孤立地评判每个选项更自然。此外，当选项变得复杂时，我们倾向于逐个方面进行评判，例如从经验、沟通能力等方面比较两位求职者。在测试时场景中，候选解也应如此评判。我们提出分方面两两锦标赛（APT），通过比较进行验证、按方面进行比较。单败淘汰赛的每场对决由多个现成的方面验证器投票决定，每个验证器沿自己的方面表达两两偏好。在五个领域和三个生成器 LLM 上，APT 优于二值多方面审批、自一致性和奖励模型验证，在开放式任务上收益最大。我们发现两个组件都不可或缺：相同方面的二值审批以及同等预算下的通用两两评判器均无法匹敌 APT。由于方面以自然语言指定，APT 还能让用户引导选择朝其关注的属性倾斜，无需重新生成解即可更好地对齐用户偏好。APT 无需训练任何组件，只需改写 prompt 即可迁移到新领域。
translation.brief: 针对 best-of-n 采样中如何选出最佳候选解的问题，提出通过单败锦标赛进行两两比较、并由多个分方面验证器投票裁决的测试时选择方法 APT。

papers.title: Decision Context: Persistent Behavioral Learning for AI Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents do not learn from corrections across sessions. A user fixes the same mistake at the start of every conversation. Existing agent memory systems primarily handle facts, such as preferences, entities, and conversational history, rather than procedural knowledge. We present Forge Decision Context (forge_dc), a system that captures behavioral signals from human corrections and self-assessed tool-call failures, compiles them into imperative RULE directives, and injects them at the decision points where they apply. We evaluate forge_dc alongside four predecessor approaches on DC-Bench, a new benchmark of 71 scenarios across nine behavioral dimensions, built from real executed agent traces in a deterministic mocked-tool environment. forge_dc reaches 95% compliance, up from 55% with naive retrieval, while injecting approximately 10 times fewer tokens per query. Across the five-stage progression, the strongest systems represent behavioral memory as explicit directives and deliver it at the decision points where it applies. The results identify representation, activation, and placement as central design choices for persistent behavioral learning.

translation.title: Decision Context：AI Agent 的持久行为学习
translation.abstract: LLM agent 无法跨会话从纠正中学习，用户不得不在每次对话开始时修正同样的错误。现有的 agent 记忆系统主要处理事实类信息，如偏好、实体和对话历史，而非程序性知识。我们提出 Forge Decision Context（forge_dc），该系统从人类纠正和自我评估的工具调用失败中捕获行为信号，将其编译为命令式的 RULE 指令，并在适用的决策点注入。我们在 DC-Bench 上将 forge_dc 与四种前代方法进行评估；DC-Bench 是一个新基准，包含九个行为维度的 71 个场景，基于确定性 mock 工具环境中的真实 agent 执行轨迹构建。forge_dc 达到 95% 的合规率（朴素检索为 55%），同时每次查询注入的 token 约减少 10 倍。在五阶段演进中，最强的系统将行为记忆表示为显式指令，并在适用的决策点交付。结果指出表示、激活和放置是持久行为学习的核心设计选择。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM agent 无法跨会话记住行为纠正的问题，提出 forge_dc 系统，将人类纠正和工具调用失败编译为显式 RULE 指令并在相应决策点注入。

papers.title: Turkish Multimodal Video Fact-Checking: A New Dataset and a Comparison of Zero-Shot Agentic and Fine-Tuned Systems
papers.abstract: Video-based misinformation spreads rapidly on social media, but almost all existing fact-checking systems focus exclusively on English text. Tools for low-resource languages such as Turkish are severely limited. In this work, we present TeViD (Turkish Video Fact-checking Dataset), to the best of our knowledge the first multimodal video fact-checking dataset for Turkish. We compiled the dataset from articles published by this http URL, an IFCN-certified organisation, and enriched it with translated Snopes articles and synthetic examples to reduce class imbalance. Building on TeViD, we develop two verification pipelines that share the same open-source base model. First, in 3MFact-TR (Pipeline 1), we adapt the multi-role 3MFact framework to Turkish with the Qwen2.5-7B large language model and the Qwen2-VL-7B vision-language model, and add three modules of our own: a semantic inconsistency checker, a 5W1H question manager, and a bilingual evidence retriever that excludes fact-checking sites to prevent leakage. Second, as our Fine-Tuned Model (Pipeline 2), we fine-tune a single Qwen2.5-7B with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to produce closed-book verdicts from the claim and the video's textual description. We report accuracy, macro F1, True class F1, and True class recall for both systems, together with ablation studies.

translation.title: 土耳其语多模态视频事实核查：新数据集及零样本 Agentic 系统与微调系统的比较
translation.abstract: 基于视频的错误信息在社交媒体上迅速传播，但几乎所有现有事实核查系统都只针对英文文本，土耳其语等低资源语言的工具严重匮乏。本工作提出 TeViD（土耳其语视频事实核查数据集），据我们所知是首个土耳其语多模态视频事实核查数据集。我们从一家 IFCN 认证机构发布的文章中汇编数据集，并用翻译的 Snopes 文章和合成样本加以扩充以缓解类别不平衡。基于 TeViD，我们开发了共享同一开源基础模型的两个核查流水线。其一为 3MFact-TR（流水线 1），使用 Qwen2.5-7B 大语言模型和 Qwen2-VL-7B 视觉语言模型将多角色 3MFact 框架适配到土耳其语，并加入我们自己的三个模块：语义不一致检查器、5W1H 问题管理器，以及排除事实核查网站以防止泄漏的双语证据检索器。其二为微调模型（流水线 2），使用低秩适配（LoRA）微调单个 Qwen2.5-7B，根据声明和视频文本描述生成闭卷判定。我们报告两个系统的准确率、宏 F1、True 类 F1 和 True 类召回率，并附消融研究。
translation.brief: 针对土耳其语视频事实核查工具匮乏的问题，构建首个土耳其语多模态数据集 TeViD，并比较基于 Qwen 的零样本 agentic 流水线与 LoRA 微调模型两种核查方案。

papers.title: Pdb or Not to Be: Comparing Debugging Interfaces With Pass$_{X}$@$k$
papers.abstract: Interactive debuggers are indispensable to human software development, yet coding agents overwhelmingly rely on edit-execute-observe loops, using common bash tools, test scripts, and print statements to debug via repeated shell commands. Stepping through a debugger provides live access to runtime state, which may enable different problem-solving capabilities. However, prior work typically introduces the debugger as an additional tool or through a new subagent, making its individual contribution difficult to isolate from the associated scaffold changes. To address this, we compare a debugger-only agent against a bash-only agent on all 500 SWE-bench Verified instances, holding the rest of the scaffold fixed. We evaluate both architectures on two models, GPT-OSS-120B and Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B, with three independent runs per architecture $\times$ model configuration. Crucially, to distinguish interface specialization from expanded coverage under repeated sampling, we introduce pass$_X$@$k$, a cross-agent pass@$k$ that provides an unbiased estimator of the probability that at least one of $k$ agents is successful. Although the bash and debugger agents solve partially disjoint subsets of the benchmark in any single pair of runs, our pass$_X$@$2$ estimator reveals that this is largely due to run-to-run variance rather than tool complementarity. Across both models, we find that two bash rollouts outperform the combination of one bash and one debugger rollout. Our findings highlight the importance of accounting for stochastic variance in evaluating agent and tool diversity, and we hope that pass$_X$@$k$ will serve as a useful framework for the community.

papers.title: ChainFlow: Few-Step Latent Flow Matching for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has become a standard way to accelerate LLM inference: a lightweight drafter proposes tokens that the target verifies in one parallel pass. Existing drafters face trade-offs that limits their speedups: autoregressive drafters generate tokens one at a time, so drafting cost grows with draft length, while diffusion drafters generate tokens in parallel but predict each position independently, ignoring inter-token dependencies. We introduce ChainFlow, a new speculative decoding paradigm and the first flow-matching drafter conditioned on the target's hidden states. ChainFlow treats drafting as a short transport over hidden states, needing one or two flow steps instead of the many denoising steps of generation from noise. A variational autoencoder compresses these states so drafting cost barely grows with target size, lightweight feedback heads restore inter-token dependencies, and tree drafting raises acceptance. On Qwen3.5 models, at matched drafter size and training data, ChainFlow outperforms EAGLE-3 and DFlash in vLLM by 39% and 11%, respectively. These gains further widen as drafters are adapted to new languages sequentially. Our ablations cover drafter design and concurrent serving, and we open-source our code and drafter models.

papers.title: Real-World Adoption, Use, and Governance of an LLM-Based Electronic Health Record Search and Synthesis Platform
papers.abstract: We evaluated the longitudinal adoption and use of Scout, an electronic health record-integrated large language model platform that provides cited search and synthesis of patient records, during staged deployment across a multi-hospital academic health system. Over 11 months, 2,635 users completed 80,465 tasks. 1,768 clinical users initiated use within the first 29 days of system-wide launch, which included a required training. Daily initiation increased 21.2-fold at launch, from 2.9 to 61.0 users per day. Of the 495 users who initiated use during the launch week, 310 did so in the first two days. Use spanned more than 20 recorded specialty categories, five care-practitioner roles, and 46,485 distinct prompts involving retrieval, synthesis, extraction, evaluation, and drafting, with 752 tasks saved for reuse. Among care practitioners who completed the required course, 77.9% went on to use Scout, with a median of 1.7 days after course completion. The highest-intensity user quintile accounted for 59.0% of tasks and 61.9% of tokens. Exploratory prompt analysis showed use across retrieval, synthesis, extraction, evaluation, and note-drafting. These findings suggest that rapid, broad adoption requires clinician-led task design and evaluation, traceable governance proportional to reach, centralized capacity planning and user support, and training integrated with access.

papers.title: Compression of Emotion in Language Model Representations
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been evaluated on their ability to identify emotions expressed in text and produce fluent emotional language. However, output predictions alone do not reveal how fine-grained emotion distinctions are organized internally. We study seven LLMs on GoEmotions, an English Reddit dataset annotated with 27 fine-grained emotion categories plus neutral. We compare model predictions and emotion-prompted final-token representations with the 28 GoEmotions categories and with coarser emotion-family and sentiment groupings. We find a consistent pattern of $\textit{overcompression}$ relative to the fine-grained GoEmotions taxonomy. Under the tested KMeans protocol, when we cluster their hidden representations without using emotion labels, the clearest split is into two groups that largely separate positive from negative emotion. Coarser emotion groupings are also recovered with fewer clusters than the full 28-category taxonomy. Yet linear probes retain substantial fine-grained predictive information. These results suggest that fine-grained emotion information remains accessible even though broader affective structure more strongly organizes the unsupervised geometry.

papers.title: Cancellation Is Not Enough: What Retries Leave Behind in an Overloaded LLM Engine
papers.abstract: Clients and proxies in front of an LLM engine retry calls that time out. After a transient overload, these retries can keep the engine from recovering even when calls arrive below its capacity. Since the engine may keep computing for clients that have left, propagating cancellation looks like the natural remedy. In this paper, we test it on vLLM with overload experiments on three open models, and with scheduler traces of one that follow each client attempt to the execution it creates in the engine. We find that with retries on, cancellation alone did not restore service in any run, and only 12-38% of the calls that arrived after the overload were delivered. The traces suggest why: retries that vLLM ran typically started prefill less than half a second before they timed out. Executions that vLLM later aborted took 79-85% of the prompt tokens it computed, and vLLM's prompt-token counter missed a third to half of all computed prompt tokens. A retry budget restored service by shedding retries but left many of the overload's calls undelivered. Request coalescing delivered every call from the overload onward, some late, unless cancellation had already aborted the running execution. Overload controls should thus be judged by the executions that retries add and the calls that clients receive.

papers.title: Enabling Retraining-Free Accurate Inference in Analog Compute in Memory Accelerators
papers.abstract: Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerators compute matrix-vector products directly inside memory arrays, eliminating weight movement and promising order-of-magnitude gains in inference efficiency. However, converter and device errors make pretrained models unusable on these arrays, and hardware-aware retraining is costly. We enable retraining-free, accurate inference of pretrained models on simple analog arrays with low-cost, shared calibration. Our key observation is that analog error depends on how each layer is represented on the array, and that this representation can be changed offline without changing the computation. We center the inputs and apply Hadamard rotations designed for analog arrays, which keep shared reference errors spread and confine input mixing to each array. Across CNNs, vision transformers and LLMs up to 14B parameters on PCM and ReRAM, the method brings vision models and larger LLMs within a few points of floating-point accuracy and matches or approaches published hardware-aware training without training any weights. On ReRAM with 6-bit ADCs, it restores ViT-B/16 from 37.4% to 82.9% and Phi-4 from 27.0% to 72.2%, both within 2.2 points of floating-point accuracy.

translation.title: 在模拟存内计算加速器中实现无需重训练的精确推理
translation.abstract: 模拟存内计算（CIM）加速器直接在存储阵列内计算矩阵向量乘，消除了权重搬运，有望带来数量级的推理效率提升。然而，转换器和器件误差使得预训练模型无法直接在这些阵列上使用，而硬件感知重训练代价高昂。我们通过低成本、共享的校准，实现了预训练模型在简单模拟阵列上无需重训练的精确推理。我们的关键观察是：模拟误差取决于每一层在阵列上的表示方式，而这种表示可以在不改变计算的情况下离线修改。我们对输入进行中心化，并应用专为模拟阵列设计的 Hadamard 旋转，使共享参考误差保持分散，并将输入混合限制在每个阵列内部。在 PCM 和 ReRAM 上、涵盖 CNN、视觉 Transformer 以及高达 14B 参数的 LLM 的实验中，该方法使视觉模型和较大 LLM 的精度达到与浮点精度相差几个百分点以内，并在不训练任何权重的情况下达到或接近已发表的硬件感知训练结果。在配备 6-bit ADC 的 ReRAM 上，该方法将 ViT-B/16 的精度从 37.4% 恢复到 82.9%，将 Phi-4 从 27.0% 恢复到 72.2%，均与浮点精度相差 2.2 个百分点以内。
translation.brief: 解决模拟存内计算中转换器与器件误差导致预训练模型失效的问题，核心方法是通过输入中心化和专为模拟阵列设计的 Hadamard 旋转等离线表示变换实现无需重训练的精确推理。

papers.title: CPU Micro-Architectural Characteristic Sensitivity Study on CPU-Side Agentic Task Latency
papers.abstract: We perform a novel study of CPU micro-architectural characteristics on how they affect agentic AI CPU side latency. Small enterprises and individual users looking to reduce costs and seeking data privacy benefit from running agents locally, motivating an investigation into the optimal performance characteristics of an edge CPU to improve user experience. We investigate the relationship between CPU core frequency, CPU uncore frequency, active physical cores, and symmetric multi threading with agentic task latency in single and multi agent configurations. Across eight experiments on an Intel edge CPU, we find that P-core frequency produces the largest median latency improvement among the evaluated parameters. Increasing P-core frequency from 2.5 to 5.5 GHz yields a 1.154$\times$ speedup for a single agent and a 1.341$\times$ speedup for eight concurrent agents. We are the first to characterize hardware micro-architectural relationships on single and multi agent configurations with TerminalBench; we also provide an open source framework and dataset for repeatable CPU side latency agentic benchmarking.

translation.title: CPU 微架构特性对 CPU 侧智能体任务延迟敏感性的研究
translation.abstract: 我们开展了一项关于 CPU 微架构特性如何影响智能体 AI CPU 侧延迟的新研究。希望降低成本并追求数据隐私的中小企业和个人用户可以从本地运行智能体中受益，这促使我们研究边缘 CPU 的最优性能特性以改善用户体验。我们研究了单智能体和多智能体配置下，CPU 核心频率、CPU uncore 频率、活跃物理核心数以及对称多线程（SMT）与智能体任务延迟之间的关系。在 Intel 边缘 CPU 上的八组实验中，我们发现 P-core 频率在所评估参数中带来最大的中位延迟改善。将 P-core 频率从 2.5 GHz 提升到 5.5 GHz，可为单智能体带来 1.154 倍加速，为八个并发智能体带来 1.341 倍加速。我们是首个使用 TerminalBench 在单智能体和多智能体配置下刻画硬件微架构关系的工作，并提供了一个开源框架和数据集，用于可复现的 CPU 侧延迟智能体基准测试。
translation.brief: 研究 CPU 微架构参数对本地运行智能体任务延迟的影响，核心方法是在 Intel 边缘 CPU 上通过 TerminalBench 系统实验测量核心频率、uncore 频率、物理核心数和 SMT 与延迟的关系。

papers.title: Dual-Stream LLM-Guided Reward Design for Reject-Inference-Aware Reinforcement Learning in E-Commerce Payment Fraud Detection
papers.abstract: Production fraud-detection models learn from a censored slice of their own traffic: transactions a legacy system blocked never receive fraud labels, so models train on a biased, approved-only distribution. We extend LLM-guided reward design, the framework of Qu et al. (2025) in which an LLM evolves the reward of a two-step REINFORCE fraud-blocking policy, to attack this reject-inference problem inside the reward. A single LLM designs a dual-stream reward: stream 1 applies the standard dollar-weighted precision objective to labeled transactions; stream 2 scores legacy-blocked, unlabeled transactions by contrasting the newest gradient-boosted risk signal against the legacy scores that drove the original block. Rather than prescribe which signals matter, we expose a superset of evidence and let the LLM decide for itself which to use, guided by evaluation feedback alone; because it writes the reward as code, that choice is directly auditable. On a held-out four-month out-of-time test, the dual-stream agent beats the prior labeled-only agent at every target recall, by +4.7, +2.4 and +3.0 points of dollar-weighted precision at 80%, 85% and 90% recall, and the production baseline by +6.8 points on average. The resulting policy is architecturally identical to that of Qu et al. (2025) and adds no inference cost.

translation.title: 面向电商支付欺诈检测中拒绝推断感知强化学习的双流 LLM 引导奖励设计
translation.abstract: 生产环境中的欺诈检测模型只从自身流量的被审查切片中学习：被旧系统拦截的交易永远不会获得欺诈标签，因此模型在带有偏差的、仅含已批准交易的分布上训练。我们扩展了 LLM 引导的奖励设计（Qu et al. (2025) 提出的框架，其中 LLM 演化两步 REINFORCE 欺诈拦截策略的奖励），在奖励内部解决这一拒绝推断问题。单个 LLM 设计出双流奖励：流 1 对有标签交易应用标准的美元加权精确率目标；流 2 通过将最新的梯度提升风险信号与驱动原始拦截决策的旧系统分数进行对比，为被旧系统拦截的无标签交易打分。我们不预先规定哪些信号重要，而是暴露一个证据超集，让 LLM 仅凭评估反馈自行决定使用哪些信号；由于它以代码形式编写奖励，这一选择可直接审计。在一个为期四个月的留出时间外测试集上，双流智能体在每个目标召回率下都优于此前仅用有标签数据的智能体，在 80%、85% 和 90% 召回率下美元加权精确率分别提升 +4.7、+2.4 和 +3.0 个百分点，平均比生产基线提升 +6.8 个百分点。所得策略在架构上与 Qu et al. (2025) 相同，且不增加推理成本。
translation.brief: 解决欺诈检测中被旧系统拦截交易无标签导致的拒绝推断偏差问题，核心方法是让 LLM 设计双流奖励，对无标签被拦截交易通过新旧风险信号对比进行打分以训练强化学习策略。

papers.title: Measuring Bounded Autonomy for an LLM Decomposition Planner on a Live 5G-Core Testbed
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are entering network-management control loops, yet their plans can fall outside the executable action space. Whether hard deterministic bounds around such a planner have real effect, or merely restate a definition, is an empirical question. We measure it on a live 5G-core testbed, where an LLM planner decides when to decompose control-plane procedures into stateless handlers inside a bounded loop: a JSON schema constrains the output, a projection-repair validator re-checks it, a deterministic fallback guarantees liveness, and every decision is persisted. Three measurements anchor the paper. First, the two tested models, run unbounded with the allowed action sets stated in the prompt, still violated intent-handler rules in 13 of 44 standard calls. Every violation broke an intent-handler combination rule that the deployed flat schema cannot encode (schema enforcement as deployed caught 0/13); a union schema encoding the rule removes the class by construction. Second, with the bounds in place, all 33 decoded live plans were feasible without repair, and a matched-condition probe put the in-distribution unbounded rate at one violation in 20 windows. Third, exploratory: on the design set the planner matched an author-specified selection reference that a threshold policy and three a priori codings each missed. Transfer to held-out scenarios remained partial (5-6 of 10), and the planner's two-clause distillate could replace the runtime planner itself. Together, the results suggest elicitation and distillation, not runtime control, as the LLM's role.

translation.title: 在真实 5G 核心网测试床上测量 LLM 分解规划器的有界自主性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正在进入网络管理控制回路，但其规划可能落在可执行动作空间之外。围绕此类规划器设置硬性确定性边界究竟有实际效果，还是仅仅重复定义，是一个实证问题。我们在真实 5G 核心网测试床上对此进行测量：LLM 规划器在一个有界循环内决定何时将控制面流程分解为无状态处理器，其中 JSON schema 约束输出，投影修复验证器进行复查，确定性回退保证活性，且每个决策都被持久化。三项测量支撑本文。第一，两个被测模型在无边界、仅在提示中说明允许动作集的情况下运行，在 44 次标准调用中仍有 13 次违反意图-处理器规则。每次违反都破坏了已部署的扁平 schema 无法编码的意图-处理器组合规则（已部署的 schema 强制检查捕获了 0/13）；编码该规则的 union schema 可从构造上消除此类违规。第二，在边界就位的情况下，所有 33 个解码出的真实规划均无需修复即可执行，且匹配条件探针显示分布内无边界违规率为每 20 个窗口 1 次。第三，探索性发现：在设计集上，规划器匹配了作者指定的选择参考，而阈值策略和三种先验编码均未能做到。向留出场景的迁移仍是部分的（10 个中 5-6 个），且规划器的两条款蒸馏产物可以替代运行时规划器本身。综合来看，这些结果表明 LLM 的角色应是引导与蒸馏，而非运行时控制。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 规划器在 5G 核心网控制回路中的有界自主性是否有效，核心方法是在真实测试床上用 JSON schema、投影修复验证器和确定性回退等边界机制测量并约束规划违规。

papers.title: RL-ATTACK: A Generalized Black-Box Adversarial Attack on Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit vulnerabilities to adversarial perturbations that can induce unintended responses. These vulnerabilities can be identified via intentional attacks and subsequently used to improve model safety. In black-box settings where gradients are inaccessible, existing methods tend to guess adversarial transformations using external knowledge, ignoring the information provided by the target model. To mitigate this, we propose a trainable black-box framework based on reinforcement learning, which learns from the target model to generate tailored adversarial transformations. We demonstrate that our approach achieves lower post-attack accuracy, greater query efficiency and better semantic preservation on both natural language inference and generative Q&A tasks. On natural language inference, it drives post-attack accuracy to 2% within 20 queries. Against generative language models, our trained attacker consistently achieves lower post-attack accuracy than the untrained attacker and wins in 4 out of 6 settings when compared to a strong optimization-based baseline. We further experiment with multiple reward designs and training settings, and we find that no design or setting is consistently dominant. Our code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: RL-ATTACK：基于强化学习的语言模型通用黑盒对抗攻击
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）容易受到可诱导非预期响应的对抗扰动影响。这些漏洞可通过有意攻击被发现，进而用于提升模型安全性。在无法获取梯度的黑盒设置下，现有方法倾向于利用外部知识猜测对抗变换，忽略了目标模型提供的信息。为缓解这一问题，我们提出一个基于强化学习的可训练黑盒框架，从目标模型中学习以生成定制化的对抗变换。我们证明该方法在自然语言推理和生成式问答任务上均实现了更低的攻击后准确率、更高的查询效率和更好的语义保持。在自然语言推理上，它可在 20 次查询内将攻击后准确率降至 2%。针对生成式语言模型，我们训练出的攻击者始终比未训练攻击者取得更低的攻击后准确率，且与强优化基线相比在 6 个设置中的 4 个中获胜。我们进一步实验了多种奖励设计和训练设置，发现没有任何设计或设置始终占优。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决黑盒设置下对抗攻击忽略目标模型反馈信息的问题，核心方法是用强化学习训练攻击者从目标模型反馈中学习生成定制化对抗变换。

papers.title: ResServe: Accurate and Efficient FP4 LLM Inference with Residue Compensation
papers.abstract: Block-scaled 4-bit floating-point (FP4) quantization reduces large language model inference costs but can degrade task quality. Higher-precision computation can mitigate this loss at the expense of some of the efficiency gains from FP4 inference. Narrow matrix computations common in decoding often leave spare hardware capacity for low-cost precision recovery. ResServe combines an FP4 activation base with an FP4-quantized residue representing information lost during quantization. It uses this spare capacity to compute the residue's contribution and combines results on-chip, avoiding extra result transfers. We apply this principle to linear layers and decode attention, while selective compensation limits added work when processing input prompts. On NVIDIA B200, compensated linear kernels using the NVFP4 format improve numerical precision while retaining latency close to uncompensated execution for the evaluated operations with few rows. In the evaluated NVFP4 inference configurations, ResServe adds at most 3.4% request-latency overhead over W4A4 and reduces request latency by 22.4-53.3% relative to W4A8. Across five models, code-generation accuracy improves over same-format uncompensated inference, with mean relative gains of 15.04% for NVFP4 and 53.57% for MXFP4.

translation.title: ResServe：基于残差补偿的精确高效FP4大语言模型推理
translation.abstract: 块缩放4位浮点（FP4）量化可降低大语言模型推理成本，但可能损害任务质量。更高精度的计算可以缓解这一损失，但会牺牲FP4推理的部分效率收益。解码中常见的窄矩阵计算往往留下空闲的硬件容量，可用于低成本的精度恢复。ResServe将FP4激活基底与FP4量化的残差相结合，残差表示量化过程中丢失的信息。它利用这些空闲容量计算残差的贡献，并在片上合并结果，避免额外的结果传输。我们将该原理应用于线性层和解码注意力，同时通过选择性补偿在处理输入提示时限制额外工作量。在NVIDIA B200上，使用NVFP4格式的补偿线性内核在评估的少行数操作中提升了数值精度，同时保持接近未补偿执行的延迟。在评估的NVFP4推理配置中，ResServe相比W4A4最多增加3.4%的请求延迟开销，相比W4A8降低22.4-53.3%的请求延迟。在五个模型上，代码生成准确率相比同格式未补偿推理有所提升，NVFP4平均相对提升15.04%，MXFP4平均相对提升53.57%。
translation.brief: 解决FP4量化导致的大语言模型推理精度下降问题，核心方法是利用解码阶段空闲硬件容量计算FP4残差补偿并在片上合并结果。

papers.title: Patching the Blind Spots: Reversible LLM Rule Overlay for Frozen Fraud Detectors
papers.abstract: In industrial tabular fraud classification, gradient-boosted trees remain state-of-the-art, but even a well-trained model has blind spots, and retraining the deployed model is not always safe. We propose a framework that patches such a model without modifying it: LLMs propose rules anchored on features the model underweights by SHAP, and the resulting noisy pool is screened for empirical support and calibrated into an additive, reversible log-lift overlay that runs at the production cut-off. Single-LLM benefit is high-variance and inverts between datasets, so we pool three diverse backbones by equal-weight logit averaging, trading peak gain for a bounded worst case. On a real-world e-commerce fraud detector trained on selection-biased data, continued training regresses even when carefully tuned, whereas the overlay gains on average +2.26% recall at equal precision ($\Delta$R@P) and +1.60% precision at equal recall ($\Delta$P@R) over production cut-offs spanning 30-57% precision and 23-63% recall. On a public benchmark of seven designed bias-shift variants it raises $\Delta$P@R on every variant and keeps $\Delta$R@P near neutral. Each amendment is a readable predicate naming the fraud pattern it covers.

translation.title: 修补盲点：面向冻结欺诈检测器的可逆LLM规则叠加
translation.abstract: 在工业表格欺诈分类中，梯度提升树仍是最先进的方法，但即使是训练良好的模型也存在盲点，而重新训练已部署的模型并不总是安全的。我们提出一个无需修改模型即可对其进行修补的框架：LLM基于SHAP识别出的模型权重不足的特征提出规则，对由此产生的含噪规则池进行经验支持筛选，并校准为在生产截止点运行的可加、可逆的对数提升叠加层。单LLM的收益方差大且在不同数据集间会反转，因此我们通过对三个多样化骨干模型进行等权logit平均来汇集它们，以峰值收益换取有界的最坏情况。在一个基于选择偏差数据训练的真实电商欺诈检测器上，即使经过精心调优，继续训练仍会导致性能回退，而叠加层在精度为30-57%、召回率为23-63%的生产截止点范围内，平均在同等精度下提升召回率+2.26%（ΔR@P），在同等召回率下提升精度+1.60%（ΔP@R）。在一个包含七个设计偏差变体的公开基准上，它在每个变体上都提升了ΔP@R，并保持ΔR@P接近中性。每条修正都是一个可读的谓词，指明其覆盖的欺诈模式。
translation.brief: 解决已部署欺诈检测模型存在盲点且不宜重训的问题，核心方法是用LLM基于SHAP提出规则并校准为可加、可逆的对数提升叠加层。

papers.title: Memory-Aware Multi-Agent Architecture with LLM-based Orchestration for Conversational Recommendation
papers.abstract: Conversational recommender systems often treat user sessions in isolation, limiting their ability to capture how user intent evolves over time. While large language models (LLMs) have improved semantic understanding, they are typically used as isolated components, without addressing how memory, retrieval, and decision-making should be integrated at the system level. In this work, we propose a memory-aware multi-agent architecture for conversational recommendation, in which LLMs act as orchestration layers that coordinate intent refinement, query construction, and interaction flow. A key design principle is the integration of long-term memory as a first-class component, influencing both routing decisions and semantic query formation. We evaluate the system through cross-session memory experiments, multi-turn conversational simulations, and supervisor-driven interaction studies on the Amazon Reviews dataset. Results show that memory-enabled interactions recover up to 63\% of the gap toward explicit-query scenarios and prevent semantic degradation in extended dialogues. In addition, supervisory orchestration increases user acceptance by +28.9 percentage points, highlighting the importance of structured orchestration in guiding interaction and output quality. We also observe an exposure bottleneck between retrieved candidates and displayed recommendations. While LLM-reranking does not improve Hit@K, it consistently enhances semantic consistency and diversity. To capture these effects, we introduce the Semantic Consistency Score (SCS), a complementary evaluation measure. Overall, the results emphasize the importance of system-level design choices, suggesting that effective conversational recommendation benefits from explicit memory integration, orchestration, and evaluation beyond traditional ranking metrics.

translation.title: 基于LLM编排的记忆感知多智能体对话推荐架构
translation.abstract: 对话推荐系统通常孤立地处理用户会话，限制了其捕捉用户意图随时间演变的能力。虽然大语言模型（LLM）提升了语义理解能力，但它们通常被用作孤立组件，没有解决记忆、检索和决策如何在系统层面集成的问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种面向对话推荐的记忆感知多智能体架构，其中LLM作为编排层，协调意图细化、查询构建和交互流程。一个关键设计原则是将长期记忆作为一等组件集成，影响路由决策和语义查询构建。我们通过跨会话记忆实验、多轮对话模拟以及在Amazon Reviews数据集上的监督者驱动交互研究来评估该系统。结果表明，启用记忆的交互最多可恢复与显式查询场景之间63%的差距，并防止长对话中的语义退化。此外，监督式编排使用户接受度提升+28.9个百分点，凸显了结构化编排在引导交互和输出质量方面的重要性。我们还观察到检索候选与展示推荐之间存在曝光瓶颈。虽然LLM重排并未提升Hit@K，但它持续增强语义一致性和多样性。为捕捉这些效应，我们引入了语义一致性评分（SCS）这一补充评估指标。总体而言，结果强调了系统级设计选择的重要性，表明有效的对话推荐受益于显式的记忆集成、编排以及超越传统排序指标的评估。
translation.brief: 解决对话推荐系统孤立处理会话、缺乏记忆与系统集成的问题，核心方法是构建以LLM为编排层、将长期记忆作为一等组件的多智能体架构。

papers.title: Remembering Is Not Enough: Evaluating Timing and Omission in Longitudinal AI Mental Health Support
papers.abstract: Evaluations of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support commonly focus on the clinical appropriateness of individual responses, potentially overlooking failures that emerge across extended interactions. As AI assistants accumulate memory of users' circumstances and prior disclosures, this raises an accountability question: Do AI chatbots provide appropriate support as users' needs evolve? We investigate by analyzing 14,256 longitudinal simulations grounded in donated chatbot histories from 22 users, examining how a memory-equipped assistant responds to suicidal ideation, self-harm, and anxiety crises across recovery trajectories and communication styles. We introduce the Context-Aware and Readiness-Evaluative (CARE) framework, developed with mental health professionals, to assess the timing and quality of advice, including omissions. Advice was less aligned with users' readiness after a crisis than in matched control stretches of the same conversation, largely because of premature recommendations, which were most common when recovery stalled. Revisiting a crisis reduced premature advice but not lagging advice, and users' communication style changed how often and when the assistant gave recommendations. Although explicitly unproductive advice was rare, the assistant frequently omitted clinician-expected support such as follow-up and planning for next steps. These findings show the limits of single response-level safety evaluation and the need to assess timing, omission, and consistency across users when holding AI systems accountable for longitudinal support.

translation.title: 记住还不够：评估纵向AI心理健康支持中的时机与遗漏
translation.abstract: 对用于心理健康支持的大语言模型（LLM）的评估通常聚焦于单个回复的临床适当性，可能忽视在长期交互中出现的失败。随着AI助手积累用户情况和既往倾诉的记忆，这引发了一个问责问题：随着用户需求演变，AI聊天机器人能否提供适当的支持？我们通过分析基于22位用户捐赠的聊天机器人历史记录构建的14,256个纵向模拟来研究这一问题，考察配备记忆的助手在恢复轨迹和沟通风格各异的情况下，如何应对自杀意念、自残和焦虑危机。我们与心理健康专业人士共同开发了情境感知与准备度评估（CARE）框架，用于评估建议的时机和质量，包括遗漏。在危机之后，建议与用户准备度的契合度低于同一对话中匹配的对照片段，主要原因是过早的建议，这在恢复停滞时最为常见。重新提及危机减少了过早建议，但未能减少滞后建议，且用户的沟通风格会改变助手给出建议的频率和时机。虽然明显无益的建议很少见，但助手经常遗漏临床医生期望的支持，例如后续跟进和下一步规划。这些发现表明单条回复层面的安全评估存在局限，在对AI系统的纵向支持进行问责时，需要评估时机、遗漏以及跨用户的一致性。
translation.brief: 解决单回复级评估无法发现AI心理健康支持中长期交互失败的问题，核心方法是基于22位用户真实历史构建14,256个纵向模拟并用CARE框架评估建议的时机、质量与遗漏。

papers.title: Divide, Diagnose, and Compose: Optimizing Agentic Pipelines and Harnesses
papers.abstract: Building agentic pipelines that achieve high task performance while keeping cost and latency low requires jointly optimizing heterogeneous and coupled design choices, including prompts, topology, model selection, and tool policies. Manually searching this combinatorial design space is expensive and time-consuming, while existing automated optimizers typically operate within a predefined subset of this space, modify the pipeline monolithically, or provide little structured evidence for pipeline changes. To mitigate these challenges, we introduce the Decomposed Credit-Assignment Framework (DeCAF), which adapts the design space to the given benchmark and pipeline, optimizes each dimension separately, and generates reasoning traces for every decision. Given a task specification, benchmark examples, and a seed pipeline, DeCAF identifies relevant optimization dimensions and generates diverse experimental hypotheses for each. Independent coding-agent sessions then optimize each dimension under a restricted edit scope, jointly evaluating performance, inference cost, and latency while recording all hypotheses, edits, and outcomes of each experiment. A final synthesis session combines compatible findings across all dimensions and uses a component-level trajectory evaluator, which derives role-specific rubrics from each agent's instructions, to localize underperforming components and guide cross-dimension revisions. Across a diverse suite of agentic benchmarks, DeCAF improves average task performance by 2.58 percentage points, while reducing inference cost by 4.30% and end-to-end latency by 42.45% compared to the best overall baseline.

translation.title: 分而诊之与组合：优化智能体流水线与测试框架
translation.abstract: 构建在保持低成本和低延迟的同时实现高任务性能的智能体流水线，需要联合优化异构且耦合的设计选择，包括提示词、拓扑结构、模型选择和工具策略。手动搜索这一组合设计空间既昂贵又耗时，而现有的自动化优化器通常只在预定义的设计空间子集内操作、以整体方式修改流水线，或为流水线变更提供很少的结构化证据。为缓解这些挑战，我们提出了分解式信用分配框架（DeCAF），它根据给定基准和流水线调整设计空间，分别优化每个维度，并为每个决策生成推理轨迹。给定任务规范、基准示例和种子流水线，DeCAF识别相关的优化维度并为每个维度生成多样的实验假设。随后，独立的编码智能体会话在受限编辑范围内优化每个维度，联合评估性能、推理成本和延迟，同时记录每个实验的所有假设、编辑和结果。最后的综合会话合并所有维度上兼容的发现，并使用组件级轨迹评估器（从每个智能体的指令中推导出角色专属评分标准）来定位表现不佳的组件并指导跨维度修订。在多样化的智能体基准套件上，与最佳整体基线相比，DeCAF将平均任务性能提升2.58个百分点，同时将推理成本降低4.30%，端到端延迟降低42.45%。
translation.brief: 解决智能体流水线中提示、拓扑、模型选择等耦合设计选择难以联合优化的问题，核心方法是DeCAF框架将设计空间分解为各维度独立优化并利用组件级轨迹评估器进行跨维度综合。

papers.title: Structuring Survey Histories for LLM Digital Twins: A Controlled Study of Background, Decision Procedure, and Evaluation Profiles
papers.abstract: LLM-based digital twins aim to predict how individuals would respond in new settings from representations of their prior responses. Existing evidence that compression of survey histories need not reduce predictive accuracy suggests that representation structure, rather than information volume alone, may be an important design choice. We study BDE, a fixed representation that organizes each respondent's survey history into Background, Decision procedure, and Evaluation. We evaluate it on Twin-2K-500 (Toubia et al., 2025) by predicting each respondent's held-out answers on 17 tasks. In a paired evaluation with 100 respondents, a fully inferred BDE profile improves overall accuracy over the raw survey transcript by 1.27 percentage points (pp) on gpt-5.4-nano (p < 0.01) and 1.19 pp on gpt-5.4-mini (p < 0.001). Three analyses then examine the schema, extraction depth, and component composition. Against a length-matched free-form profile written from the same transcript by the same extractor, BDE improves pricing accuracy on both simulators (2.15 pp on nano, p < 0.01; 1.38 pp on mini, p < 0.05), while its overall advantage is significant only on nano (1.05 pp, p < 0.05). Allowing deeper inference during extraction yields no statistically significant gain on either simulator. By contrast, adding Evaluation to a Background--Decision procedure profile improves overall accuracy by 1.44 pp on nano (p < 0.001) and 1.22 pp on mini (p < 0.001). These results indicate that the advantage over raw transcripts is not explained by compression or length alone, and attribute it primarily to profile composition rather than deeper extraction.

papers.title: AlterNet: Adaptive-Depth Mixture-of-Experts with Learned Halting for Elastic Inference
papers.abstract: Most LLM architectures have fixed compute demands determined at training time. We propose a novel architecture that combines the Mixture-of-Experts architecture with shallow experts and a novel dynamic-depth system to make the extent of a forward pass dynamically adjustable. Our approach lets the model automatically determine the compute needed for a given task, paired with a system to scale it down after training without retraining when the execution environment demands faster or cheaper inference. To achieve this, we introduce an iterative computation mechanism, sequence-level depth-based routing steered by a halting mechanism within the experts, a depth encoding that lets the model track its progress in the chain, and a regularization mechanism that incentivizes the model to use allocated compute efficiently. We present initial benchmarks and discuss future research directions.

papers.title: How are viral trends different from educational and commercial uses of LLM image generation and editing? A privacy-preserving descriptive analysis
papers.abstract: Gemini's Nano Banana models, first introduced in late 2025, led to a shift in the capabilities and use of image generation and editing. We utilize Urania, a Google-developed framework for generating insights about LLM chatbot interactions with rigorous differential privacy (DP) guarantees, to analyze use cases and intents, techniques and ways of prompting, without ever looking at a single image or individual prompt. We select a subsample of 2.1M conversations in early 2026 which utilized Nano Banana models, into roughly 800 clusters in five categories: (1) Social & Viral Sharing, (2) Brand & Marketing Collateral, (3) Educational & Technical Information Media, (4) Product Visualizations & E-commerce, and (5) Architectural & Spatial Designs. We then compare these clusters on 21 features of use, measuring aspects of prompts' (a) editing techniques, (b) artistic style requests, (c) composition, and (d) chatbot interactions. This allows us to describe a baseline of how people are using image generation and editing tools for different use cases---(including growing and emergent use cases which were not possible before Nano Banana)---in a privacy-preserving manner.

papers.title: AttentionSwitch: Jailbreak Defense for LLMs via Joint Learning of Sparse Attention-Head Selection and Scaling
papers.abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, yet they remain susceptible to jailbreak attacks that circumvent safety mechanisms and elicit harmful or unintended outputs. Although safety can be improved through model fine-tuning, such approaches can be computationally expensive and may degrade previously acquired capabilities through catastrophic forgetting. Recent jailbreak defenses have therefore explored targeted interventions on specific model components associated with unsafe behavior. However, existing approaches typically decouple two inherently related decisions: where to intervene and how to modify the selected components. Such sequential optimization may be suboptimal because the optimal intervention location can depend on the intervention applied there, and vice versa. In this work, we introduce AttentionSwitch, the first jailbreak defense to jointly optimize intervention sites and strengths within a frozen LLM. Specifically, AttentionSwitch learns a sparse set of attention heads together with query-conditioned multiplicative scaling factors, allowing the outputs of the selected heads to be either attenuated or amplified without altering the directions of their representations. Across popular language models and jailbreak attacks, AttentionSwitch outperforms existing defenses, with particularly strong results when training data is scarce.

papers.title: Debate to Deceive: Poisoning LLM's Fact-Checking via Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Debate
papers.abstract: Knowledge attacks on Large Language Models, such as manipulating fact-checking judgments, pose significant risks to AI reliability. Existing approaches -- adversarial suffix/template injection and single-agent self-reflection -- lack robustness across diverse defenses and are prone to confirmation bias and costly trial-and-error, respectively. We propose Debate-to-Deceive (D2D), a multi-agent debate framework grounded in human debate structure and rhetorical style, enabling agents to generate adversarial passages that are semantically coherent, rhetorically effective, and resistant to early confirmation bias. D2D formalizes the adversarial process as an evolutionary game in which agents adaptively evolve their rhetorical strategies (Logos, Pathos, Ethos) through competition. To manage the intractably large LLM output space, we decouple agent behavior into a strategic layer, which selects a rhetorical action from a compact strategy space via evolutionary-inspired learning dynamics, and a generation layer, where the LLM produces a concrete passage conditioned on that strategy and the debate context. On four fact-checking benchmarks (FEVER, HealthVer, CLIMATE-FEVER, and SciFact), D2D substantially outperforms existing attacks and evades most defenses.
