papers.title: CrowdDirector: Runtime Orchestration of Crowd Simulation through Natural-Language Directives
papers.abstract: Natural language offers an intuitive way to direct a virtual crowd while a simulation is running. Handwritten rules execute efficiently but cannot respond flexibly to varied instructions, whereas asking a large language model (LLM) to control the crowd at every update introduces repeated latency, cost, and the risk of unsupported actions. We present CrowdDirector, a framework that uses an LLM only when the user adds or changes an instruction. The LLM translates the request into a structured instruction, and a scene validator checks whether the entities and actions it references exist in the current Unity scene. Accepted instructions are stored and remain continuously active as the simulation is running. At each simulation tick, a graph neural network uses the current scene state and active instruction to choose an available action and target for each agent, while Unity handles movement, interactions, and animation. The network is trained offline on simulated scenarios, with LLM guidance on how agents should respond to instructions. Our evaluations show the scene validator's feasibility decisions matched human judgements more often than the LLM's own assessment, and on a behavioural benchmark CrowdDirector follows user instructions more closely than handwritten rules while avoiding repeated LLM calls. It therefore provides a practical middle ground between fixed rules and continuous LLM control.

papers.title: Conflux: Preventing Privilege Escalation with Principal Contexts and System-Level Evaluation
papers.abstract: LLM agents combine information from multiple principals while acting externally. We formalise privilege escalation (PE) as the system-level security objective: an action may proceed only if every principal that influenced it would allow it. Model-level defences remain probabilistic, so enforcement must sit outside model judgement. We present Conflux, a principal-context defence. Its kernel, ITES, derives authority from provenance and the organisation's existing access-control system and intersects the permissions of every influencing principal. We prove a conditional authority-confinement theorem: under complete mediation, no-laundering provenance, a known non-empty decision context, fresh permission checks, and action binding, the kernel admits no action that escalates privilege with respect to any recorded influencing principal. The theorem covers the represented value-influence fragment; control influence from tool, branch, recipient, or plan-step selection remains a refinement obligation. Conflux extends the kernel with independent policy ports, argument-aware authorisation, disclosure, consent, delegation, restriction, and exposure planning. We describe two system- level evaluators. SLED is a black-box evaluator: it exhaustively explores a declared finite model of a defence up to a bound. SLED-V is a white-box evaluator: it checks a serialisable intermediate representation against security and provenance properties. The evidence is bounded and partial. The appendix reports retained AgentDojo, SLED, and SLED-V results, including the limits of those runs. No result in this paper is an unbounded deployment guarantee.

papers.title: Guardrail Erosion in Domain Fine-Tuned Large Language Models: A Paired Audit of Knowledge-Centric Abstention in Biomedical LLMs
papers.abstract: The number of domain fine-tuned models, particularly in the biomedical domain, is rapidly expanding. Fine-tuning promises high-performing models at a fraction of the cost of training a base model, but it can also produce unintended behavioral changes. Multiple studies have shown that safety guardrails can erode with fine-tuning, yet large-scale studies across model architectures, data mixtures, and fine-tuning methodologies remain limited. Where prior work in this space has studied value-centric refusal, this work focuses on knowledge-centric abstention. We audit 25 biomedical domain fine-tuned large language models against 11 paired base checkpoints on MedAbstain and ClinDet-Bench to evaluate the impact of fine-tuning on knowledge-centric abstention. We find that defined appropriate abstention measured by these benchmarks, already low in base models (median 8.3% on MedAbstain), falls further after fine-tuning (median 4.2%, decreasing in 21 of 25 pairs on MedAbstain), and that the magnitude and direction of change are heterogeneous across pairs. These results motivate fine-tuning methods that improve domain-specific capability while preserving appropriate caution.

papers.title: Aligning, Fast and Slow: A Control-Theoretic Oversight Framework for Long-Horizon Trajectories and Maintained Deployments
papers.abstract: AI agents can pass checks on individual tasks while retaining memory or code changes that alter their later behavior. We introduce a control-theoretic framework that couples a fast loop controlling proposed actions with a slow loop reviewing persistent changes and reassessing configurations after model or tool updates. When measurement errors and changes between checks are bounded and controllers can enforce their decisions, we derive a deployment-level bound and a rule for dividing review effort. In simulation, dividing a fixed review budget between both loops reduces mean maximum departure from intended behavior roughly twelvefold compared with review confined to individual runs. In coding stress tests with authored memories and five matched seeds, combined controls reduce mean severity on a 0-3 scale from 0.325 without gates to 0.117, resolving 33 of 120 issues versus 35 without gates; in trading stress tests, combined controls reduce mean shortfall in low-emission purchases from 0.892 without gates to 0.107. The overall framework helps developers and auditors compare and enforce oversight designs, while the agent studies test component controls rather than the full deployment-level guarantee.

papers.title: Learning from How Users Interpret: Personalizing Recommendation Explanation Order
papers.abstract: Personalized explanations typically adapt their content or presentation based on preferences, interaction histories, or other user characteristics. We examine whether regularities inferred from prior textual interpretations can support personalization of explanation organization. In a controlled within participant study with 122 participants, prior interpretations were represented along three dimensions: information selection, relative salience, and relational organization. The relational dimension was partially operationalized through co mobilization. These representations were aggregated into fixed historical profiles and used to organize otherwise identical explanation sentences. Participants encountered four organization procedures: the OWN historical profile, the DONOR historical profile, a population profile called POP, and a language model procedure using the historical profile called PROFILE LLM. Post exposure objective comprehension was the primary outcome. OWN achieved 86.5 percent correct responses, compared with 66.0 percent for DONOR, 63.9 percent for POP, and 73.0 percent for PROFILE LLM. Mixed effects analyses showed higher comprehension with OWN than with each alternative procedure. No reliable overall condition effect was detected for recommendation acceptance. These findings indicate that historical profiles derived from prior interpretations can provide an actionable signal for personalizing explanation order while keeping explanatory content and wording fixed.

papers.title: Training Stability under Adaptive Curricula
papers.abstract: Unsupervised Environment Design (UED) approaches train reinforcement learning (RL) agents on diverse curricula that may evolve with their capabilities. While prior work has largely focused on how these curricula are constructed, we study whether their students remain trainable under the resulting distributions. Across multiple UED mechanisms, environment complexities, and extended training horizons, we identify recurring learner-side pathologies, including parameter growth, degraded value--outcome ordering, and loss of representational diversity, that accompany stagnation and performance degradation. These findings connect limitations in UED to optimization failures previously identified in conventional deep RL, while showing how adaptive curricula couple the learner's optimization state to its future training distribution. Controlled interventions show that mitigating selected pathologies improves learning. Stabilizing the learner improves long-horizon performance and zero-shot generalization without changing the curriculum rule or increasing environment interaction. Our results establish learner trainability as a complementary design principle for UED. Effective curricula require students that remain capable of learning from the distributions they produce.

translation.title: 自适应课程下的训练稳定性
translation.abstract: 无监督环境设计（UED）方法在随智能体能力演化的多样化课程上训练强化学习（RL）智能体。以往工作大多关注课程如何构建，我们则研究学生在所得分布下是否仍保持可训练性。在多种UED机制、环境复杂度和延长训练周期下，我们识别出反复出现的学习者侧病理现象，包括参数增长、价值-结果排序退化和表征多样性丧失，它们伴随停滞和性能下降。这些发现将UED的局限与此前在传统深度RL中发现的优化失败联系起来，同时展示了自适应课程如何将学习者的优化状态与其未来训练分布耦合。受控干预表明缓解选定的病理现象可改善学习。在不改变课程规则或增加环境交互的情况下，稳定学习者可提升长周期性能和零样本泛化。我们的结果将学习者可训练性确立为UED的互补设计原则：有效的课程需要能够从其产生的分布中持续学习的学生。
translation.brief: 研究UED课程训练下RL智能体出现的训练病理现象，提出通过稳定学习者（缓解参数增长等病理）来提升长周期性能与零样本泛化。

papers.title: SteerGR: Steering Generative Recommendation via Sparse Autoencoders for Controllable Game Discovery
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation aims to predict item identifiers from user interaction histories, but explicit control over the properties of recommended items remains underexplored. A key challenge is to connect human-readable concepts to internal features whose interventions effectively change the recommended items. To address this, we propose Steerable Generative Recommender (SteerGR), a framework that uses sparse autoencoders for concept-level control in game discovery. SteerGR proceeds through three stages: (i) Concept Definition and Grounding for defining play concepts with an LLM; (ii) Feature Discovery and Selection for discovering candidate features by their concept associations and selecting one by its steering effect; and (iii) Sparse Feature Intervention for amplifying or suppressing selected features to steer recommendations without retraining the recommender. Extensive experiments with two industrial generative recommendation models on a real-world game dataset show that the selected features successfully steer recommendations toward or away from target concepts. We believe this work takes a first step to extend SAE-based steering from LLMs to industrial generative recommendation.

translation.title: SteerGR：基于稀疏自编码器的生成式推荐可控引导，用于游戏发现
translation.abstract: 生成式推荐旨在从用户交互历史预测物品标识符，但对推荐物品属性的显式控制仍未被充分探索。一个关键挑战是将人类可读的概念与干预后能有效改变推荐结果的内部特征联系起来。为此，我们提出可引导生成式推荐器（SteerGR），一个利用稀疏自编码器实现概念级控制的框架，应用于游戏发现。SteerGR分三个阶段：(i) 概念定义与落地，用LLM定义游玩概念；(ii) 特征发现与选择，按概念关联发现候选特征并按引导效果选择其一；(iii) 稀疏特征干预，通过放大或抑制所选特征来引导推荐，无需重新训练推荐器。在真实游戏数据集上对两个工业生成式推荐模型的大量实验表明，所选特征能成功将推荐引导至或偏离目标概念。我们相信这项工作是将基于SAE的引导从LLM扩展到工业生成式推荐的第一步。
translation.brief: 针对生成式推荐缺乏对推荐物品属性显式控制的问题，提出用稀疏自编码器发现与概念关联的特征并通过干预其激活来引导推荐，无需重训模型。

papers.title: MotionDecipher: LLM-Assisted Clinical Interpretation of Human Motion Signals for Efficient Gait Analysis
papers.abstract: Clinical gait and motion analysis is widely used to guide targeted interventions for patients with neurological disorders, the outcome of which is typically a report with descriptions of joint movements and forces. Current practices rely on experts' manual effort, which is labor-intensive and time-consuming. Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) provide opportunities to address this problem, but translating human motion into clinical gait descriptions remains challenging because the quality of the context directly affects LLMs' reasoning capability over continuous motion signals. To tackle this, we introduce MotionDecipher, a novel framework bridging the semantic gap between motion data and clinical interpretations. Specifically, we made 3 key advancements: 1) a Human Motion Tokenizer that converts motion signals into domain-specific tokens for time- and frequency-informed gait interpretation; 2) a Meta Feature Selector that transforms tokens into Structured Representations; and 3) a Hybrid Context Constructor to determine the optimal demonstration-based prompt for In-Context Learning. We evaluated MotionDecipher on data collected at an accredited gait lab from 122 patients and 46 controls. Results show that MotionDecipher achieves 0.91 BERTScore (13% over GPT-5), while expert evaluation ranks MotionDecipher highest in Correctness, Completeness, and Conciseness compared to baselines, highlighting its promise for efficient gait analysis.

translation.title: MotionDecipher：LLM辅助的人体运动信号临床解读，用于高效步态分析
translation.abstract: 临床步态与运动分析被广泛用于指导神经系统疾病患者的针对性干预，其产出通常是描述关节运动和受力的报告。当前实践依赖专家人工，费时费力。大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为解决该问题提供了机会，但将人体运动转化为临床步态描述仍具挑战，因为上下文质量直接影响LLM对连续运动信号的推理能力。为此，我们提出MotionDecipher，一个弥合运动数据与临床解读之间语义鸿沟的新框架。具体包括三项关键进展：1) 人体运动分词器（Human Motion Tokenizer），将运动信号转换为领域特定token，用于结合时域和频域信息的步态解读；2) 元特征选择器（Meta Feature Selector），将token转换为结构化表示；3) 混合上下文构造器（Hybrid Context Constructor），为In-Context Learning确定最优的基于示例的提示。我们在认证步态实验室采集的122名患者和46名对照数据上评估MotionDecipher。结果显示其达到0.91 BERTScore（比GPT-5高13%），专家评估在正确性、完整性和简洁性上均将MotionDecipher排在基线之上，凸显其在高效步态分析上的前景。
translation.brief: 针对专家人工步态分析费时费力的问题，提出MotionDecipher框架，通过运动分词器、结构化表示和混合上下文构造，让LLM将运动信号转化为临床步态报告。

papers.title: Generative Search and Recommendation at Shopify
papers.abstract: Search and recommendation at Shopify require retrieving relevant products from a changing catalog of billions of products under strict latency constraints. We present SID-LLM, which casts both tasks as generating semantic IDs: short sequences of content-derived tokens representing products. We jointly pre-train SID-LLM on catalog and behavioral data, giving search and recommendation a shared representation and training objective. We show that reinforcement learning further improves judged search relevance. Furthermore, distillation from task-specific experts improves recommendation quality over joint supervised fine-tuning without a statistically detected loss in search quality. Finally, for efficient serving, we pair multi-token prediction with a lightweight ranker, improving retrieval quality over our autoregressive baseline while reducing latency. We evaluate SID-LLM both as a standalone retriever and as a component of Shopify's production search and recommendation systems. As a standalone search system, SID-LLM achieves quality comparable to Shopify's existing multi-model search stack while meeting production latency requirements. Integrating SID-LLM into the search and recommendation stacks provides significant gains in both offline evaluations and online A/B tests. Together, these results demonstrate the practical value of semantic-ID generation as a unified approach to product discovery at scale.

translation.title: Shopify的生成式搜索与推荐
translation.abstract: Shopify的搜索与推荐需要在严格延迟约束下从不断变化、规模达数十亿的商品目录中检索相关商品。我们提出SID-LLM，将两项任务统一为生成语义ID：代表商品的、由内容派生的短token序列。我们在目录数据和行为数据上联合预训练SID-LLM，为搜索和推荐提供共享表示与训练目标。我们表明强化学习可进一步提升经人工评判的搜索相关性。此外，从任务特定专家蒸馏可在不损失搜索质量（统计上未检测到）的情况下，比联合监督微调更好地提升推荐质量。最后，为高效服务，我们将多token预测与轻量级排序器结合，在降低延迟的同时提升检索质量。我们既将SID-LLM作为独立检索器评估，也作为Shopify生产搜索与推荐系统的组件评估。作为独立搜索系统，SID-LLM在满足生产延迟要求的同时达到与Shopify现有多模型搜索栈相当的质量。将SID-LLM集成到搜索与推荐栈中，在离线评估和在线A/B测试中均带来显著收益。这些结果共同证明了语义ID生成作为大规模商品发现统一方法的实用价值。
translation.brief: 针对大规模商品搜索与推荐需统一且低延迟的问题，提出SID-LLM将两任务统一为语义ID生成，并结合强化学习、专家蒸馏和多token预测优化质量与延迟。

papers.title: I Think, Therefore I Attack: Evaluating Thought Injection Attacks on Reasoning Agents
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) are one of the key components of current agentic systems. LRMs augment their output with an explicit chain-of-thought reasoning stage, introducing a new attack surface for thought injection, in which untrusted text resembling the model's own deliberation is fed back to the model. We present a two-part study of this attack, performed against the prevailing large, production class open-weight models (e.g., GLM-5.3, MiniMax-M2.5, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next). We first evaluate the effectiveness of static thought-injection prompts under different styles as well as tagged and untagged conditions and find that the effects of thinking tags and payload styles are all properties of the specific target model. In the second study, we exploit this model-specificity in a containerized agentic cyber range, using indirect injection prompts styled in the form of the target model's own reasoning traces to achieve attack success rates (ASR) up to 50% on operational objectives such as reverse-shell exfiltration and repository backdooring. We also find that the same malicious objective in standard prompt injection user voice never succeeds, and thinking tags suppress the agent's tendency to disclose the injection. Our results show that imitating a reasoning model's own thought style is effective for this style of attack, and that tag stripping is an unreliable defense.

translation.title: 我思故我攻：评估针对推理智能体的思维注入攻击
translation.abstract: 大型推理模型（LRM）是当前智能体系统的关键组件之一。LRM在输出中附加显式思维链推理阶段，为思维注入引入了新的攻击面：将形似模型自身思考过程的不可信文本反馈给模型。我们针对主流大型生产级开源权重模型（如GLM-5.3、MiniMax-M2.5、Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）开展了两部分研究。第一部分评估不同风格、带标签与不带标签条件下静态思维注入提示的有效性，发现思考标签和载荷风格的影响均是特定目标模型的属性。第二部分在容器化智能体网络靶场中利用这种模型特异性，使用模仿目标模型自身推理痕迹风格的间接注入提示，在反向shell外泄、仓库植入后门等操作目标上实现高达50%的攻击成功率（ASR）。我们还发现，以标准提示注入用户口吻表达相同恶意目标从未成功，且思考标签会抑制智能体披露注入的倾向。结果表明模仿推理模型自身的思维风格对这类攻击有效，而去标签防御并不可靠。
translation.brief: 研究针对大型推理模型的思维注入攻击，发现模仿目标模型自身推理风格的注入提示可在智能体环境中实现高达50%的攻击成功率，且去标签防御不可靠。

papers.title: Notwithstanding Anything to the Contrary, Ignore All Instructions: Measuring Prompt Injection Guards on Legal Contract Review Attacks
papers.abstract: Specialized prompt injection guards are deployed in front of document analysis systems, but no false positive rate has been published for any of them on legal contracts. We measure eleven open-weights guards on two corpora of legal contracts and find that existing guards struggle: document-level false positive rates are as high as 92.39%; two guards fall below chance on paired AUC; and a five-regex baseline is not Pareto-dominated by any guard in the panel. Controlled probes locate model-specific as well as general failure modes. Prompted LLMs resolve the tested failures, including a second threat category (unauthorized scope claims) on which every guard scores zero. A cascaded LLM solution, where the positives of a mid-tier model are verified by a frontier model, is 6.5x cheaper than using exclusively a frontier model and approaches its performance.

translation.title: 无论如何，忽略所有指令：在法律合同审查攻击上测量提示注入防护
translation.abstract: 专用提示注入防护被部署在文档分析系统之前，但没有任何防护在法律合同上的误报率被公开过。我们在两个法律合同语料库上测量了十一个开源权重防护，发现现有防护表现不佳：文档级误报率高达92.39%；两个防护在配对AUC上低于随机水平；且一个五条正则的基线并未被面板中任何防护Pareto支配。受控探针定位了模型特定和通用的失败模式。通过提示的LLM可以解决这些测试到的失败，包括第二类威胁（未授权范围声明），所有防护在该类别上得分均为零。一种级联LLM方案——由中等模型产生的阳性结果再由前沿模型验证——比完全使用前沿模型便宜6.5倍，且性能接近。
translation.brief: 针对法律合同审查场景中提示注入防护误报率高的问题，通过大规模测量与受控探针定位失败模式，并提出级联LLM验证方案以低成本提升防护性能。

papers.title: What Matters for LLM Persona Simulation: Signal Form in Cold-Start E-Commerce Advertising
papers.abstract: Estimating advertising performance in cold-start settings is challenging because historical logs are unavailable before launch. Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential alternative by simulating persona-conditioned user responses, but it remains unclear which design choices actually drive LLM-based persona simulation. Using real Google Ads e-commerce campaign data across five demographic segments, we identify three signal-form dimensions that affect simulation quality: (i) a demographic anchor without noisy rich attributes, (ii) a relative qualitative banner-blindness signal rather than quantitative anchors, and (iii) prompt phrasing. On this campaign, our method attains an MAE of 24.9 and a MAPE of 26.1%, a 51.3% lower MAE than the best tested non-LLM baseline and 77.3% lower than an LLM configuration using explicit CTR anchors. Systematic ablations show that minimal demographic descriptions achieve lower mean error than richer persona configurations, while relative qualitative cues substantially outperform the tested quantitative anchors. We additionally compare these configurations with direct-prior and rule-based baselines and with alternative LLM configurations.

translation.title: 什么对LLM人格模拟重要：冷启动电商广告中的信号形式
translation.abstract: 在冷启动设置下估计广告效果具有挑战性，因为上线前没有历史日志。大语言模型（LLM）通过模拟人格条件下的用户响应提供了潜在替代方案，但尚不清楚哪些设计选择真正驱动基于LLM的人格模拟。使用来自五个人群细分的真实Google Ads电商广告活动数据，我们识别出影响模拟质量的三个信号形式维度：(i) 无噪声丰富属性的人口统计锚点，(ii) 相对定性的横幅盲视信号而非定量锚点，(iii) 提示措辞。在该广告活动上，我们的方法达到24.9的MAE和26.1%的MAPE，比测试的最佳非LLM基线低51.3%的MAE，比使用显式CTR锚点的LLM配置低77.3%。系统性消融表明，最小化的人口统计描述比更丰富的人格配置实现更低的平均误差，而相对定性线索显著优于测试的定量锚点。我们还将这些配置与直接先验和基于规则的基线以及替代LLM配置进行了比较。
translation.brief: 解决冷启动广告效果预估缺乏历史数据的问题，通过真实广告数据消融实验确定LLM人格模拟中最优的信号形式设计（最小人口统计锚点、相对定性信号、提示措辞）。

papers.title: Jev as an LLM Safety Guardrail: An Empirical Study of Input Filtering, Selective Output Review, and Over-Refusal
papers.abstract: External safety filters can prevent unsafe requests from reaching a large language model (LLM), but may also reject legitimate queries. We present an end-to-end empirical evaluation of Jev, a probabilistic decision model, as a safety guardrail for a Qwen2.5-1.5B-based pipeline. Three configurations are compared on 970 benchmark prompts: an unfiltered LLM, Jev input filtering, and tiered Jev input filtering with selective output review. Across 720 prompts labeled harmful (520 AdvBench and 200 XSTest-unsafe), the fraction recorded as answered decreases from 527/720 (73.2%) without filtering to 17/720 (2.4%) with input filtering. On 250 XSTest-safe prompts, however, non-answer/refusal increases from 3/250 (1.2%) to 27/250 (10.8%). Tiered filtering yields 40/720 (5.6%) harmful-prompt answers and 10/250 (4.0%) benign-prompt refusals, with 79/970 (8.1%) of prompts requiring output review. Joint optimization of the tiered thresholds improves macro-F1 from 0.9351 to 0.9512, while reducing harmful-prompt answers and output-review frequency at the same benign-refusal rate. Matched-budget comparisons reveal modest additional gains over a retuned single gate on the evaluation data, although these gains are not consistently observed on a held-out split.

translation.title: Jev作为LLM安全护栏：输入过滤、选择性输出审查与过度拒绝的实证研究
translation.abstract: 外部安全过滤器可以阻止不安全请求到达大语言模型（LLM），但也可能拒绝合法查询。我们对Jev——一个概率决策模型——作为基于Qwen2.5-1.5B流水线的安全护栏进行了端到端实证评估。在970个基准提示上比较三种配置：无过滤LLM、Jev输入过滤、以及带选择性输出审查的分层Jev输入过滤。在720个标注为有害的提示（520个AdvBench和200个XSTest-unsafe）上，被记录为已回答的比例从无过滤的527/720（73.2%）降至输入过滤的17/720（2.4%）。然而在250个XSTest-safe提示上，不回答/拒绝从3/250（1.2%）升至27/250（10.8%）。分层过滤产生40/720（5.6%）的有害提示回答和10/250（4.0%）的良性提示拒绝，其中79/970（8.1%）的提示需要输出审查。分层阈值的联合优化将macro-F1从0.9351提升至0.9512，同时在相同良性拒绝率下减少有害提示回答和输出审查频率。等预算比较显示，在评估数据上比重新调优的单门控有适度额外收益，尽管这些收益在留出集上并不一致出现。
translation.brief: 评估概率决策模型Jev作为LLM安全护栏在过滤有害请求与避免过度拒绝之间的权衡，比较输入过滤与分层过滤加输出审查等配置并联合优化阈值。

papers.title: When F1 Is Not Enough: Auditing Codebooks for LLM-Assisted Annotation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for text annotation in social science, but standard performance metrics do not explain why errors occur. Low F1 may reflect limitations of the annotation system, defects in the written codebook, or inconsistency in reference labels. We propose a pre-deployment codebook audit for LLM-assisted annotation. The audit uses class-specific metrics and confusion matrices to identify problematic classes and boundaries, structured document-level review to attribute error sources, and targeted codebook revision followed by held-out evaluation. We apply the audit to two published multi-class codebooks from distinct domains. In both applications, the audit identifies under-specified or conflicting coding rules, and targeted revisions reduce the diagnosed errors on held-out data. Analyses with two LLM annotators show that some problematic boundaries and codebook revisions transfer across models, whereas other revision effects are annotator-specific. The results show that LLM annotation errors can help identify weaknesses in the written measurement instrument, not only in the model. Codebook auditing complements prompting, retrieval, and fine-tuning by clarifying whether persistent errors call for model improvement, codebook revision, or renewed scrutiny of reference labels.

translation.title: 当F1不够时：为LLM辅助标注审计编码手册
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于社会科学的文本标注，但标准性能指标无法解释错误发生的原因。低F1可能反映标注系统的局限、编码手册的缺陷或参考标签的不一致。我们提出一种面向LLM辅助标注的部署前编码手册审计。该审计使用类别特定指标和混淆矩阵识别有问题的类别和边界，通过结构化的文档级审查归因错误来源，并进行针对性的编码手册修订及留出集评估。我们将该审计应用于来自不同领域的两个已发表的多类编码手册。在两个应用中，审计均识别出欠明确或冲突的编码规则，且针对性修订减少了留出数据上的诊断错误。使用两个LLM标注者的分析表明，一些有问题的边界和编码手册修订可跨模型迁移，而其他修订效果则依赖于具体标注者。结果表明，LLM标注错误可以帮助识别书面测量工具的弱点，而不仅是模型的弱点。编码手册审计通过澄清持续错误是需要模型改进、编码手册修订还是重新审视参考标签，来补充提示、检索和微调。
translation.brief: 解决LLM辅助标注中低F1无法定位错误根源的问题，提出部署前编码手册审计方法，结合类别指标、混淆矩阵和文档级审查归因错误并针对性修订编码手册。

papers.title: Lea: An Agent Backbone for Mathematician-Controlled Formalization in Lean
papers.abstract: Agentic systems now formalize research-level mathematics in Lean, but they are built for autonomy: the mathematician states a target and inspects a result. The alternative, a general-purpose coding harness, is domain-neutral and must be assembled into a formalization workspace before any mathematics begins. Mathematicians, however, report wanting to keep high-level control over how an argument is decomposed and established. We present $\textbf{Lea}$, a Lean-specific agent backbone for mathematician-facing software rather than a single interface. Lea exposes runs, sessions, and typed events through one application-neutral API, and ships with Lean tooling (blueprints, LSP, Loogle, SafeVerify) already wired. We report two applications built on it: $\textbf{LeaChat}$, a web client for interactive proof authoring, and $\textbf{LeaOverleaf}$, which formalizes theorems annotated directly in an Overleaf document; a session begun in either continues in the other. In a case study, a mathematician outlined a proof of the Durfee square generating function in a few natural-language messages, and Lea produced a complete Lean development from Mathlib alone, following the intended decomposition closely and requiring substantive correction at a single point. Lea and both applications are released as open source so that further mathematician-facing tools can be built on the same backbone.

translation.title: Lea：面向数学家控制的Lean形式化智能体骨干
translation.abstract: 智能体系统如今可以在Lean中形式化研究级数学，但它们是为自主性而构建的：数学家陈述目标并检查结果。另一种选择——通用编码工具框架——是领域中立的，在任何数学开始之前必须组装成形式化工作区。然而数学家们表示希望对论证如何分解和确立保持高层控制。我们提出$\textbf{Lea}$，一个Lean专用的智能体骨干，面向数学家的软件而非单一界面。Lea通过一个应用中立的API暴露运行、会话和类型化事件，并预装了Lean工具（blueprints、LSP、Loogle、SafeVerify）。我们报告了基于它构建的两个应用：$\textbf{LeaChat}$，一个用于交互式证明编写的Web客户端；以及$\textbf{LeaOverleaf}$，它形式化直接在Overleaf文档中标注的定理；在任一端开始的会话可在另一端继续。在一个案例研究中，一位数学家用几条自然语言消息概述了Durfee方生成函数的证明，Lea仅用Mathlib就生成了完整的Lean开发，紧密遵循预期的分解，且仅在一处需要实质性修正。Lea及两个应用均以开源发布，以便更多面向数学家的工具可以在同一骨干上构建。
translation.brief: 解决现有Lean形式化智能体缺乏数学家高层控制的问题，构建Lean专用的智能体骨干Lea，通过应用中立API和预装Lean工具支持数学家主导的交互式定理形式化。

papers.title: "I had nobody to turn to": Why LGBTQ+ People Choose (Not) to Use AI Chatbots for Personal Health and Relationship Advice
papers.abstract: While there is an abundance of research into large language model (LLM) biases against LGBTQ+ communities, far less research has examined how and why LGBTQ+ people choose to make use of AI chatbots. In this work, we examine how LGBTQ+ people choose (not) to use AI chatbots across three domains in which LGBTQ+ users have unique needs: relationship support, mental health support, and gender or sexual health support. We surveyed 73 people (60 LGBTQ+; 13 non-LGBTQ+) on how they interact with AI chatbots and find that participants' access to external resources, privacy concerns, and perceptions of chatbot capabilities shape whether and how they choose to make use of AI chatbots. For instance, some LGBTQ+ participants felt that chatbots might actually be less biased against LGBTQ+ people than the people they know offline. We also find that LGBTQ+ participants report using AI chatbots less frequently than non-LGBTQ+ participants across 15 specific personal health and relationship advice scenarios, citing concerns about AI sycophancy and adverse cognitive side-effects. Recognizing AI chatbots as vital (albeit imperfect) resources for LGBTQ+ people, we recommend researchers consider systemic issues that drive users to AI chatbots and design technologies (AI or otherwise) that prioritize privacy, anonymity, and real human connection.

translation.title: “我无人可倾诉”：LGBTQ+ 人群为何选择（不）使用 AI 聊天机器人获取个人健康与情感关系建议
translation.abstract: 尽管已有大量关于大语言模型（LLM）对 LGBTQ+ 群体偏见的研究，但关于 LGBTQ+ 人群如何以及为何选择使用 AI 聊天机器人的研究却少得多。本工作考察了 LGBTQ+ 人群在三个具有独特需求的领域——情感关系支持、心理健康支持以及性别或性健康支持——中如何选择（不）使用 AI 聊天机器人。我们调查了 73 人（60 名 LGBTQ+，13 名非 LGBTQ+）与 AI 聊天机器人的互动方式，发现参与者可获得的外部资源、隐私顾虑以及对聊天机器人能力的认知，决定了他们是否以及如何选择使用 AI 聊天机器人。例如，一些 LGBTQ+ 参与者认为聊天机器人对 LGBTQ+ 人群的偏见实际上可能比他们线下认识的人更少。我们还发现，在 15 个具体的个人健康与情感关系建议场景中，LGBTQ+ 参与者使用 AI 聊天机器人的频率低于非 LGBTQ+ 参与者，并提及对 AI 阿谀奉承（sycophancy）及不良认知副作用的担忧。鉴于 AI 聊天机器人是 LGBTQ+ 人群的重要（尽管不完美）资源，我们建议研究者关注驱使用户转向 AI 聊天机器人的系统性问题，并设计优先考虑隐私、匿名性和真实人际连接的技术（无论是否为 AI）。
translation.brief: 研究 LGBTQ+ 人群在健康与关系建议场景中使用或不使用 AI 聊天机器人的原因，通过 73 人问卷调查揭示资源可及性、隐私顾虑与能力认知的影响。

papers.title: Mind the Divergence: Divergence-Guided Reliability-Aware Fusion and Adaptive LLM Prompting for Conversational Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversations (MERC) integrates textual, acoustic, and visual cues to identify utterance-level emotions. However, existing approaches generally do not explicitly adapt multimodal processing to the degree of inter-modal predictive disagreement. In real conversations, semantic incongruity, concealed emotion, noisy observations, and ambiguity can affect modality-specific emotional evidence differently, while the reliability of individual modalities varies across samples. Rather than identifying each source of inconsistency separately, we model their common consequence for emotion recognition as predictive disagreement among unimodal emotion distributions over the same emotion-label set. Such disagreement makes indiscriminate fusion prone to propagating unreliable or competing evidence. Inspired by the Brunswik Lens Model, we propose MiD-ERC, a divergence-centric framework that quantifies inter-modal predictive disagreement using a normalized divergence score and estimates sample-specific modality reliability. MiD-ERC uses these signals to coordinate divergence-guided cross-modal gating, divergence-modulated reliability weighting, and divergence-conditioned adaptive LLM prompting. The framework is trained end-to-end using only standard emotion annotations, without requiring additional conflict labels, auxiliary data construction, or external retrieval modules. Experiments on IEMOCAP and MELD demonstrate that MiD-ERC achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly pronounced improvements on high-divergence samples.

translation.title: Mind the Divergence：面向对话情感识别的散度引导可靠性感知融合与自适应 LLM 提示
translation.abstract: 对话中的多模态情感识别（MERC）整合文本、声学和视觉线索来识别话语级情感。然而，现有方法通常没有根据模态间预测分歧的程度显式地调整多模态处理。在真实对话中，语义不一致、情感隐藏、噪声观测和歧义会以不同方式影响各模态的情感证据，而单个模态的可靠性也因样本而异。我们没有分别识别每种不一致来源，而是将它们对情感识别的共同后果建模为同一情感标签集上各单模态情感分布之间的预测分歧。这种分歧使得不加区分的融合容易传播不可靠或相互冲突的证据。受 Brunswik 透镜模型启发，我们提出 MiD-ERC，一个以散度为中心的框架，使用归一化散度分数量化模态间预测分歧，并估计样本特定的模态可靠性。MiD-ERC 利用这些信号协调散度引导的跨模态门控、散度调制的可靠性加权和散度条件下的自适应 LLM 提示。该框架仅使用标准情感标注进行端到端训练，无需额外的冲突标签、辅助数据构建或外部检索模块。在 IEMOCAP 和 MELD 上的实验表明，MiD-ERC 达到了最先进的性能，在高散度样本上的提升尤为显著。
translation.brief: 针对多模态对话情感识别中模态间预测分歧导致融合不可靠的问题，提出用归一化散度分数引导跨模态门控、可靠性加权与自适应 LLM 提示的 MiD-ERC 框架。

papers.title: Adaptive Scheduling Pipeline for Multi-Instance Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: We present the Adaptive Scheduling Pipeline (ASP), an offline rollout scheduler for multi-instance asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) of large language models (LLMs). ASP jointly reduces three sources of rollout underutilization - padding bubbles from intra-minibatch length heterogeneity, skewness bubbles from long-tail outputs, and sorting bubbles from fluctuations in training-queue occupancy induced by length-sorted dispatch - through a single offline preprocessing pass. This enables efficient multi-instance rollout that overcomes the early scaling plateau of single-instance inference while smoothing the arrival of generated samples at the trainer. We integrate the scheduler into an asynchronous architecture that decouples rollout from training while keeping policy lag observable and bounded. Complete ASP improves end-to-end throughput by up to 3.22 times and reduces iteration time by up to 76.8% relative to MindSpeed-RL, while reducing iteration time by up to 62.5% relative to verl. Within ASP, scheduling reduces mean iteration time by 10.9%. ASP also scales more robustly with additional generation resources than these baselines and shows no visible convergence degradation in the measured bounded-lag regime. ASP has since been used in an internal telecom-domain RL post-training workflow, reducing the reported training period from more than three months to about two months and producing a domain-enhanced model for knowledge answering and tool calling.

translation.title: 面向多实例异步强化学习的自适应调度流水线
translation.abstract: 我们提出了自适应调度流水线（ASP），一个用于大语言模型（LLM）多实例异步强化学习（RL）的离线 rollout 调度器。ASP 通过单次离线预处理，联合减少三种 rollout 资源利用率低下的来源——由 minibatch 内长度异质性导致的填充气泡、由长尾输出导致的偏斜气泡，以及由按长度排序分发引起的训练队列占用波动导致的排序气泡。这使得高效的多实例 rollout 成为可能，既克服了单实例推理的早期扩展瓶颈，又平滑了生成样本到达训练器的过程。我们将该调度器集成到一个异步架构中，该架构将 rollout 与训练解耦，同时保持策略滞后（policy lag）可观测且有界。完整的 ASP 相比 MindSpeed-RL 将端到端吞吐量提升至多 3.22 倍、迭代时间减少至多 76.8%，相比 verl 将迭代时间减少至多 62.5%。在 ASP 内部，调度使平均迭代时间降低 10.9%。与这些基线相比，ASP 在增加生成资源时扩展得更稳健，并且在所测量的有界滞后区间内没有可见的收敛退化。ASP 此后已被用于内部电信领域 RL 后训练工作流，将报告的训练周期从三个多月缩短至约两个月，并产出了一个在知识问答和工具调用方面得到领域增强的模型。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 异步强化学习中 rollout 资源利用率低的问题，提出通过单次离线预处理消除填充、偏斜和排序三类气泡的自适应调度流水线 ASP。

papers.title: Rethinking Agent Trajectory Compression: A Workflow-Aware Perspective
papers.abstract: As long-horizon agents increasingly rely on multi-step tool interactions to accomplish complex tasks, their execution trajectories continuously accumulate structured outputs and intermediate artifacts, leading to growing context overhead. Existing compression methods primarily rely on text importance or fixed truncation rules, often overlooking cross-step dependencies within workflows and potentially discarding critical information required for subsequent task execution. To address this challenge, we propose WAAC, a workflow-aware framework for agent trajectory compression. WAAC structurally models successful historical trajectories to extract reusable workflow compression experience and incorporates online backward dependency analysis to dynamically identify information retention requirements. By combining current dependency constraints with historical experience, WAAC selects appropriate compression strategies for different types of historical information. Experiments on PinchBench and Odysseys demonstrate that WAAC achieves an overall score of 87.6 and a perfect completion rate of 19.0%, respectively, while reducing execution costs by 19.7% and 29.1% compared with the strongest baseline methods. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of workflow-aware trajectory compression in improving task performance and cost efficiency for long-horizon agents. Code and resources are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 重新思考智能体轨迹压缩：一种工作流感知的视角
translation.abstract: 随着长程智能体日益依赖多步工具交互来完成复杂任务，其执行轨迹会不断累积结构化输出和中间产物，导致上下文开销持续增长。现有压缩方法主要依赖文本重要性或固定截断规则，往往忽略工作流内的跨步骤依赖，并可能丢弃后续任务执行所需的关键信息。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 WAAC，一个工作流感知的智能体轨迹压缩框架。WAAC 对成功的历史轨迹进行结构化建模，以提取可复用的工作流压缩经验，并结合在线反向依赖分析来动态识别信息保留需求。通过将当前依赖约束与历史经验相结合，WAAC 为不同类型的历史信息选择合适的压缩策略。在 PinchBench 和 Odysseys 上的实验表明，WAAC 分别取得 87.6 的总分和 19.0% 的完美完成率，同时相比最强基线方法将执行成本降低 19.7% 和 29.1%。这些结果证明了工作流感知的轨迹压缩在提升长程智能体任务性能和成本效率方面的有效性。代码和资源见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对智能体轨迹压缩忽略跨步骤依赖的问题，提出通过历史轨迹建模提取压缩经验并结合在线反向依赖分析来选择压缩策略的 WAAC 框架。

papers.title: Reconstructing LLM Lineage Trees via Fine-Tuning Path Inference
papers.abstract: Fine-tuned (FT) derivatives of large language models (LLMs) are now released in large numbers, yet their provenance relies on self-reports and cannot be verified. Misattributed lineage leaves a verifier unable to audit outsourced fine-tuning, confirm license compliance of derived models, or trace vulnerabilities that a parent passes to its children. All three require the direction of derivation, not merely its presence. Existing output-only methods are limited to pairwise derivation tests or undirected lineage estimation, while recovering a directed tree requires white-box access to model weights. We formalize the problem of reconstructing a directed model tree, including internal nodes, under gray-box access, where only teacher-forced log-likelihoods are observed and weights are never inspected. Fine-tuning raises the log-likelihood of the training data, and a child inherits this increase from its parent. Building on this property, we define an asymmetric per-task log-likelihood deviation between any two models as a trace of fine-tuning history, and derive from it an edge weight for each ordered pair of models. We propose TRACE-Edge, which exactly solves for the maximum spanning directed tree under these edge weights, with neither hyperparameters nor tree-structure constraints. We evaluate it on five configurations totaling 25 model trees built from three base models and seven tasks. TRACE-Edge achieves a parent-match accuracy of 0.74 when probed with the fine-tuning examples, and on average outperforms an output-similarity baseline even with held-out probes drawn from the same distribution as the training data.

translation.title: 通过微调路径推断重建 LLM 谱系树
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的微调（FT）衍生模型如今被大量发布，但其来源依赖自我报告且无法验证。错误的谱系归属使验证者无法审计外包的微调、确认衍生模型的许可证合规性，或追踪由父模型传递给子模型的漏洞。这三者都需要推导的方向，而不仅仅是推导的存在。现有的仅基于输出的方法仅限于成对推导测试或无向谱系估计，而恢复有向树需要对模型权重的白盒访问。我们在灰盒访问条件下形式化了重建有向模型树（包括内部节点）的问题，其中仅观测 teacher-forced 对数似然，从不检查权重。微调会提高训练数据的对数似然，而子模型会从父模型继承这种提升。基于这一性质，我们定义任意两个模型之间的非对称逐任务对数似然偏差作为微调历史的痕迹，并由此为每个有序模型对导出边权重。我们提出 TRACE-Edge，在这些边权重下精确求解最大生成有向树，既不需要超参数也不需要树结构约束。我们在由三个基础模型和七个任务构建的共 25 个模型树的五种配置上进行评估。TRACE-Edge 在使用微调样本探测时达到 0.74 的父模型匹配准确率，即使使用与训练数据同分布的保留探测样本，其平均表现也优于输出相似度基线。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 衍生模型谱系无法验证的问题，提出利用灰盒对数似然偏差作为边权重并精确求解最大生成有向树的 TRACE-Edge 方法来重建有向谱系树。

papers.title: Inside the Trap: A Renewal Law for Prefix-Cache Collapse in LLM Agent Serving
papers.abstract: Prefix caching lets an LLM agent's follow-up turns reuse cached KV, but a burst can tip an engine into a trap in which every turn misses and the backlog does not drain, at a load it served before. In registered paired tests on two engines, two GPUs and two models (passed at 9 of 10 rates), a 200-session burst left the engine at zero hits to the end in all 30 runs, while every matched no-burst run stayed good and a session cap prevented the trap in all 30 capped runs. We analyse an idealization of the trapped state exactly: for a fluid FIFO server on which every turn misses, we prove that along FIFO orbits its cycles obey a linear renewal recursion. As is classical, the trap drains if and only if arrivals are below the all-miss capacity; above it, a Perron root fixes the dynamics: every trapped state converges to a known self-similar regime in which the gap between turns grows linearly and the turns served are young and short. For our workload the backlog grows at 0.6 to 0.8 of the excess load and sessions complete faster than the all-miss capacity, a youth premium with turn-count and cost-growth factors, so in the model a trap's measured throughput overstates the recovery threshold. Retrospectively, with nothing fitted to trap data, the theory matches 57 stuck runs: the mean served prompt within 3% in 50 runs, completions above the all-miss capacity in every run, and the pooled gap growth. Blind in outcome, 4 runs trapped by a tool slowdown met 4 of 5 pre-set scores, cut traps persisted, and with a 20-step budget, trapped runs completed below the all-miss capacity, as predicted. Of two exits, refusing arrivals sheds sessions; a session cap restores reuse: in registered tests it rescued 9 of 9 established traps at the same load without shedding, and the engine stayed good after release. We do not prove that the engine converges to the model.

translation.title: 陷阱内部：LLM Agent 服务中前缀缓存崩塌的更新律
translation.abstract: 前缀缓存使 LLM agent 的后续轮次可以复用缓存的 KV，但一次突发负载可能使引擎陷入陷阱：在它此前能承受的负载下，每一轮都缓存未命中且积压无法排空。在两个引擎、两块 GPU 和两个模型上的注册配对测试（10 个速率中 9 个通过）中，200 会话的突发使引擎在全部 30 次运行中命中率保持为零直到结束，而所有匹配的无突发运行均保持正常，且会话上限在全部 30 次受限运行中阻止了陷阱。我们对陷阱状态的理想化进行了精确分析：对于一个每轮都未命中的流体 FIFO 服务器，我们证明沿 FIFO 轨道其周期服从线性更新递归。经典结论是，当且仅当到达率低于全未命中容量时陷阱才会排空；高于该容量时，Perron 根决定了动力学：每个陷阱状态都收敛到一个已知的自相似区域，其中轮次间隔线性增长，且被服务的轮次年轻而短促。在我们的工作负载下，积压以超额负载的 0.6 到 0.8 倍增长，会话完成速度快于全未命中容量（一种带有轮次数和成本增长因子的年轻溢价），因此在模型中陷阱的实测吞吐量会高估恢复阈值。回顾性地看，在没有任何数据拟合的情况下，该理论匹配了 57 次卡死运行：50 次运行中被服务提示的均值误差在 3% 以内，每次运行的完成量都高于全未命中容量，且合并的间隔增长也吻合。在结果盲测中，4 次由工具减速引发的陷阱运行满足 5 项预设指标中的 4 项，截断陷阱持续存在，且在 20 步预算下，陷阱运行的完成量低于全未命中容量，与预测一致。在两种退出方式中，拒绝到达会丢弃会话；会话上限则恢复复用：在注册测试中，它在相同负载下无需丢弃即挽救了 9 个已形成的陷阱中的 9 个，且释放后引擎保持正常。我们并未证明引擎会收敛到该模型。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 服务中突发负载导致前缀缓存全未命中的"陷阱"状态，通过流体 FIFO 服务器的线性更新递归理论刻画其动力学，并提出会话上限作为恢复复用的退出机制。

papers.title: From Procedures to Permissions: Learning Precise Subagent Authorization from Agent Skills
papers.abstract: As language agents tackle increasingly complex tasks, they increasingly rely on multiple agents to coordinate specialized work, requiring decisions not only about what each subagent should do but also which tools and workspace resources it should access. Existing agent systems provide mechanisms for controlling tools and execution environments, but do not directly specify the resources required by each delegated subtask. Moreover, task outcomes and execution trajectories alone provide limited supervision for determining whether a subagent has received appropriate permissions. We observe that Agent Skills encode procedural knowledge describing the operations, tools, and files required at each step, providing a natural source of supervision for authorization. Building on this observation, we synthesize tasks and step-by-step procedures from Skills, execute them through subagent delegation in interactive environments, and use verified trajectories to construct training data for task execution and authorization. On ClawArena-Team, our method improves tool permission precision by 13.4 percentage points and workspace permission precision by 24.1 percentage points, while increasing overall task success by 11.6 percentage points for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. On Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SkillsBench, our method remains competitive with existing agent data synthesis approaches. These results show that the procedural knowledge embedded in Agent Skills provides a source of supervision for precise subagent orchestration that task outcomes alone cannot provide.

translation.title: 从流程到权限：从 Agent Skills 学习精确的子代理授权
translation.abstract: 随着语言代理处理日益复杂的任务，它们越来越依赖多个代理协调专业化工作，这不仅需要决定每个子代理应做什么，还需决定其应访问哪些工具和工作区资源。现有代理系统提供了控制工具和执行环境的机制，但并未直接指定每个被委派子任务所需的资源。此外，仅凭任务结果和执行轨迹难以为判断子代理是否获得恰当权限提供监督。我们观察到 Agent Skills 编码了描述每一步所需操作、工具和文件的流程性知识，为授权提供了天然的监督来源。基于这一观察，我们从 Skills 合成任务和分步流程，在交互环境中通过子代理委派执行它们，并利用经验证的轨迹构建任务执行与授权的训练数据。在 ClawArena-Team 上，我们的方法将 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 的工具权限精确率提升 13.4 个百分点，工作区权限精确率提升 24.1 个百分点，同时整体任务成功率提升 11.6 个百分点。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 SkillsBench 上，我们的方法与现有代理数据合成方法保持竞争力。这些结果表明，Agent Skills 中蕴含的流程性知识为精确的子代理编排提供了任务结果本身无法提供的监督来源。
translation.brief: 利用 Agent Skills 中编码的分步流程知识作为监督信号，合成任务与经验证轨迹来训练子代理的精确工具和工作区权限授权。

papers.title: Toward LLM Self-Play Under Data Scarcity: Effectiveness, Generalizability, and Trustworthiness
papers.abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has been driven largely by scaling model size and human-curated training data, yet this paradigm is increasingly constrained by data scarcity and diminishing returns from human supervision. Self-play offers a promising pathway for autonomous data generation and improvement, but current frameworks remain unsatisfactory due to a lack of a data-centric perspective, limited cross-domain generalization, and growing trustworthiness and security concerns. In this paper, we argue that real-world LLM self-play systems should achieve effectiveness, generalizability, and trustworthiness under data scarcity. To address these challenges, we outline three blue-sky research directions for future self-play systems: (1) data-centric self-play for effective experience generation, (2) generalizable self-play for open-world and unverifiable tasks, and (3) trustworthy self-play for reliable self-evolution. We further discuss research opportunities and solutions within each direction. This paradigm shift will establish a sustainable and safe AI ecosystem by transforming finite human knowledge into inexhaustible high-quality experience through self-play architectures.

translation.title: 迈向数据稀缺下的 LLM 自博弈：有效性、泛化性与可信性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展主要得益于模型规模和人工策划训练数据的扩展，但这一范式日益受到数据稀缺和人类监督收益递减的制约。自博弈为自主数据生成与改进提供了有前景的路径，但当前框架仍不尽如人意，原因在于缺乏以数据为中心的视角、跨领域泛化能力有限，以及日益增长的可信性与安全性担忧。本文主张，现实世界的 LLM 自博弈系统应在数据稀缺条件下实现有效性、泛化性和可信性。为应对这些挑战，我们概述了未来自博弈系统的三个前瞻性研究方向：（1）以数据为中心的自博弈以实现有效的经验生成；（2）面向开放世界和不可验证任务的泛化性自博弈；（3）面向可靠自我进化的可信自博弈。我们进一步讨论了每个方向内的研究机遇与解决方案。这一范式转变将通过自博弈架构将有限的人类知识转化为取之不尽的高质量经验，从而建立一个可持续且安全的 AI 生态系统。
translation.brief: 针对数据稀缺下 LLM 自博弈的不足，提出以数据为中心、可泛化、可信三个研究方向及相应解决方案的立场论文。

papers.title: Frame: Form-Restricted Authoring with Model-Based Evaluation
papers.abstract: Many professional reports reuse the structure of prior editions while updating the content. We formalize this setting as form-restricted report generation: given a sample report and new grounding documents, generate a report that preserves the sample's form while accurately reflecting the new evidence. We introduce FRAME, a benchmark of 120 EDGAR- and arXiv-derived instances across Financial Quarterly, Financial Annual, Academic Simple, and Academic Complex categories, built with a temporal three-snapshot pipeline. We evaluate outputs with three human-validated metrics: structural similarity via semantic tree-edit distance, coverage via information unit recall, and faithfulness via claim-level grounding verification. Across five LLMs, open-source models nearly match proprietary models on structure but lag on coverage and faithfulness; all models perform better on financial than academic reports, and performance declines with longer outputs and more complex grounding.

translation.title: Frame：基于模型的表单受限报告撰写与评估
translation.abstract: 许多专业报告在更新内容时会复用先前版本的结构。我们将这一场景形式化为表单受限报告生成：给定一份样例报告和新的依据文档，生成一份保留样例形式同时准确反映新证据的报告。我们提出 FRAME 基准，包含 120 个源自 EDGAR 和 arXiv 的实例，涵盖财务季报、财务年报、学术简单和学术复杂四个类别，采用时间三快照流水线构建。我们用三项经人工验证的指标评估输出：基于语义树编辑距离的结构相似性、基于信息单元召回的覆盖率，以及基于声明级依据验证的忠实性。在五个 LLM 上的评估显示，开源模型在结构上接近专有模型，但在覆盖率和忠实性上落后；所有模型在财务报告上优于学术报告，且性能随输出变长和依据更复杂而下降。
translation.brief: 提出表单受限报告生成任务及 FRAME 基准，用结构相似性、覆盖率和忠实性三项指标评估 LLM 在保留样例结构的同时更新内容的能力。

papers.title: Glyph: An Interpretability Engine for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery in Clinical Data
papers.abstract: Automated scientific discovery has the potential to advance understanding of disease mechanisms and accelerate identification of early disease markers. Manual data annotation is infeasible at population scale, motivating methods that automatically extract pre-defined phenotypes in multimodal and unstructured clinical data. Such pre-defined feature sets determine and limit which associations these approaches can discover. This limitation extends to agentic AI systems that use these tools to query population-scale data. In contrast, foundation models (FMs) trained on large volumes of clinical data can perform tasks beyond their training objectives. This suggests their latent embeddings may represent novel or unexplored features that could yield insights into disease mechanisms, yet such latent features remain difficult to interpret. To address this challenge, we introduce Glyph, an automated multistage framework that extracts features from multimodal and unstructured clinical data using FMs and sparse autoencoders, interprets them as coded clinical concepts, and evaluates their value for clinical scientific discovery. We applied Glyph to abdominal CT volumes, CT radiology reports and laboratory measurements from 41,628 patients across different institutions. We identified 397 predictive concepts supported by 4,463 Bonferroni-significant associations. Moreover, a majority of discovered associations were automatically reproducible in held-out cohorts across different sites. Glyph concepts provided complementary associations to literature-derived markers, leading to gains in predictive power. We envision that interpretability can extend beyond a mechanistic understanding of neural networks to connecting implicitly learned features with clinical knowledge and establishing their significance for patient outcomes. We release Glyph at this https URL.

translation.title: Glyph：面向临床数据 AI 驱动科学发现的可解释性引擎
translation.abstract: 自动化科学发现有望加深对疾病机制的理解并加速早期疾病标志物的识别。人工数据标注在人群规模上不可行，这促使人们研究从多模态和非结构化临床数据中自动提取预定义表型的方法。此类预定义特征集决定并限制了这些方法可发现的关联，这一局限也延伸到使用这些工具查询人群规模数据的 agentic AI 系统。相比之下，在大规模临床数据上训练的基础模型（FM）可以完成超出其训练目标的任务，这表明其潜在嵌入可能表示新颖或未被探索的特征，从而可能揭示疾病机制，但这些潜在特征仍难以解释。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Glyph，一个自动化多阶段框架，它使用 FM 和稀疏自编码器从多模态和非结构化临床数据中提取特征，将其解释为编码的临床概念，并评估其对临床科学发现的价值。我们将 Glyph 应用于来自不同机构 41,628 名患者的腹部 CT 体积、CT 放射学报告和实验室测量数据。我们识别出 397 个预测性概念，由 4,463 个经 Bonferroni 校正显著的关联支持。此外，大多数发现的关联可在不同机构的留出队列中自动复现。Glyph 概念提供了对文献来源标志物的补充关联，带来了预测能力的提升。我们期望可解释性不仅限于对神经网络的机制性理解，还能将隐式学习的特征与临床知识联系起来，并确立其对患者结局的意义。我们在该 https URL 发布 Glyph。
translation.brief: 提出 Glyph 框架，用基础模型和稀疏自编码器从多模态临床数据中提取并解释潜在特征为临床概念，以发现可复现的疾病关联。

papers.title: ResQAdam: Residual-Preserving Adaptive Optimization for Memory-Efficient Quantization Aware Training
papers.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is the most reliable way to obtain accurate low-bit large language models (LLMs), but training with AdamW keeps two dense FP32 states for every weight matrix. We find that low-rank memory-efficient optimizers such as GaLore and LDAdam degrade substantially in QAT. A considerable part of the QAT momentum lies outside its top-r singular subspace, and projection-based methods discard this part at every step. We further observe that this residual remains useful when only its sign is kept. Based on these observations, we propose ResQAdam. It keeps a single BF16 momentum, applies Adam only to the r x r coordinates of the principal subspace, and adds a normalized sign update computed from the residual. We evaluate ResQAdam with two from-scratch QAT methods and three QAT fine-tuning pipelines, with weights quantized down to 2 bits. It reduces optimizer-state memory by 71% to 74% relative to AdamW, stays close to AdamW in most settings, and lowers training throughput by less than 2%.

papers.title: LLM-Augmented Flow for Project Conformation and Task Complexity Evaluation Based on the TLM Framework
papers.abstract: The software development process, from inception to a working product or solution, can be divided into two major phases: discovery (Discovery) and delivery (Delivery). The Discovery is further subdivided into High-Level Discovery (HLD) and Low-Level Discovery (LLD). During HLD, management identifies the business solution or product to be integrated into the company's infrastructure. LLD, in turn, produces requirement documentation artifacts, including the Product Requirements Document (PRD), Business Requirements Document (BRD), and Functional Specifications Document (FSD). Story Points (SP) are a widely used modern approach to measuring the effort required to accomplish predetermined tasks, and the artifacts listed above help derive SP more precisely. With the rapid growth of LLM technologies, one of the main questions that arises is whether the whole Discovery phase, or most of it, can be completed with the help of LLM tools. In this paper, we test a framework that structures requirement documentation generation and task complexity scoring, based on the model introduced by (Tran, Lévesque, and Meunier 2004) and executed with the help of agentic tools. The approach is applied to a real-world commercial project in the fintech domain as a feasibility study rather than a validation: development effort was not recorded for the tasks examined, and the resulting complexity scores are therefore reported as the output of the instrument rather than as validated estimates of effort.

papers.title: ODD+LLM: Specifying LLM-Agent Behavior for Reproducible Social Simulation
papers.abstract: The ODD protocol is the de facto standard for describing agent-based models, but it lacks vocabulary for the components that determine LLM-agent behavior: prompt assembly, memory serialization, parsing, and retry logic. We propose ODD+LLM, a backward-compatible extension adding five documentation blocks grounded in the CoALA cognitive-architecture framework. To show that the gap matters, we conduct a multiverse analysis [Steegen et al., 2016] of a published LLM naming-game simulation, varying six specification choices a reimplementer must make. Variants that are defensible readings of the paper stay within statistical noise of our baseline reconstruction. Missing one instruction that the paper states but is easy to overlook (that the model answers as an outside observer rather than as a player) raises the share of runs settling on the convention agents individually favor from 0.35 to 1.00 and makes convergence three times faster, in a reimplementation that uses a different model from the original. We complement the demonstration with a reconstruction-sufficiency review of 28 published LLM-agent simulations, finding that the details of how prompts are built and how model outputs are parsed are undetermined in 77% of cases, and that no paper fully specifies its main LLM call. ODD+LLM gives the field a standard home for information it already produces but currently scatters across code repositories, supplementary files, and undocumented defaults.

papers.title: DRAFT-Bench: Evaluating Frontier Agents Across the Professional Design Lifecycle
papers.abstract: Can frontier general-purpose agents understand client intent, explore creative directions, execute revisions, and prepare production deliverables? We introduce DRAFT-Bench (Design Reliability Across Feedback and Tasks), a lifecycle-oriented evaluation of requirement elicitation, creative exploration, constrained editing, iterative revision, and production handoff. Its Requirement-to-Artifact framework links evolving requirements, protected properties, artifact versions, and delivery obligations. We compare native Codex/Astra and Claude Code across 35 design briefs under 43 conditions, alongside a separate 40-scenario RFQ track. Astra completes 43/43 design conditions and Claude 35/43. All scored core runs receive full structural credit, yet on the 28 core conditions scored for both systems, semantic checks flag violations in 11 for Astra and 5 for Claude; these are model judgments, not expert-confirmed failure rates. RFQ coverage is high, but success ordering changes across cohorts. SKU expansion, revision dependencies, and White ink files expose ambiguity among unmet obligations, missing inputs, and evaluator interpretations. These findings separate execution, requirement compliance, and professional acceptance. Unpaired tracks and different tools preclude claims of RFQ-to-delivery success, factory acceptance, or a pure model ranking.

papers.title: SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
papers.abstract: Reliable dermatology AI requires access to verifiable evidence distributed across heterogeneous textual and visual sources. However, conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically relies on one-shot retrieval from flat corpora, limiting its ability to adapt retrieval granularity, explore multi-hop relations, and integrate multimodal clinical evidence. We introduce SkinMind, a multimodal agentic RAG framework that equips policy models with human-inspired graph probing for autonomous evidence seeking. SkinMind organizes retrieval as an iterative interaction between an orchestrator and a graph environment. Through eight hierarchical graph-probing tools, the orchestrator progressively identifies relevant entities, inspects node-level information, traverses relations and paths, and retrieves source-text and visual evidence. This progressive-disclosure design allows the model to adaptively determine the retrieval modality, exploration direction, and evidence granularity while constructing a query-specific evidence subgraph. To support autonomous graph probing, we construct SkinMind-KG from a 62M-token corpus of dermatology guidelines and textbooks and 423K images, guided by a dermatologist-informed schema and a conflict-resolution mechanism. The resulting graph contains over 1.0M nodes and 2.0M edges, unifying textual, relational, and visual evidence for retrieval. Across six dermatology VQA benchmarks and two policy-model settings, SkinMind improves the average score over direct answering by 8.70 and 8.89 points with GPT-5.4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash, respectively, while consistently outperforming competing RAG methods. Together, SkinMind and SkinMind-KG provide an effective foundation for evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning in dermatology.

papers.title: More with Less: Efficient Parallel Scientific Code Translation via an Agent-Skill Workflow
papers.abstract: Translating parallel scientific codes between HPC programming frameworks is a critical but labor-intensive task. Existing LLM-based approaches rely on fixed sequential pipelines with undifferentiated repair strategies and correctness criteria that do not match scientific computing practice. We present an agent-skill framework that separates translation, compilation diagnosis, and execution validation into three autonomous agents coordinated by a verdict-driven orchestrator, routing each failure to a targeted repair skill rather than retrying blindly. An automated output check drives the self-correction loop, complemented by an offline LLM-based verification that exposes false positives escaping compiler and runtime checks. We evaluate the framework on 30 HeCBench kernels translated bidirectionally among CUDA, OpenMP, and SYCL with three open-source LLMs. Our framework attains the higher verified correctness rate in all 18 model and direction combinations over a state-of-the-art baseline while consuming up to 52.4% fewer tokens, remaining consistent across models and directions without architectural modification.

papers.title: AIM: Adaptive Interaction in Multi-Agent Debate for Multimodal LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) improves reasoning on multimodal tasks, but its accuracy and token efficiency depend on how agents interact during debate. A largely overlooked design choice is which interaction modalities agents use to exchange evidence. Existing methods rely on fixed text- or graph-based interaction, which fails to convey fine-grained multimodal evidence and thus degrades accuracy while inflating token cost due to verbose descriptions. To address this, we propose Adaptive Interaction in Multi-Agent Debate (AIM), an adaptive routing framework that dynamically selects the optimal modality combination for inter-agent interaction in multimodal MAD. Beyond text and graph, AIM introduces task-dependent modality interaction, where agents exchange targeted regions of interest from the task-specific multimodal input, such as image regions, audio segments, or spatio-temporal video clips. To determine the best combination for each instance, AIM first generates a structured baseline response and extracts interpretable routing features that capture which evidence the instance requires, how confident the baseline agent is, and how much new evidence each modality would add beyond the baseline response. A lightweight router then uses these routing features to select a modality combination that avoids both under-fusion (i.e., agents miss decisive evidence) and over-fusion (i.e., redundant modalities inflate token cost) risks. Across eight benchmarks spanning three multimodal task families, \name achieves the highest accuracy. Combining modalities improves accuracy by up to 6.4\% over the best single-modality baseline, and adapting the combination per instance adds up to 4.2\% over the most accurate fixed combination of each benchmark with up to 53.4\% fewer tokens.

papers.title: Using an LLM to Tackle Difficult Cases in NER for Nepali Tweets
papers.abstract: Named entity recognition (NER) is challenging for social media data in a low-resource language. LLMs often lag behind pretrained language models (PLMs) in NER performance, but they show promise in handling cases that PLMs struggle with. Using a dataset of Nepali tweets, we split the test set into "easy" and "hard" cases using token probabilities from a fine-tuned pretrained language model (PLM). We then evaluate an LLM on the hard test cases using 16 different prompt configurations. We find that selecting examples based on semantic similarity and increasing the number of examples improves F1 score by almost 10 points from the baseline configuration. Although the LLM underperforms the PLM on the full and easy test sets, it surpasses the PLM on the hard test set, resulting in an improved score when the two models are combined.

papers.title: Phantom Consensus: Measuring Social Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly aggregate judgments across model instances, but reasoning about other agents can itself introduce failure. We study a setting in which LLMs shift their public decisions after observing ambiguous social signals while reporting inaccurate estimates of what other agents privately judged, even when the group's recorded private judgments do not support the apparent consensus. We call this failure phantom consensus and study it as a pluralistic-ignorance-style pattern in controlled LLM collectives. To measure this phenomenon, we introduce PHANTOM-Bench, a benchmark that separates isolated private judgments, public decisions after ambiguous social signals, elicited estimates of the group's private judgment, transparency-based recovery, and controls for neutral public text and explicit vote-following. Across nine closed- and open-weight models, ambiguous public signals consistently degrade decision quality and can turn correct private group judgments into incorrect public collective outcomes. Public accuracy drops by as much as 47.8 percentage points, and collective rationality failures reach 47.3% in the most susceptible setting. We observe substantial errors in reported group-private beliefs alongside public-stage failures, while control conditions reveal model-dependent differences in susceptibility to ambiguous and explicit peer signals. Revealing the agents' recorded private decisions repairs many failures without revealing the gold label, although recovery varies across models. Our results show that evaluating multi-agent LLM systems requires measuring not only final agreement, but whether that agreement reflects independently measured private judgments or an apparent consensus.

papers.title: Beyond Truncation? Entailment-Licensed Elision and the Limits of Semantic Preservation in LLM Decoding
papers.abstract: Instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) answer at greater length than a request needs. We ask whether a training-free controller inside the decoding loop can remove that surplus while preserving content, judged against the simplest possible baseline: truncating the model's own answer to the same length. An entropy-gated logits processor removes 25.5-34.9% of tokens on MT-Bench development questions and 19.9-34.2% on a sealed test split within pre-registered BERTScore non-inferiority margins, yet we prove and confirm by audit that its output is always a prefix of the unmodified answer: the saving is truncation. A survey of 23 training-free mechanism families finds none that selects content better than truncation without oracle labels. We therefore introduce Entailment-Licensed In-Decoding Elision (ELIDE), which, at each sentence boundary, withholds a span from the reader only when a natural-language inference model judges it entailed by the text already shown, while leaving the model's generation unchanged. ELIDE beats matched-length truncation on three model families, but reading 936 of its elisions on 670 public prompts shows that 59% harm the answer, a failure that no automatic measure detects. Scoping the licence to its discourse unit reduces the harmful share to about one elision in ten on two fresh tests.

papers.title: Refer-CityFlow and M3Track: A Benchmark Dataset and Reference Framework for Language-Driven Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking
papers.abstract: Referring multi-object tracking enables users to specify targets through natural language, but existing Refer-MOT benchmarks primarily focus on single-camera settings. We formalize Referring Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking (Refer-MTMCT), where free-form queries specify identity-consistent trajectories to be recovered across a network of sequential, sparse-overlap cameras. We introduce Refer-CityFlow, a benchmark built on CityFlow's global cross-camera identity annotations and augmented with language queries requiring joint language grounding, cross-camera association, and spatio-temporal reasoning. Refer-CityFlow covers 96 videos from 40 roadside cameras with 660+ identity-consistent cross-camera trajectories, 4,362 trajectory-level descriptions, and 7,699 queries, including 1,699 real-user queries collected from 50 participants. Reference experiments on the four-camera Scenario 02 show that single-camera referring trackers reach 14.95-18.28 HOTA on real-user queries, while the evaluated cross-view method achieves about 0.05 HOTA in direct transfer. To establish reference performance, we provide M3Track, a modular multimodal reference framework in which a large language model (LLM)-based agent orchestrates interchangeable detection, tracking, and cross-camera association modules. M3Track reaches 44.10 HOTA and 65.40 IDF1 on the same real-user query set. The project repository is available at this https URL.

translation.title: Refer-CityFlow 与 M3Track：面向语言驱动的多目标多相机跟踪的基准数据集与参考框架
translation.abstract: 指代式多目标跟踪使用户能够通过自然语言指定目标，但现有的 Refer-MOT 基准主要聚焦于单相机场景。我们形式化了指代式多目标多相机跟踪（Refer-MTMCT）任务，其中自由格式的查询指定需要在一系列稀疏重叠的相机网络中恢复的身份一致轨迹。我们构建了 Refer-CityFlow 基准，它基于 CityFlow 的全局跨相机身份标注，并增加了需要联合语言定位、跨相机关联和时空推理的语言查询。Refer-CityFlow 涵盖来自 40 个路边相机的 96 段视频，包含 660 多条身份一致的跨相机轨迹、4,362 条轨迹级描述和 7,699 条查询，其中包括从 50 名参与者收集的 1,699 条真实用户查询。在四相机 Scenario 02 上的参考实验表明，单相机指代跟踪器在真实用户查询上达到 14.95-18.28 HOTA，而所评估的跨视角方法直接迁移仅达到约 0.05 HOTA。为建立参考性能，我们提供了 M3Track，一个模块化多模态参考框架，其中基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体协调可互换的检测、跟踪和跨相机关联模块。M3Track 在同一真实用户查询集上达到 44.10 HOTA 和 65.40 IDF1。项目仓库见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 提出语言驱动的多目标多相机跟踪新任务及基准数据集 Refer-CityFlow，并构建由 LLM 智能体协调检测、跟踪与跨相机关联模块的参考框架 M3Track。

papers.title: Same Facts, Different Remedy: Linguistic Profiling and Arbitrariness in LLM and System One Decisions
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to resolve consumer complaints, and the way complainants write varies with age, education and socioeconomic status (SES). We audit three remedy-decision systems using sociolinguistic rewrites of US consumer financial complaints that are instructed to preserve every fact: two generative LLMs that return a single label (GPT-4o-mini and GPT-5-mini) and a probabilistic "System One" model that returns a distribution over remedies (Jev). Using pre-registered hypotheses tested once on held-out complaints, we separate two phenomena that single-label audits conflate. At the group scale, older, college-educated and higher-SES styles receive slightly more generous remedies; these effects replicate but are small, with every monetary-remedy gap within 0.5 percentage points. At the individual scale, two style versions of the same complaint receive different monetary decisions 2.6-6.3% of the time. In a variance-component analysis of the probabilistic model, persona components shared across the two rewrite models account for about 1.6% of within-complaint variation. The persona gaps are associated mainly with delivery (vocabulary, grammar, politeness) rather than content. Positive controls show that all three systems respond 49-387 times more strongly to remedy-relevant facts than to style. Rewriting every complaint into one standard style reduced GPT-4o-mini's education and SES gaps by 94% and 87% while retaining fact sensitivity, but reversed two of the probabilistic model's gaps and did not make individual decisions more stable. Independent LLM auditors flagged material fact changes in 3.3% and 11.7% of rewrites, and instability persisted among unflagged rewrites. Fairness audits of LLM decision systems should report group disparities and individual instability as separate outcomes.

translation.title: 相同事实，不同裁决：LLM 与 System One 决策中的语言特征画像与任意性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于处理消费者投诉，而投诉者的写作方式随年龄、教育程度和社会经济地位（SES）而变化。我们审计了三个裁决决策系统，使用被要求保留所有事实的美国消费者金融投诉的社会语言学改写版本：两个返回单一标签的生成式 LLM（GPT-4o-mini 和 GPT-5-mini），以及一个返回裁决分布的概率型 "System One" 模型（Jev）。通过在保留集投诉上一次性检验的预注册假设，我们区分了单标签审计所混淆的两种现象。在群体尺度上，年长、受过大学教育和较高 SES 的写作风格获得略为宽松的裁决；这些效应可复现但很小，所有金钱裁决差距均在 0.5 个百分点以内。在个体尺度上，同一投诉的两个风格版本有 2.6-6.3% 的概率获得不同的金钱裁决。在概率模型的方差成分分析中，两个改写模型共享的人设成分约占投诉内变异的 1.6%。人设差距主要与表达方式（词汇、语法、礼貌程度）相关，而非内容。阳性对照显示，三个系统对裁决相关事实的响应强度是对风格的 49-387 倍。将所有投诉改写为统一标准风格使 GPT-4o-mini 的教育和 SES 差距分别缩小 94% 和 87%，同时保持对事实的敏感性，但反转了概率模型的两个差距，且未使个体决策更稳定。独立的 LLM 审计员在 3.3% 和 11.7% 的改写中标记出实质性事实变更，且未标记改写中不稳定性依然存在。对 LLM 决策系统的公平性审计应将群体差异和个体不稳定性作为独立结果分别报告。
translation.brief: 通过保留事实的社会语言学改写审计 LLM 与概率模型在消费者投诉裁决中的语言风格偏见，区分群体差异与个体决策不稳定性两类现象。

papers.title: Seeing vs. Counting: Complexity Twins Show Where Multimodal LLMs Fail on Diagrams
papers.abstract: When a multimodal LLM miscounts in a diagram, does it fail at seeing or at counting? Existing visual graph and puzzle benchmarks vary visual density and algorithmic hardness together, confounding the two. We pair counting questions about the same drawing that sit in different counting-complexity classes, such as its spanning trees (a determinant) and its simple paths (#P-complete), and use a transcription probe and a text-only control to separate reading from computing. We test Gemini, Gemma and Qwen3-VL models; for the Gemini models, the answer depends on how the model computes. In chain of thought, most of them read small drawings correctly and then fail at counting, at a rate set far more by the size of the answer than by its complexity class (for the primary model, the odds of an exact answer fall 2.38-fold per decade of the answer). Given code and an exact transcription, the primary model counts correctly even on 10x10 grids, and reading becomes the bottleneck: a single view misses horizontal edges, and a second reading of a rotated copy with crop checks reads 86/96 large grids exactly, against 57/96 when the upright reading is simply repeated.

translation.title: 看见与计数：复杂度孪生问题揭示多模态 LLM 在图表上的失败之处
translation.abstract: 当多模态 LLM 在图表中数错时，它是败于“看见”还是“计数”？现有的视觉图和谜题基准将视觉密度与算法难度混在一起变化，使二者相互混淆。我们将关于同一图形、但属于不同计数复杂度类的计数问题配对，例如其生成树（行列式）和简单路径（#P-完全），并使用转录探针和纯文本对照来分离读取与计算。我们测试了 Gemini、Gemma 和 Qwen3-VL 模型；对于 Gemini 模型，答案取决于模型的计算方式。在思维链模式下，大多数模型能正确读取小图形，然后在计数上失败，失败率更多由答案的大小而非其复杂度类决定（对主模型，答案每增加一个数量级，精确回答的几率下降 2.38 倍）。在给定代码和精确转录的情况下，主模型即使在 10x10 网格上也能正确计数，此时读取成为瓶颈：单次读取会遗漏水平边，而对旋转副本进行带裁剪检查的第二次读取可精确读取 86/96 个大网格，而简单重复正向读取仅为 57/96。
translation.brief: 设计复杂度孪生计数问题与转录探针，分离多模态 LLM 在图表任务中“读取”与“计算”两种失败来源。

papers.title: Sharing the Road: LLM-Based Bargaining in Mixed-Autonomy Traffic
papers.abstract: Mixed-autonomy traffic involves heterogeneous driving populations competing for shared road space. Previous studies have shown the existence and emergence of collective rationality using game-theoretic and reinforcement learning approaches, which rely on explicitly specified behavioral assumptions or reward functions for driving agents. However, how bargaining behaviors between driving agents evolve and lead to collective outcomes based on richer agent characteristics and language-based reasoning remains less understood. To fill this gap, we develop a bargaining framework based on large language models (LLMs) in which population-level autonomous vehicle (AV) and human-driven vehicle (HV) agents negotiate road-space allocations under heterogeneous objectives and private information. Through controlled experiments varying traffic composition, agent objectives, and traffic-domain knowledge, we examine bargaining behavior, coordination, and resource utilization. Results show that negotiated allocations respond to relative traffic density without strictly following proportional sharing, while density-balanced states exhibit greater coordination difficulty. Fairness-oriented objectives substantially improve agreement rates but do not necessarily yield equally high road-space utilization. Furthermore, domain knowledge affects bargaining outcomes differently across objective configurations, shaping both coordination and the role-dependent effects of fairness. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLM-based bargaining for modeling and designing interactions among driving agents in mixed-autonomy traffic.

translation.title: 共享道路：混合自动驾驶交通中基于 LLM 的议价
translation.abstract: 混合自动驾驶交通涉及异构驾驶群体竞争共享道路空间。以往研究通过博弈论和强化学习方法展示了集体理性的存在与涌现，但这些方法依赖于对驾驶智能体显式指定的行为假设或奖励函数。然而，基于更丰富的智能体特征和语言推理的议价行为如何演化并导致集体结果，仍知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们开发了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的议价框架，其中群体层面的自动驾驶车辆（AV）和人类驾驶车辆（HV）智能体在异构目标和私有信息下协商道路空间分配。通过改变交通组成、智能体目标和交通领域知识的受控实验，我们考察了议价行为、协调和资源利用。结果表明，协商出的分配会对相对交通密度做出响应，但不严格遵循比例分配，而密度均衡状态表现出更大的协调难度。以公平为导向的目标显著提高达成协议的比率，但不一定带来同样高的道路空间利用率。此外，领域知识在不同目标配置下对议价结果的影响不同，既影响协调，也影响公平的角色相关效应。这些发现展示了基于 LLM 的议价在建模和设计混合自动驾驶交通中驾驶智能体交互方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 构建基于 LLM 的议价框架，让 AV 与 HV 智能体在异构目标和私有信息下协商道路空间分配，研究议价行为与集体结果。

papers.title: ISER-MoE: Dynamic In-Switch Replication of Hot Experts for Load Balancing in Expert-Parallel
papers.abstract: Expert-parallel mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers run at the pace of the most loaded GPU, and a few hot experts carry most of the excess load. Replicating them at every MoE layer balances the load only if their weights arrive within the layer, and broadcasting from the owner is the bottleneck: point-to-point copies overload it, and baseline broadcasts pay latency or bandwidth overheads. We present ISER-MoE (In-Switch Expert Replication for MoE), built in TensorRT-LLM, which multicasts hot experts through the NVLink switch to fixed GPU groups, so each byte leaves its owner once. A GPU scheduler assigns hot experts to groups per layer, and a multi-port broadcast spreads the injection over the group's ports, both overlapped with the shared expert. In trace replay, the scheduler removed 98-99% of the excess load; in prefill serving of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, throughput rose 17.4% on a math benchmark and 7.2% on agentic prompts.

translation.title: ISER-MoE：专家并行中热专家的交换机内动态复制以实现负载均衡
translation.abstract: 专家并行的混合专家（MoE）层的运行速度受限于负载最重的 GPU，而少数热专家承担了大部分超额负载。在每个 MoE 层复制它们只有在权重能在该层内到达时才能均衡负载，而从属主广播是瓶颈：点对点复制会使属主过载，基线广播则付出延迟或带宽开销。我们提出 ISER-MoE（In-Switch Expert Replication for MoE），构建于 TensorRT-LLM 之上，它通过 NVLink 交换机将热专家多播到固定的 GPU 组，使每个字节只离开属主一次。GPU 调度器按层将热专家分配到各组，多端口广播将注入分散到组的多个端口上，两者均与共享专家重叠执行。在轨迹回放中，调度器消除了 98-99% 的超额负载；在 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的预填充服务中，数学基准上吞吐量提升 17.4%，智能体提示上提升 7.2%。
translation.brief: 提出 ISER-MoE，通过 NVLink 交换机内多播热专家到固定 GPU 组并配合逐层调度，解决专家并行 MoE 中热专家导致的负载不均问题。

papers.title: KnowEvo: Knowledge Evolution for Protein Optimization
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in scientific discovery, yet systematically accumulating and refining reusable scientific knowledge remains challenging. Existing approaches primarily improve LLM-based problem solving through parameter optimization or feedback-driven refinement of prompts, programs, and solution trajectories, leaving acquired expertise either embedded in model weights or scattered across iterative problem-solving processes. As a result,knowledge is difficult to systematically inspect, evaluate, and refine. We propose KnowEvo, a framework that treats externalized knowledge itself as the optimization target. Our key insight is that scientific knowledge is inherently modular: multiple interacting mechanisms jointly determine the design outcomes. This makes knowledge evolution fundamentally challenging, as improvements cannot be attributed to individual components in isolation. To address this, KnowEvo represents knowledge as executable expertise blocks and organizes their refinements into strategy mutation trees, enabling structured exploration over a combinatorial knowledge space. The framework combines a Thompson-style forward allocation strategy that adaptively distributes evaluation budgets across strategy variants with a backward revision process, in which a code agent operates in an isolated sandbox to translate rollout evidence into localized program updates. This design enables persistent accumulation, evaluation, and refinement of mechanistic expertise across iterative experimentation. We evaluate KnowEvo on protein optimization tasks including stability and solubility. Results show that knowledge evolution consistently improves over initial strategy blocks and outperforms monolithic program evolution and prior LLM-guided evolution baselines across metrics such as pass@k, MRR, MAP,and NDCG@5. Code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: Frontier3DBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for 3D Creation across Objects, Scenes, and Interactive Open Worlds
papers.abstract: Coding agents combine visual understanding with program execution, offering a new route to automated 3D creation. By translating images and instructions into editable programs, they bring reconstruction, generation, and editing into a shared workflow. Yet existing benchmarks fragment evaluation across task scopes and protocols, leaving their capabilities across construction levels unclear. We propose Frontier3DBench, a unified benchmark of 145 tasks across 9 categories spanning object, scene, and interactive open-world creation, with joint evaluation of appearance, structure, and behavior. Experiments with 11 model-harness configurations reveal strengths that vary by level: GPT-6.1-sol leads the object and scene levels and achieves the highest overall score of 66.02/100, whereas GPT-6-astra leads interactive world construction. However, all configurations score lower on reference reconstruction than on text-driven generation in object and scene tasks. Producing plausible content thus remains easier than reproducing specified geometry, layouts, and visual details. Moreover, generated worlds average 83.08/100 on local mechanisms but only 20.82 on motion clearance and 30.26 on stateful workflows: individual mechanisms often function, whereas complete activities that require coordinated actions and persistent state remain difficult. These results identify reference fidelity and coordinated activity completion as central bottlenecks for coding agents in 3D creation.
