papers.title: ReplayAudit: Auditing Outsourced LLM Fine-Tuning via Sealed Records and Selective Replay
papers.abstract: Auditing outsourced LLM fine-tuning requires checking an untrusted provider's training while controlling verification cost. Uniform sampling ignores training-time signals, while checking a suspicious record can require replaying several preceding steps. We present ReplayAudit, a telemetry-guided auditing system that seals training records before challenges and independently replays sampled intervals from sealed checkpoints. Loss changes and parameter-update norms guide stratified random sampling; replay determines whether the selected computation agrees with its records. We relate sampling probabilities to replay work and evaluate the system on real LoRA training. A 7B BF16 prototype rejects a false update-norm report during a random audit; targeted checks also reject false loss reports and skipped updates. We calibrate sampling budgets offline to at least a 90% probability of directly selecting an injected step. For two learning-rate deviation settings, executing these budgets on the same honest 1.5B trajectory reduces median complete-audit wall time by 49% and 67% relative to uniform sampling. When skipped updates evade the high-anomaly stratum, the corresponding audit instead costs 38% more. These results show how deviation capture and actual replay work jointly determine the cost of telemetry-guided auditing.

translation.title: ReplayAudit：通过封存记录与选择性重放审计外包 LLM 微调
translation.abstract: 审计外包的 LLM 微调需要在控制验证成本的同时检查不可信提供商的训练过程。均匀采样忽略了训练时的信号，而检查一条可疑记录可能需要重放其之前的多个步骤。我们提出 ReplayAudit，一个遥测引导的审计系统，它在挑战之前封存训练记录，并从封存的检查点独立重放采样的区间。损失变化和参数更新范数引导分层随机采样；重放用于确定所选计算是否与其记录一致。我们将采样概率与重放工作量联系起来，并在真实的 LoRA 训练上评估该系统。一个 7B BF16 原型在随机审计中拒绝了一份虚假的更新范数报告；针对性检查也拒绝了虚假的损失报告和被跳过的更新。我们离线校准采样预算，使直接选中注入步骤的概率至少达到 90%。对于两种学习率偏差设置，在相同的诚实 1.5B 轨迹上执行这些预算，相比均匀采样将完整审计的中位墙钟时间分别降低 49% 和 67%。当被跳过的更新避开高异常层时，相应审计的成本反而增加 38%。这些结果表明，偏差捕获与实际重放工作量如何共同决定遥测引导审计的成本。
translation.brief: 针对外包 LLM 微调难以低成本审计的问题，提出 ReplayAudit 系统，通过封存训练记录并基于遥测信号分层采样进行选择性重放验证。

papers.title: Encoding Memory in World Models with Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) approaches have demonstrated strong performance across diverse domains in recent years, learning accurate world models from agent trajectories. However, despite this progress, current approaches still struggle to surpass human performance on tasks that require long-term memory and planning. In this work, we address the problem of long-term memory in MBRL by moving beyond the commonly studied paradigm of architecture design. We introduce Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (TT-MBRL), using gradient descent at test time to encode the memory of episode observations into world model parameters. This enables the agent to learn a distinct world model for each episode, improving memory capabilities compared to traditional approaches that solely rely on contextual memory. We first establish a proof of concept on a simplified two-dimensional variant of the Memory Maze environment, which we refer to as Memory Maze 2D, showing consistent improvements across different world model architectures. We then demonstrate the effectiveness of TT-MBRL in the 3D domain, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Memory Maze benchmark. Finally, we show that TT-MBRL maintains strong performance on non-memory benchmarks such as DeepMind Control and Atari 100k.

translation.title: 基于测试时模型强化学习在世界模型中编码记忆
translation.abstract: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）方法近年来在多种领域展现出强大性能，能够从智能体轨迹中学习准确的世界模型。然而，尽管取得了这些进展，当前方法在需要长期记忆和规划的任务上仍难以超越人类表现。在本工作中，我们通过超越常被研究的架构设计范式来解决 MBRL 中的长期记忆问题。我们提出测试时基于模型的强化学习（TT-MBRL），在测试时使用梯度下降将回合观测的记忆编码到世界模型参数中。这使智能体能够为每个回合学习一个独特的世界模型，相比仅依赖上下文记忆的传统方法提升了记忆能力。我们首先在 Memory Maze 环境的简化二维变体（我们称之为 Memory Maze 2D）上建立概念验证，在不同世界模型架构上均显示出一致的改进。随后我们在 3D 领域展示了 TT-MBRL 的有效性，在 Memory Maze 基准上取得了新的最先进结果。最后，我们表明 TT-MBRL 在 DeepMind Control 和 Atari 100k 等非记忆基准上仍保持强劲性能。
translation.brief: 针对 MBRL 长期记忆不足的问题，提出 TT-MBRL 方法，在测试时用梯度下降将回合观测记忆编码进世界模型参数，为每个回合学习专属世界模型。

papers.title: A Separation Principle for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: We study cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems in which agents evolve under decoupled noisy dynamics but share a population objective. A canonical example is a mobility operator that orchestrates a fleet of vehicles to meet customer demand. The stochastic and time-varying nature of these problems calls for learning approaches, yet existing MARL algorithms do not scale: learning assignment and routing jointly over the full state-action space becomes prohibitive as the number of agents grows. Formulating the problem over the space of probability measures, we prove a separation principle: the population cost-to-go function is upper bounded by an optimal transport problem whose transportation cost is the target-conditioned single-agent cost-to-go function. This simplifies the multi-agent problem to learning a single-agent policy and coordinating the agents via optimal transport. Building on this principle, we introduce SALT (Separation-based Assignment and Learning via optimal Transport), a family of algorithms that learn a target-conditioned single-agent policy using any standard reinforcement learning algorithm, and then coordinate the agents via optimal transport. Since learning occurs at the single-agent level, SALT scales to fleet sizes where MARL baselines become intractable and transfers without retraining to fleet sizes unseen during training. In a vehicle-delivery experiment on the southern Manhattan road network, where MARL baselines are computationally prohibitive, SALT improves travel time by 15-21% over a shortest-path routing heuristic. In stochastic grid worlds, SALT reduces average travel times by 23-61% relative to MARL baselines and scales to population sizes where these methods fail.

translation.title: 协作式多智能体强化学习的分离原理
translation.abstract: 我们研究智能体在解耦噪声动力学下演化但共享群体目标的协作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）问题。一个典型例子是调度车队以满足客户需求的出行运营商。这类问题的随机性和时变性要求采用学习方法，然而现有MARL算法无法扩展：随着智能体数量增长，在完整状态-动作空间上联合学习分配与路由变得不可行。通过在概率测度空间上表述该问题，我们证明了一个分离原理：群体cost-to-go函数被一个最优传输问题所上界，其传输成本是目标条件化的单智能体cost-to-go函数。这将多智能体问题简化为学习一个单智能体策略并通过最优传输协调各智能体。基于该原理，我们提出SALT（Separation-based Assignment and Learning via optimal Transport）算法族，它使用任意标准强化学习算法学习目标条件化的单智能体策略，然后通过最优传输协调智能体。由于学习发生在单智能体层面，SALT可扩展到MARL基线不可行的车队规模，并且无需重新训练即可迁移到训练时未见过的车队规模。在曼哈顿南部路网的车辆配送实验中（MARL基线在计算上不可行），SALT相比最短路径路由启发式将行驶时间改善15-21%。在随机网格世界中，SALT相比MARL基线将平均行驶时间降低23-61%，并能扩展到这些方法失效的种群规模。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体强化学习在智能体数量增长时不可扩展的问题，提出分离原理，将问题简化为学习单智能体策略并用最优传输进行智能体协调（SALT算法）。

papers.title: How Much Conversation History Does an AI Agent Need?
papers.abstract: How does using less conversational history change reader-token use and benchmark scores? We examine this question on 1,100 BEAM questions. We held the retrieval ranking and reader constant across five fixed passage budgets, and mean assigned scores rose as the passage budget grew. The score gain per additional token became smaller at the upper tested budgets. Answerable questions generally received higher scores with more context. Pooled abstention scores sometimes rose as the passage budget shrank. We also tested message retention in a controlled task with explicit conversational-state targets and compared retained user messages with token-matched recency. Qwen matched the full state more often for direct requirements when user messages were retained. Its full-state matching declined when answers depended on references to earlier offers. Mistral produced near-floor results across the retention conditions. A scoring audit leaves the correctness of BEAM answers unresolved. These experiments characterize the token and score consequences of the tested memory budgets. Reliable budget selection depends on retaining the evidence each question requires and validating the measure used to assess answer quality.

translation.title: AI智能体需要多少对话历史？
translation.abstract: 使用更少的对话历史会如何影响阅读器token使用量和基准分数？我们在1,100个BEAM问题上考察这一问题。我们在五个固定段落预算下保持检索排序和阅读器不变，平均分配分数随段落预算增长而上升，但在测试的较高预算下每增加token带来的分数增益变小。可回答的问题通常在更多上下文下获得更高分数。汇总的弃权分数有时随段落预算缩小而上升。我们还在一个具有显式对话状态目标的受控任务中测试了消息保留，并将保留的用户消息与token匹配的近因策略进行比较。当保留用户消息时，Qwen在直接需求上更频繁地匹配完整状态；当答案依赖于对先前报价的引用时，其完整状态匹配度下降。Mistral在各保留条件下产生接近下限的结果。评分审计使BEAM答案的正确性仍未确定。这些实验刻画了所测试记忆预算对token和分数的影响。可靠的预算选择取决于保留每个问题所需的证据并验证用于评估答案质量的度量。
translation.brief: 研究对话历史预算对智能体token消耗和基准分数的影响，通过在BEAM问题和受控任务上的实验刻画不同记忆预算的代价与收益。

papers.title: Autonomous Particle Image Velocimetry Using Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Particle image velocimetry (PIV) reconstructs a flow field from the motion of tracer particles but the reconstruction quality is bounded by how well the flow structure of interest is resolved in the images. The acquisition position is typically fixed by the operator before the measurement. We cast camera placement as a sequential decision-making problem and train a reinforcement learning agent to control a 6-DoF manipulator equipped with a camera, enabling it to locate, frame and resolve a hydrofoil wake in a water tunnel. The agent commands the camera pose and observes the scene only through the velocity field and uncertainty estimated from time-separated image pairs. It is trained entirely in a photorealistic simulation of our water tunnel, with wakes generated by Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations of hydrofoils with varying profiles, positions and angles of attack. After zero-shot transfer to the real water tunnel, the policy reliably locates and frames the wakes of randomly placed hydrofoils. It resolves the wake at a higher resolution than a fixed camera view and with lower error in the measured flow statistics, in roughly half the time of a full scan and with far fewer image pairs.

translation.title: 基于零样本Sim-to-Real强化学习的自主粒子图像测速
translation.abstract: 粒子图像测速（PIV）通过示踪粒子的运动重建流场，但重建质量受限于感兴趣流动结构在图像中的分辨程度。采集位置通常由操作者在测量前固定。我们将相机放置建模为序贯决策问题，训练一个强化学习智能体控制配备相机的6自由度机械臂，使其能够定位、取景并分辨水洞中的水翼尾流。智能体控制相机位姿，仅通过从时间分离的图像对估计的速度场和不确定性观察场景。它完全在我们水洞的照片级真实仿真中训练，尾流由不同翼型、位置和攻角的水翼的计算流体动力学（CFD）仿真生成。零样本迁移到真实水洞后，该策略能可靠地定位并取景随机放置的水翼尾流。它以比固定相机视角更高的分辨率分辨尾流，测得的流动统计误差更低，耗时约为全扫描的一半，且所需图像对远少于全扫描。
translation.brief: 将PIV相机放置建模为序贯决策问题，在仿真中用强化学习训练机械臂控制相机，零样本迁移到真实水洞以自主定位并高分辨率分辨水翼尾流。

papers.title: PoseRieFlow: Riemannian Flow Matching for Whole-Body Text-to-Pose Generation
papers.abstract: We present PoseRieFlow, a compact flow-matching framework for text-conditioned generation of whole-body 3D human poses. Prior text-to-pose methods either neglect articulated hands or model rotations in Euclidean space despite their non-Euclidean geometry. PoseRieFlow instead formulates generation directly on the product manifold of SMPL-H joint rotations, learning a text-conditioned vector field that transports samples from an isotropic $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ Gaussian prior to the data distribution along Riemannian geodesics. A part-tokenized Diffusion Transformer aggregates the 52 joints into eight body-part tokens, allocating a dedicated token and nonlinear projector to each hand, and restores per-joint resolution through part-specific decoders, shortening the sequence while improving kinematic fidelity over per-joint tokenization. With only 21.6M trainable parameters, PoseRieFlow supports expressive SMPL-H generation with detailed hand articulation at a fraction of the scale of recent LLM-based generators. On PoseScript, it attains the lowest whole-body kinematic error among all hand-producing methods, with consistent kinematic gains from the Riemannian formulation over its Euclidean counterpart at every practical inference budget, while distributional and retrieval metrics remain comparable between them.

translation.title: PoseRieFlow：用于全身文本到姿态生成的黎曼流匹配
translation.abstract: 我们提出PoseRieFlow，一个用于文本条件化全身3D人体姿态生成的紧凑流匹配框架。先前的文本到姿态方法要么忽略铰接手部，要么尽管旋转具有非欧几何却在欧氏空间中建模。PoseRieFlow则直接在SMPL-H关节旋转的乘积流形上表述生成，学习一个文本条件化的向量场，沿黎曼测地线将各向同性$\mathrm{SO}(3)$高斯先验的样本传输到数据分布。一个部件分词的Diffusion Transformer将52个关节聚合为八个身体部件token，为每只手分配专用token和非线性投影器，并通过部件专用解码器恢复逐关节分辨率，在缩短序列的同时提高了相比逐关节分词的运动学保真度。PoseRieFlow仅有21.6M可训练参数，即可以远小于近期基于LLM生成器的规模支持带精细手部铰接的富有表现力的SMPL-H生成。在PoseScript上，它在所有产生手部的方法中取得最低的全身运动学误差，且在所有实际推理预算下，黎曼表述相比其欧氏对应方法均带来一致的运动学增益，而分布和检索指标在两者之间保持相当。
translation.brief: 针对文本到姿态生成中忽略手部或在欧氏空间建模旋转的问题，提出在SMPL-H旋转乘积流形上的黎曼流匹配框架PoseRieFlow，以小参数量实现精细全身姿态生成。

papers.title: Verifier Noise Is a Temperature: Testing Tilt Predictions in Finite-Budget LLM-Guided Search
papers.abstract: LLM-guided search loops propose a modified candidate, score it, and keep it if it scores better. When both candidates are re-scored at every comparison, as in the minibatch acceptance gates of prompt optimizers, keep-if-better is a reversible Markov chain if the score difference is logistic and the mutation operator is reversible, and its stationary law is the mutation equilibrium tilted by exp(beta f). For any continuous symmetric noise difference the same tilt is the stationary law of a small-step diffusion limit, with beta = 4F'(0); for a minibatch gate beta grows with the square root of the minibatch size. Caching the incumbent's score instead inflates the recorded score. We test the tilt as a prediction for LLM-guided program search, committing each prediction from calibration data before the search runs. The level after 150 steps rises with the minibatch size in six of seven settings, but its predicted value fails: on bin packing, search attains 62-88% of the predicted gain when the proposer edits the parent and 109-119% when it writes new heuristics. The attained fraction falls with the parent-child quality correlation of unselected mutation; a registered test on two new settings confirmed the direction, but not the quantitative agreement after a correction. Further registered tests found that runs started from a good program kept losing quality over 300 steps, more so from starts that search had selected, by a margin that passed its registered rule narrowly. Runs from different starts had not reached a common level, so whether the tilt describes the stationary law of LLM editing remains open. A registered test in prompt optimisation on frozen task-model scores failed: search exceeded the tilt, and the bin-packing relation did not transfer.

translation.title: 验证器噪声是一种温度：在有限预算LLM引导搜索中检验倾斜预测
translation.abstract: LLM引导的搜索循环提出一个修改后的候选，对其评分，若分数更好则保留。当每次比较都对两个候选重新评分时，如提示优化器的minibatch接受门，若分数差为logistic且变异算子可逆，则keep-if-better是一个可逆马尔可夫链，其平稳律是被exp(beta f)倾斜的变异平衡。对任何连续对称噪声差，同样的倾斜是小步长扩散极限的平稳律，其中beta = 4F'(0)；对minibatch门，beta随minibatch大小的平方根增长。缓存现任者的分数则会夸大记录的分数。我们将该倾斜作为LLM引导程序搜索的预测进行检验，在搜索运行前从校准数据提交每个预测。在七个设置中的六个里，150步后的水平随minibatch大小上升，但其预测值失败：在装箱问题上，当提议者编辑父程序时搜索达到预测增益的62-88%，当其编写新启发式时达到109-119%。达到的比例随未选中变异的父子质量相关性下降；在两个新设置上的注册测试确认了方向，但修正后未达到定量一致。进一步的注册测试发现，从好程序出发的运行在300步内持续损失质量，从搜索选出的起点出发损失更多，其差距勉强通过注册规则。从不同起点出发的运行尚未达到共同水平，因此倾斜是否描述LLM编辑的平稳律仍悬而未决。在冻结任务-模型分数上的提示优化注册测试失败：搜索超过了倾斜，且装箱关系未能迁移。
translation.brief: 将LLM引导搜索中验证器噪声建模为温度参数并给出平稳分布的倾斜预测，通过程序搜索和提示优化的注册实验检验该预测的定量有效性。

papers.title: Attend at the Right Resolution: Head-Adaptive Sparse Attention via Query-Key Interaction Structure
papers.abstract: Attention is a major scalability bottleneck in large language models (LLMs), with its computational cost and key-value (KV) memory traffic becoming increasingly prohibitive as context length grows. Sparse attention addresses this bottleneck by restricting each query to a subset of the context, but its effectiveness hinges on identifying relevant regions both cheaply and reliably. Existing training-free methods primarily rely on runtime relevance estimates, with selection dimensionality and granularity typically governed by fixed heuristics rather than the intrinsic interaction structure of pretrained attention heads. We take a different perspective: the query-key operator of each pretrained head defines a characteristic response structure that determines the resolution needed for sparse selection, both across feature directions and across context tokens. Building on this insight, we propose Head-Adaptive Sparse Attention (HASA), a training-free sparse attention framework that jointly adapts selection resolution along these two dimensions. Along the feature dimension, the singular spectrum of each head's query-key operator determines an effective rank, yielding a compact, head-specific response space. Along the sequence dimension, neighboring regions are progressively merged according to the directional coherence of their token responses in this same space, while heterogeneous regions remain separate. Exact attention is then computed using the original full-dimensional KV states of the selected regions. HASA captures 88.1% of dense-attention mass and, compared with UNIQUE, a strong recent sparse-attention baseline, improves accuracy by up to 3.47 and 2.57 points on RULER and LongBench-Pro, respectively, and accelerates self-attention by up to 1.32x, while achieving up to 14.07x speedup over dense attention.

translation.title: 在正确的分辨率上注意力：基于Query-Key交互结构的头自适应稀疏注意力
translation.abstract: 注意力是大语言模型（LLM）的主要可扩展性瓶颈，随着上下文长度增长，其计算成本和键值（KV）内存流量日益难以承受。稀疏注意力通过将每个查询限制在上下文的一个子集内来缓解这一瓶颈，但其有效性取决于能否廉价且可靠地识别相关区域。现有的免训练方法主要依赖运行时相关性估计，其选择维度和粒度通常由固定启发式规则决定，而非预训练注意力头固有的交互结构。我们采取不同的视角：每个预训练头的query-key算子定义了一种特征响应结构，决定了稀疏选择所需的分辨率，既包括特征方向也包括上下文token。基于这一洞察，我们提出头自适应稀疏注意力（HASA），一个免训练的稀疏注意力框架，可沿这两个维度联合调整选择分辨率。在特征维度上，每个头的query-key算子的奇异谱决定一个有效秩，从而得到紧凑的、头特定的响应空间。在序列维度上，根据token响应在该空间中的方向一致性逐步合并相邻区域，而异质区域保持独立。随后使用所选区域原始的全维KV状态计算精确注意力。HASA捕获了88.1%的稠密注意力质量，与近期强稀疏注意力基线UNIQUE相比，在RULER和LongBench-Pro上分别提升准确率最高3.47和2.57分，自注意力加速最高1.32倍，相对稠密注意力实现最高14.07倍加速。
translation.brief: 针对稀疏注意力选择粒度依赖固定启发式的问题，提出利用预训练注意力头query-key算子的奇异谱和响应方向一致性，在特征和序列两个维度自适应确定选择分辨率的免训练稀疏注意力框架HASA。

papers.title: Intent-Aware Caching for Efficient LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Modern LLM serving systems use prefix caching to accelerate multi-turn conversational workloads. They cache the key-value states of previous conversation prefixes and reuse them when subsequent requests share the same prefix, to avoid redundant prefill computation and reduce serving latency. However, achieving a high cache hit rate remains challenging because cache reuse depends on whether a conversation continues and how soon the next turn arrives. Our analysis of real workloads shows that user intent is a useful signal for this behavior, as different intents exhibit different continuation probabilities and inter-turn delays. Based on this key insight, we propose Intent-Aware Caching (IAC), an online eviction policy that classifies requests by intent, learns lightweight reuse statistics from recent serving logs and leverages these statistics to guide an oracle-inspired eviction strategy. Extensive evaluation on real workloads (WildChat and ShareChat) shows that IAC reaches a 34.6% cache hit rate. This substantially outperforms both the previous learning-based approach (18.8%) and traditional methods such as least recently used (LRU, 12.2%), while reducing average serving latency by up to 46.1%.

translation.title: 面向高效LLM服务的意图感知缓存
translation.abstract: 现代LLM服务系统使用前缀缓存来加速多轮对话工作负载。它们缓存先前对话前缀的键值状态，并在后续请求共享相同前缀时复用，以避免冗余的prefill计算并降低服务延迟。然而，实现高缓存命中率仍然具有挑战性，因为缓存复用取决于对话是否继续以及下一轮到来的时间。我们对真实工作负载的分析表明，用户意图是这一行为的有用信号，因为不同意图表现出不同的继续概率和轮间延迟。基于这一关键洞察，我们提出意图感知缓存（IAC），一种在线淘汰策略，它按意图对请求分类，从近期服务日志中学习轻量级复用统计信息，并利用这些统计信息指导受oracle启发的淘汰策略。在真实工作负载（WildChat和ShareChat）上的广泛评估表明，IAC达到34.6%的缓存命中率，显著优于此前基于学习的方法（18.8%）和传统方法如LRU（12.2%），同时将平均服务延迟降低最高46.1%。
translation.brief: 针对LLM服务中前缀缓存命中率低的问题，提出按用户意图分类请求并从服务日志学习复用统计来指导缓存淘汰的在线策略IAC。

papers.title: MemoryDojo: Benchmarking Poisoning Through LLM Agent Memory
papers.abstract: LLM agents benefit from using memory systems to improve performance on long-horizon, multi-session tasks. However, memory introduces a critical attack surface. Malicious instructions encountered in one session may be stored and propagated through memory before being retrieved and acted upon in later sessions. Because memory systems differ in how they process and retrieve information, the downstream effects of poisoning can vary significantly across systems. To quantify the effects of poisoning across different memory architectures, we introduce MemoryDojo, a benchmark for tracing the lifecycle of poisoned information through agent memory and measuring its influence on subsequent agent behavior. MemoryDojo is easily extensible, consists of 155 multi-session long-horizon trajectories covering four domains, and supports five different memory systems. Through our evaluation, we find that all memory systems are susceptible to memory poisoning, with substantial variation in downstream effects. We further propose a memory-aware poison optimization process that increases the poisoning efficacy, highlighting differences between memory architectures. We hope that MemoryDojo will support research on understanding and mitigating agentic memory risks.

translation.title: MemoryDojo：通过LLM智能体记忆进行投毒的基准测试
translation.abstract: LLM智能体受益于使用记忆系统来提升长时程、多会话任务的性能。然而，记忆引入了一个关键攻击面。在一个会话中遇到的恶意指令可能被存储并通过记忆传播，随后在后续会话中被检索并执行。由于记忆系统在处理和检索信息的方式上各不相同，投毒的下游影响在不同系统间可能差异显著。为量化投毒在不同记忆架构下的影响，我们提出MemoryDojo，一个用于追踪被投毒信息在智能体记忆中的生命周期并衡量其对后续智能体行为影响的基准。MemoryDojo易于扩展，包含覆盖四个领域的155条多会话长时程轨迹，并支持五种不同的记忆系统。通过评估，我们发现所有记忆系统都易受记忆投毒攻击，且下游影响差异显著。我们进一步提出一种记忆感知的投毒优化流程，可提高投毒效果，凸显了不同记忆架构之间的差异。我们希望MemoryDojo能支持理解和缓解智能体记忆风险的研究。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体记忆系统易被投毒且影响因架构而异的问题，构建追踪投毒信息生命周期并衡量其行为影响的基准MemoryDojo，并提出记忆感知的投毒优化方法。

papers.title: FOSCAR: Accelerating Decode Attention over 2- and 4-Bit KV Caches through Affine Folding
papers.abstract: Large-language-model decode attention streams the key-value (KV) cache for every generated token. Packing that cache into 2-bit or 4-bit quantized integers reduces memory traffic but does not automatically translate into latency saving. Existing 2-bit fused kernels reach under 31%/15% of peak HBM throughput on H100/B200. Converting each value and applying its scale and offset before feeding Tensor Cores is a major bottleneck because instruction-issue throughput is scarce on modern GPUs. Instead of applying scale and offset to each KV value, FOSCAR uses affine folding to apply them to the other operand or the output of decode-attention matrix products, depending on the quantization scheme (token-wise or channel-wise). This reduces scale-and-offset operations by up to two orders of magnitude while preserving the dequantized attention output in exact arithmetic. FOSCAR also uses bit manipulation to feed KV operands to Tensor Cores efficiently, requiring only 1 and 0.19 ALU instructions per INT2 element on H100 and B200, respectively. Finally, FOSCAR builds warp-specialized GPU pipelines for Hopper (H100) and Blackwell (B200) using wgmma and tcgen05. On H100, FOSCAR INT2 and INT4 kernels achieve geo-mean speedups of $3.36\times$ and $2.83\times$ over FlashInfer BF16, and $2.03\times$ and $1.71\times$ over TensorRT-LLM FP8. On B200, the corresponding INT2 and INT4 speedups are $2.67\times$ and $2.30\times$ over FlashInfer BF16, $1.48\times$ and $1.28\times$ over TensorRT-LLM FP8, and $1.16\times$ and $1.00\times$ over TensorRT-LLM NVFP4. We integrate FOSCAR into SGLang to benchmark serving efficiency. On long-context serving workloads, FOSCAR increases peak aggregate throughput by up to 170% and 341% over 2-bit and 16-bit baselines, respectively. We open-source FOSCAR as a kernel library at this https URL.

translation.title: FOSCAR：通过仿射折叠加速2比特和4比特KV缓存上的解码注意力
translation.abstract: 大语言模型解码注意力需要为每个生成的token流式传输键值（KV）缓存。将该缓存打包为2比特或4比特量化整数可减少内存流量，但并不自动转化为延迟节省。现有2比特融合内核在H100/B200上仅达到峰值HBM吞吐量的31%/15%以下。在送入Tensor Cores之前对每个值进行转换并应用其缩放和偏移是主要瓶颈，因为现代GPU的指令发射吞吐量稀缺。FOSCAR不对每个KV值应用缩放和偏移，而是使用仿射折叠，根据量化方案（逐token或逐通道）将其应用于解码注意力矩阵乘法的另一操作数或输出。这将缩放和偏移操作减少最多两个数量级，同时在精确算术下保持反量化的注意力输出。FOSCAR还使用位操作高效地将KV操作数送入Tensor Cores，在H100和B200上每个INT2元素分别只需1和0.19条ALU指令。最后，FOSCAR使用wgmma和tcgen05为Hopper（H100）和Blackwell（B200）构建warp专用GPU流水线。在H100上，FOSCAR的INT2和INT4内核相对FlashInfer BF16分别取得3.36倍和2.83倍的几何平均加速，相对TensorRT-LLM FP8分别取得2.03倍和1.71倍加速。在B200上，相应的INT2和INT4加速为相对FlashInfer BF16的2.67倍和2.30倍，相对TensorRT-LLM FP8的1.48倍和1.28倍，相对TensorRT-LLM NVFP4的1.16倍和1.00倍。我们将FOSCAR集成到SGLang中以评估服务效率。在长上下文服务工作负载上，FOSCAR相对2比特和16比特基线分别将峰值聚合吞吐量提升最高170%和341%。FOSCAR作为内核库在此https URL开源。
translation.brief: 针对低比特KV缓存解码内核因逐元素反量化操作导致吞吐量低的问题，提出用仿射折叠将缩放和偏移移至矩阵乘法的另一操作数或输出，并结合位操作与warp专用流水线构建高效GPU内核FOSCAR。

papers.title: One Run Is Not Enough: A Monte Carlo Protocol for Evaluating LLM Reliability on Data Science Tasks
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for automating data science workflows. Benchmarks such as DataSciBench (2026) and StatQA (2024) have advanced the evaluation of their capabilities across data science and statistical tasks. Assessing their reliability requires examining both the quality of their responses and their consistency across repeated runs, task types, and difficulty levels. With this aim, we introduce DS-QA, a benchmark comprising 100 data science and statistics questions drawn from UK university courses, spanning 16 datasets and three difficulty levels. We develop a three-layer evaluation framework that combines general response properties (runtime, verbosity and text similarity), coarse-grained metrics (accuracy, code executability and completeness), and task-specific metrics. We evaluate OpenAI models using a Monte Carlo protocol with 100 repeated runs. The results reveal substantial variability in responses to data visualisation and supervised learning tasks, particularly at medium and hard difficulty levels, highlighting the importance of evaluating consistency alongside response quality. We also find that an increase of 0.1 in the word verbosity ratio corresponds to an increase of about 0.013 in the token verbosity ratio.

translation.title: 一次运行是不够的：评估LLM在数据科学任务上可靠性的蒙特卡洛协议
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在自动化数据科学工作流方面展现出前景。DataSciBench（2026）和StatQA（2024）等基准推动了对其在数据科学和统计任务上能力的评估。评估其可靠性需要考察响应质量及其在重复运行、任务类型和难度级别上的一致性。为此，我们提出DS-QA，一个包含100道来自英国大学课程的数据科学和统计问题的基准，涵盖16个数据集和三个难度级别。我们开发了一个三层评估框架，结合通用响应属性（运行时间、冗长度和文本相似度）、粗粒度指标（准确性、代码可执行性和完整性）以及任务特定指标。我们使用100次重复运行的蒙特卡洛协议评估OpenAI模型。结果揭示了在数据可视化和监督学习任务上响应的显著变异性，尤其是在中等和困难难度级别上，凸显了在评估响应质量的同时评估一致性的重要性。我们还发现，词冗长度比增加0.1对应token冗长度比增加约0.013。
translation.brief: 针对LLM在数据科学任务上可靠性评估缺乏一致性考察的问题，构建DS-QA基准并提出结合三层指标与100次重复运行的蒙特卡洛评估协议。

papers.title: What to Delegate, What to Preserve: Human Preferences for Agentic AI Across Everyday Life and Work
papers.abstract: AI agents can execute multi-step tasks on users' behalf, yet the boundaries of acceptable delegation remain unclear. We report a scenario-based survey of 289 U.S. adults with prior AI experience covering 45 use cases across nine life domains. Each respondent evaluated one scenario per domain, producing repeated measures of automation preference, trust, collaboration, AI leadership, privacy concern, and willingness to pay. Automation preferences varied substantially across domains. Generalized estimating equation models showed that greater trust in the AI agent, desired AI leadership, prior task-specific AI use, and anticipated financial savings were associated with greater automation preference. In contrast, concerns that automation would reduce personal fulfillment predicted lower automation preference. Open-ended responses further revealed a preference for bounded autonomy, with participants often favoring substantial AI execution while retaining human involvement, oversight, or final authority. We argue that delegation is best understood as a configuration of execution, collaboration, leadership, and authority.

papers.title: GuardrailAgent: An Agentic Framework for Jailbreak Defense
papers.abstract: Despite undergoing safety training to align with human values, large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that circumvent built-in safeguards and elicit malicious behaviors given by the adversary. Existing defenses are mostly static and fail to adapt to new or unknown attack strategies, providing limited resilience. To address these, we propose a multi-agent defense framework, GuardrailAgent, that offers adaptive, end-to-end protection. The system autonomously gathers and summarizes attack characteristics into a continuously updated knowledge base that supports both input- and output-side detection. A feedback module integrates misclassified cases for iterative improvement at minimal cost. Tested on over ten representative jailbreaks, the framework achieved a 93.1% input-side detection rate, 93.9% overall detection, and a 95.8% F1 score, while rapidly adapting to unseen attacks. These results demonstrate GuardrailAgent's outstanding capability to maintain LLM safety in the face of evolving jailbreak tactics.

papers.title: Safety Is $Π_1$, Provability Is $Σ_1$: One Framework for the Hugging Face Breach and OpenAI's Mathematical Proofs
papers.abstract: OpenAI's agents breached Hugging Face in July 2026, and the same company released more than seven hundred AI-generated manuscripts of mathematical proofs in October 2026. The first event is read as a failure in security, while the second is read as a success in mathematics. We read both through the hybrid framework of our paper (Kim and Kang, 2026, arXiv:2611.01914), in which coding, proving, and learning from data are derivations by one and the same deductive mechanism, distinguished by the kinds of premises from which they are derived. Under this framework, the AI systems behind the two events ran the same loop, in which a statistical proposer produces candidate exploits or proofs and a deductive verifier settles each one by a derivation. What separates the events is the logical form of the statement wanted by each of the two domains, security and mathematics. The safety of a program is a $\Pi_1$ statement, for it says that no exploit exists, which is not assured by any finite list of tests that have been passed by the program. By contrast, the provability of a sentence is a $\Sigma_1$ statement, for it says that a proof exists, which is assured by a single instance, namely a proof that has been checked by the deductive verifier. The theorem behind both is Turing's Undecidability Theorem: the halting set is $\Sigma_1$ but not decidable, so its complement is $\Pi_1$ and not $\Sigma_1$, which is to say that membership has a finite witness but non-membership has none. We prove that attaching a statistical proposer to a deductive verifier does not change this undecidability result, however good the proposer is. We then discuss what does assure safety and where the residual risk goes.

papers.title: Language as Trait, Politeness as Strategy: Controlled Tests of Linguistic Effects in LLM Social-Deduction Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through conversation, and the same message can be phrased in simpler or more complex language, bluntly or politely. We test whether such differences change how other agents judge and act, using the LURK Werewolf framework, which separates each utterance's speech-act predicate from its natural-language realization. We rewrite only the realization, check that the game content is preserved, and replay each game day from saved checkpoints against a re-sampled control. We vary linguistic range consistently across a speaker's messages and politeness strategy per utterance. Across 30 games and 4,335 replays, neither manipulation changes the trust other agents place in the speaker, and no effect on votes or night actions survives correction for multiple comparisons; the largest uncorrected effect is that shifting range away from a neutral paraphrase changes about 4 percentage points more of the other players' votes. In natural play, 88% of face-threatening speech is bald on-record regardless of role.

papers.title: AnimWeb-Bench: Benchmarking Animated Webpage Code Generation from Videos
papers.abstract: Animation is pervasive on the Web, the CSS animation property alone appears on over three-quarters of webpages. Yet existing webpage code generation benchmarks target static screenshots, user-triggered interactions, or isolated motion graphics, leaving the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and coding agents to reconstruct complete animated webpages largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce AnimWeb-Bench, the first benchmark for animated webpage code generation from videos. It comprises 124 real-world webpages spanning 7 application domains and 33 animation types, with 91.9% of pages combining multiple types, each paired with a reference video and the static assets of the original webpage. We further propose a human-aligned, two-dimensional evaluation protocol: Static Appearance Fidelity measures structure, text, color, and visual similarity on aligned keyframes, while Animation Fidelity tracks UI components across frames and compares their position, size, velocity, and appearance with those in the reference video. Evaluating 14 MLLMs and three coding agents reveals: (1) reproducing webpage animations is substantially more difficult than reproducing static appearance; (2) explicit frame inspection and render feedback improve the reconstruction quality of coding agents; and (3) rapid, continuous changes are harder to reproduce than discrete state transitions. Our code and dataset are available at this https URL .

papers.title: Strategic Competition and Convergence in LLM Leaderboards
papers.abstract: Leaderboards are a popular way to compare large language model (LLM) capabilities and can influence how model developers invest resources. We ask when competition on leaderboards leads developers to produce models with similar capability profiles, which we call monoculture, or similar performance levels. We study this by formulating leaderboard competition as a game in which model developers invest resources across capabilities to maximize their win rate. We show that similar production functions can induce similar capability profiles, while comparative advantage can sustain distinct capability profiles. We then study convergence in performance levels and show that diminishing returns can lead to an increasingly crowded competitive frontier. Using data from LM Arena and OpenRouter, we find that developers improve more in categories where they lag competitors, while still retaining category-specific advantages. At the same time, we find that the frontier of models becomes increasingly crowded, alongside increasingly diversified model usage patterns. Our results suggest that increasing competition does not need to produce interchangeable models, but can instead sustain competitive models with distinct strengths.

papers.title: Are These Programmers Ripe Enough to Eat? Evaluating How LLMs Handle Lexical Knowledge Conflicts in Translation
papers.abstract: External lexical resources can help large language models (LLMs) translate texts in low-resource languages and specialized domains, but these resources may conflict with models' prior lexical knowledge. To isolate this conflict, we construct a controlled Mandarin-to-English translation task in which familiar source words are assigned new meanings within and across semantic categories. We treat these prompt-supplied meanings as contextual knowledge (CK) and systematically evaluate the effects of word frequency, sentence context, and prompt framing on the translated outputs. Across nine models, CK reliance is greater for less frequent source words and in sentence contexts that support the supplied meanings. Prompt framing can reduce CK reliance, but seven of nine models favor CK even when explicitly instructed to ignore the supplied meanings. Within model families, larger models are more likely than smaller models to utilize CK in their outputs. Three follow-up experiments further show that modal weakening lowers CK reliance, the effect of repetition depends on prompt layout, and the effect of reasoning varies across models. Overall, our controlled study reveals how CK reliance varies across conditions and models, motivating new methods to detect and evaluate lexical conflicts and guide models' lexical choices in LLM-based translation.

papers.title: Knowing When to Intervene: Causal Evaluation of AI Agents
papers.abstract: Current evaluations of agentic AI systems primarily rely on benchmarks. However, the static nature of benchmarks makes them uninformative about the value of auditing interventions at deployment time. For reliable deployment, we often need to determine within an agent's trajectory whether or not to intervene, e.g., by verifying the agent's current output or steering it toward different behavior, using either human review or more costly models or time-consuming agentic supervision. The value of such interventions is fundamentally a causal inference question, asking whether the causal effect of such an intervention is beneficial for the final outcome. Estimating this causal effect is particularly challenging due to the dynamic nature of the problem: the impact of an intervention depends on the current context and environment, as well as the agent's future behavior. We develop the first methodologically grounded framework for evaluating the causal effects of randomized interventions within agent trajectories. By leveraging a relatively small dataset of agent trajectories collected under randomized interventions such as verification or screening, we can estimate the dynamic causal effect of a rich class of (contextual) intervention policies. The structural parameters that we estimate can also be used to construct safety leaderboards that capture the risk of various agentic actions, which can be used by practitioners for audit prioritization. Applying our methods to tau-bench Retail, ToolSandbox, and ImpossibleBench, we find that intervention effects vary substantially across agent actions and states. More broadly, our work suggests a rich research agenda at the intersection of causal inference and agentic evaluation, which we believe is essential for the reliable and safe deployment of AI agents in the real world.

papers.title: Test-Time Compute Scales Better with Parallel Agent Teams
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling improves the performance of a fixed model by spending more computation at inference. There are two common ways to spend it on agents when a verifier can score every attempt. Best-of-N sampling runs many independent agents and keeps the best result but saturates quickly. One large team of collaborating agents can score higher but stops improving as it grows. Can we get the best of both? Our method, parallel agent teams, does so by sampling many small teams in parallel and keeping the best team's result. We test it on 12 long-horizon tasks from GPU kernels and formal proofs to exploit development. With a 27B model and a budget of 100 agents, parallel teams of ten beat parallel agents on 10 of 12 tasks and beat one team of 100 on all four tasks where we ran such large teams. At equal dollar cost the same parallel teams beat a frontier model on half the tasks. A simple statistical model shows that individual agents lose because their many samples have a low mean and that one large team loses because a single sample gets no gain from variance. Sampling many small teams in parallel balances a high mean with the gain from variance. Parallel agent teams thus offer a more effective way to scale test-time compute.

papers.title: When Instruction Files Go Stale: Documentation Debt and Hidden Cost in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code are guided by repository instruction files (also called context files or agent configuration files) like this http URL and this http URL, which are read in every agent session. As any documentation artifact, these files can fall behind the code and become stale (e.g., a test folder moves, but the file still points to the old one). In technical debt terms, such a stale instruction is documentation debt, and its interest is the cost it adds to every later agent session. Evaluations that check only task success can miss this cost, and the stale file can persist. In this study, we ask what leads agents to act on a stale instruction, how it affects their behavior and at what cost, and how they recover. We study three real-world stale instructions from active open-source repositories in depth, each a different kind of guidance: a test command, a code location, and a procedure for adding a component. Agents fix 22 maintenance tasks under three versions of each instruction (left stale, corrected to the current path, and removed), with the code and the task held fixed, and we analyze 732 trajectories of two models at the level of individual tool calls. We find that agents follow stale guidance when it is relevant to their tasks, sometimes even when correct information is available elsewhere. On the stale test command, Claude Sonnet 5.5 needed about two extra tool calls per run, a third more than with the corrected command; in the other cases, we could not detect a difference. Although agents generally recovered from the immediate failures, none repaired the underlying instruction file. Correcting the instructions eliminated operations on obsolete paths, while removing them prevented most. Our findings show that task success alone can hide the costs of documentation debt, highlighting the need to evaluate agent behavior beyond final outcomes.

papers.title: Maya a1: Do the Options Read the Model, or Does Their Position? Order Sensitivity in a Non-Autoregressive Decision Model
papers.abstract: Laya answers typed multiple-choice questions in one forward pass by scoring a hidden state at one [MASK] marker per option. We re-engineer the checkpoint (421M parameters; a 2-layer option head with no positional tensor; a documented but unused parallel layout) and test whether the answer depends on where an option is listed. Presenting 951 Qwen-verified questions under every cyclic rotation of their options (or six random permutations for 12 options), the released checkpoint changes its answer for 25.8% [22.9-28.7] of questions (19.7% on the 605 English-language items alone); accuracy with the gold option first versus last differs by 10.1 points, and the flips concentrate where the model's own confidence is low (54% versus 8% across confidence terciles). Fine-tuning with Laya's trainer on 2,818 teacher-verified rows with option shuffling cuts the flip rate to 7.2%; the identical rows without shuffling give 11.4%, so shuffling is responsible for 4.2 points of the improvement. A confidence-weighted vote over orderings gives 69.7% against 69.1% for a single base pass at 4.1x the compute. Labels are LLM-made and the test sets are teacher-filtered. We also fine-tune with the authors' parallel layout on the same rows: flip rate 0.5%.

translation.title: Maya a1：是选项读了模型，还是选项的位置？非自回归决策模型中的顺序敏感性
translation.abstract: Laya 通过在每个选项处的一个  标记上对隐藏状态打分，用一次前向传播回答输入型多选题。我们重新剖析了该检查点（421M 参数；一个无位置张量的 2 层选项头；一个有文档记录但未使用的并行布局），并测试答案是否取决于选项的排列位置。在 951 个经 Qwen 验证的问题上，对选项做所有循环轮换（12 个选项时用六个随机排列），发布的检查点对 25.8% [22.9-28.7] 的问题改变了答案（仅 605 个英文题目上为 19.7%）；正确选项排第一与排最后时准确率相差 10.1 个百分点，且翻转集中在模型自身置信度低的地方（置信度三分位间为 54% 对 8%）。用 Laya 的训练器在 2,818 条经教师验证、并做选项打乱的样本上微调，将翻转率降至 7.2%；同样的样本不打乱则得到 11.4%，因此打乱贡献了 4.2 个百分点的改进。对多种排序做置信度加权投票得到 69.7%，而单次基础推理为 69.1%，计算量为 4.1 倍。标签由 LLM 生成，测试集经教师过滤。我们还用作者的并行布局在相同样本上微调：翻转率 0.5%。
translation.brief: 研究非自回归多选题模型对选项排列顺序的敏感性，并通过选项打乱微调与并行布局消除该偏差。

papers.title: Compaction, decay and reinforcement in a two-tier conversational memory: a paired evaluation against retrieval-augmented generation
papers.abstract: A conversational agent that remembers has to decide what to keep. Retrieval-augmented generation keeps the transcript and searches it; the alternative is to compact each turn into atomic facts and search those. We compare the two on LoCoMo, with both arms answering all 1,985 questions in one window, against the same stores, with the same generator and judge, and both predictions on one row, which licenses McNemar's exact test on the 512 questions where they disagree. On the four categories comparable work reports, compaction scores 71.4 per cent against 64.6, a lead of 6.8 points (p = 5.5e-08) at 34 per cent fewer prompt tokens. On all five, including the adversarial set comparable work drops, the lead falls to 2.0 and stops being significant, because the baseline leads adversarial by 14.6. That loss has a structure. Our lead falls as the reference answer demands more source wording, 9.6 points ahead at one or two reference words and 3.1 behind past eight, with token overlap moving the same way, so the judge is not the cause. Compaction keeps what a fact asserts and discards how it was said, so it wins where the answer is a value and loses where it is a phrasing. We also report four negative results with their power calculations.

translation.title: 两层对话记忆中的压缩、衰减与强化：与检索增强生成的配对评估
translation.abstract: 一个有记忆的对话代理必须决定保留什么。检索增强生成（RAG）保留完整对话记录并检索；另一种方法是将每轮对话压缩为原子事实再检索。我们在 LoCoMo 上比较两者，两个系统在同一窗口内回答全部 1,985 个问题，使用相同的存储、生成器和评判器，且两个预测放在同一行，从而可对 512 个分歧问题使用 McNemar 精确检验。在可比工作报告的四个类别上，压缩法得 71.4%，对 64.6%，领先 6.8 个百分点（p = 5.5e-08），且提示 token 少 34%。在全部五个类别（包括可比工作丢弃的对抗集）上，领先缩小到 2.0 且不再显著，因为基线在对抗集上领先 14.6。这一损失有结构性：当参考答案需要更多原文措辞时我们的领先下降——参考词为一两个时领先 9.6 个百分点，超过八个词时落后 3.1，token 重合度同向变化，说明评判器不是原因。压缩保留事实断言的内容而丢弃其表述方式，因此答案为取值时占优，答案为措辞时落败。我们还报告了四个带功效计算的阴性结果。
translation.brief: 在 LoCoMo 上配对比较对话记忆压缩与 RAG，发现压缩在答案为事实取值时占优、在需要原文措辞时落败。

papers.title: Agents on the Patch Path: Mining AI-Associated Security Remediation in GitHub Security Advisories
papers.abstract: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly involved in software development, but their participation in real-world security remediation remains poorly understood. We investigate observable evidence of coding-agent involvement in commits referenced by reviewed GitHub Security Advisories (GHSAs), characterize the associated vulnerabilities, and examine review timing in relation to advisory disclosure routes. We develop a local-Git mining pipeline that identifies agent evidence through known agent accounts, explicit commit-message attribution, repository instruction files, and agent configuration artifacts. Linking these findings to GHSA-referenced commits yields 469 valid candidate advisories across 189 repositories, including 448 with direct attribution and 21 supported only by repository-level evidence. Claude is the most frequently observed tool family, followed by Copilot and Cursor. We further compare review timing against other advisories and historical baselines using an exact route--timing decomposition. Relative to advisories published in the same months, candidate advisories exhibit a modestly longer mean review lag, primarily associated with within-route timing rather than disclosure-route composition. Compared with a historical baseline, they exhibit substantially shorter mean review lags, with both route composition and within-route timing contributing to the difference. These findings demonstrate that coding-agent involvement is already observable across hundreds of security advisories and repositories, including high- and critical-severity vulnerabilities. By distinguishing direct attribution from repository-level adoption evidence and separating route-composition effects from within-route timing differences, we provide an empirical characterization of agent-associated remediation in the GHSA review pipeline.

translation.title: 补丁路径上的智能体：在 GitHub Security Advisories 中挖掘 AI 相关的安全修复
translation.abstract: 自主编码智能体越来越多地参与软件开发，但其在真实安全修复中的参与情况仍知之甚少。我们调查经审核的 GitHub Security Advisories（GHSAs）所引用提交中编码智能体参与的可观测证据，刻画相关漏洞，并考察审查时机与公告披露路径的关系。我们开发了本地 Git 挖掘流水线，通过已知智能体账号、显式提交信息署名、仓库指令文件和智能体配置工件识别智能体证据。将这些发现与 GHSA 引用的提交关联，得到 189 个仓库中的 469 条有效候选公告，其中 448 条有直接署名，21 条仅有仓库级证据支持。Claude 是最常观察到的工具家族，其次是 Copilot 和 Cursor。我们进一步用精确的路径—时机分解，将审查时机与其他公告及历史基线比较。相对于同月发布的公告，候选公告的平均审查滞后略长，主要与路径内时机而非披露路径构成相关。与历史基线相比，其平均审查滞后显著更短，路径构成与路径内时机均促成该差异。这些发现表明，编码智能体的参与已在数百条安全公告和仓库中可观测，包括高和严重级别漏洞。通过区分直接署名与仓库级采用证据、分离路径构成效应与路径内时机差异，我们为 GHSA 审查流程中智能体相关的修复提供了实证刻画。
translation.brief: 构建本地 Git 挖掘流水线，从 GHSA 引用的提交中识别编码智能体参与安全修复的证据并刻画其漏洞与审查时机特征。

papers.title: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design
papers.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context LLM serving. While 4-bit microscaling formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) shrink the cache and run attention on FP4 Tensor Cores, a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration: existing FP4 KV systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops, whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. We present BitDecoding-FP4, an algorithm--system co-design for accurate and efficient native FP4 KV decoding. We mitigate three error sources: Dual-Residual Query Quantization splits queries into two FP4 tensors, cutting query logit error from 60% to 1%; Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling prevents E4M3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero; and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization combines static smoothing, Hadamard rotation, and scale search to suppress key outliers under token-wise scaling. At the system level, we remove the softmax bottleneck via transposed softmax with fused probability quantization and stacked query MMA on paged KV caches. Across dense and MoE models with GQA and MLA, BitDecoding-FP4 stays within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 (1 point with MXFP4), and tracks BF16 KV in RL training rollouts. In end-to-end serving on NVIDIA B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, it delivers 2.4-3.0$\times$ higher peak serving throughput than BF16 KV. The implementation is available at this https URL.

translation.title: BitDecoding-FP4：通过算法—系统协同设计实现原生 FP4 KV 缓存解码
translation.abstract: 键值（KV）缓存在长上下文 LLM 服务中主导内存容量与带宽。虽然 4 位微缩放格式（NVFP4、MXFP4）能缩小缓存并在 FP4 Tensor Core 上运行注意力，但算法量化与系统感知加速之间仍存在根本鸿沟：现有 FP4 KV 系统使用朴素量化导致严重精度下降，而面向精度的 4 位算法依赖向量码本，其查找开销降低解码吞吐。我们提出 BitDecoding-FP4，一种实现精确高效原生 FP4 KV 解码的算法—系统协同设计。我们缓解三个误差来源：Dual-Residual Query Quantization 将 query 拆分为两个 FP4 张量，把 query logit 误差从 60% 降至 1%；Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling 防止 E4M3 缩放因子将长上下文概率舍入为零；Outlier-Aware Key Quantization 结合静态平滑、Hadamard 旋转和缩放搜索，在逐 token 缩放下抑制 key 离群值。在系统层面，我们通过转置 softmax 与融合概率量化以及分页 KV 缓存上的堆叠 query MMA 消除 softmax 瓶颈。在带 GQA 和 MLA 的稠密与 MoE 模型上，BitDecoding-FP4 与 BF16 KV 的精度差距在 NVFP4 下不超过 0.5 个点（MXFP4 下 1 个点），并在 RL 训练 rollout 中与 BF16 KV 表现相当。在 NVIDIA B300 上以 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 进行端到端服务，相比 BF16 KV 提供高 2.4-3.0 倍的峰值服务吞吐。实现见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 通过算法—系统协同设计（残差量化、防下溢缩放、离群值抑制及转置 softmax 等系统优化）实现精确高效的原生 FP4 KV 缓存解码。

papers.title: Designing Effective Monitor-Based Interventions for Mitigating Reward Hacking During RL
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) rewards are notoriously difficult to design and control, often leading to the model learning unintended behaviors such as reward hacking. One potential solution is to monitor for reward hacking and penalize it when detected; however, training against a monitor could lead to evasive behavior, and our general understanding of how to apply monitors effectively during training is limited. To study how best to use monitors to mitigate reward hacking, we introduce and open source three realistic environments where Qwen3-4B reward hacks: a coding environment hackable via test overwriting, a medical chat environment hackable via sycophancy, and a biography generation environment hackable via hallucination. We first focus on the coding environment, where we find that: (1) models can learn to evade highly accurate monitors by exploiting systemic flaws in probes and LLM judges; (2) monitors that leak more learning signal during RL suppress reward hacking but are more often evaded; and (3) including easier problems in training can decrease reward hacking. We apply our findings to build better reward hacking monitors for the medical chat and biography generation environments that improve upon naive baselines to reduce reward hacking rates across seeds to before-training levels in some interventions. Our results demonstrate that our takeaways translate to new settings and that better monitor intervention designs are possible.

translation.title: 设计有效的基于监视器的干预措施以缓解 RL 中的奖励黑客行为
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）的奖励设计 notoriously 难以设计和控制，常导致模型学到奖励黑客等非预期行为。一种潜在方案是监视奖励黑客行为并在检测到时施加惩罚；然而针对监视器训练可能导致规避行为，且我们对如何在训练中有效使用监视器的总体理解有限。为研究如何最好地使用监视器缓解奖励黑客，我们引入并开源了三个 Qwen3-4B 会奖励黑客的现实环境：可通过覆盖测试作弊的编码环境、可通过谄媚作弊的医疗聊天环境，以及可通过幻觉作弊的传记生成环境。我们首先聚焦编码环境，发现：(1) 模型可以通过利用探针和 LLM 评判器的系统性缺陷学会规避高精度监视器；(2) 在 RL 中泄露更多学习信号的监视器能抑制奖励黑客但更常被规避；(3) 在训练中加入更简单的问题可减少奖励黑客。我们将发现应用于为医疗聊天和传记生成环境构建更好的奖励黑客监视器，优于朴素基线，在某些干预下将跨种子的奖励黑客率降至训练前水平。我们的结果表明这些经验可迁移到新场景，且更好的监视器干预设计是可能的。
translation.brief: 构建三个可奖励黑客的开源环境，系统研究基于监视器的干预设计以在 RL 训练中缓解奖励黑客行为。

papers.title: Can Agentic Systems Close the Gap in Radiology with Production AI Tools?
papers.abstract: Radiology AI has developed along two paths: specialized models that perform well on narrow tasks but cover few clinical findings, and generalist models that address a broader range of tasks but remain prone to hallucination and inaccurate measurements. Combining the two through agentic systems offers a route towards comprehensive radiology reporting, but published systems are tied to one modality or body part. We describe a radiology agentic framework that standardizes how an orchestrator calls modular tools to produce a structured report, and use it to measure what such a system can do with the tools from FDA-cleared radiology AI devices. Report generation is simulated on a large multi-modality report corpus, with the orchestrator given either a catalog of finding classes consolidated from the cleared devices, each available on the modalities it is cleared for, or an unlimited catalog in which any class can be requested, and planning either from the clinical indication or from the target report. Tool outputs are simulated from the reference report, so the comparison isolates tool availability and orchestration from tool error. With the cleared catalog and the indication alone, the orchestrator recovers under a third of the clinically actionable findings; recovery improves substantially with the unlimited catalog, and further when the plan is written from the target report. Attributing every missed finding to a cause shows that most are classes no cleared device offers for the study's modality, and that a third are classes or tools that were offered and not called. Adding the most frequently missing tools closes most of the gap to the unlimited catalog on held-out reports, whereas a smaller orchestrator with the unlimited catalog gives up the whole gain. Tool availability and effective orchestration are thus complementary constraints on comprehensive AI-assisted radiology reporting.

papers.title: GroundWork: Bridging Human and LLM Reasoning Through a Structured Argumentation Model
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into workflows that require reasoning over text documents, yet interaction remains largely conversational. This leaves argumentative structure implicit or embedded in text, making it difficult to maintain, compare, and revise arguments as analyses evolve. We present GroundWork, a mixed-initiative system that makes argument structure a shared, editable state for humans and LLMs. GroundWork operationalizes the Toulmin model of argumentation as a typed graph with explicit operations for human and LLM edits. It exposes this structure through coordinated corpus views and an editable workbench for constructing, comparing, testing, and tracing source-grounded arguments. We evaluate GroundWork through an expert study with four participants spanning consulting, product development, law, and immunology, and three use-case scenarios in intelligence, law, and medicine. Our findings show that GroundWork makes source-grounded arguments inspectable, comparable, and revisable as shared human-LLM state.

papers.title: Ensemble Methodology for Reference-Free Confidence Estimation in LLM-based Code Summarization
papers.abstract: This paper describes an approach and use case to estimate the correctness of LLM-generated COBOL summaries without access to human-authored references. The core intuition is that inter-model agreement on semantics is informative about truth, and that an LLM-as-judge can provide higher-fidelity pairwise assessments than traditional string- or embedding-based metrics. We operationalise this intuition with (i) controlled summary generation from diverse models; (ii) a LLM evaluator that compares pairs of summaries and emits structured judgments; and (iii) a calibrated aggregation rule that combines supportive evidence while penalising only corroborated contradictions.

papers.title: Computer-Use Agents Are Embodied Generalists
papers.abstract: In many areas of AI, general-purpose models have increasingly replaced handcrafted methods and specialized architectures. We argue that embodied AI is poised for a similar shift. Our key claim is that embodied tasks can be formulated as interaction with digital software. Specifically, we build software that renders an agent's view of a physical environment on a screen and provides controls for acting in it. A computer-use agent (CUA) can then perform embodied tasks through the same screenshots and keyboard and mouse actions that it uses to operate ordinary software. Using a single CUA design and changing only the software, our entries win first-, second-, third-, and sixth-place prizes across four ECCV workshop competitions, without any competition-specific agent tuning. These results suggest that the skills CUAs learn on software, such as visual grounding, precise clicking, and exploration, already carry over to embodied tasks, giving CUAs a far broader scope in embodied AI than previously realized. We therefore advocate that computer-use agents can be embodied generalists. Further, we advocate that, by following the training strategy that made computer-use agents general, embodied AI can converge on a single general model as well, ushering in a new era of general embodied AI. Website: this https URL

papers.title: FlowMoP: Stochastic Multi-Person Motion Prediction
papers.abstract: Predicting the future motion of multiple people is inherently stochastic: the same observed history admits many plausible continuations depending on intent, coordination, and social context. Yet the dominant paradigm in multi-person 3D motion prediction remains deterministic, with existing methods producing a fixed number of outputs per agent. In contrast, we present a conditional flow matching framework that jointly generates diverse future motions for multiple agents, modeling both global trajectories and root-relative poses. A B-spline reparameterization compresses the generative state space while enforcing temporal smoothness, and a dual-stream transformer conditions each agent's predictions on observed neighbor motion for interaction-aware forecasting. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on CMU-Mocap (UMPM) and 3DPW, outperforming deterministic baselines on joint position error, pose error, and final displacement error despite producing a full predictive distribution. We additionally establish the first motion prediction baseline on WorldPose, a large-scale professional soccer dataset, where social conditioning demonstrably concentrates predictive uncertainty along interaction-constrained directions.

papers.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
papers.abstract: Large language models reinvent the wheel all the time. They conflate task-solving with the execution of the solutions, which forces them to solve every problem from scratch. We show that once a task has been reasoned through, the application of its solution to a new problem instance can be done very efficiently and with little involvement from language models. We introduce agentic reasoning caching, a method for constructing robust CPU-executable agentic reasoning caches (ARCs) from LLM reasoning traces. ARCs show on-par performance with frontier LLMs across a range of difficult mathematical and scientific tasks, are fully explainable, continually trainable, robust to input perturbations, and 16-291x cheaper to invoke than the source model.

translation.title: CPU-ARC：面向CPU端推理复用的智能体推理缓存
translation.abstract: 大语言模型总是在重复造轮子。它们将任务求解与解决方案的执行混为一谈，迫使它们从零开始解决每一个问题。我们证明，一旦某个任务已被推理解决，将其解决方案应用于新的问题实例可以非常高效地完成，且几乎不需要语言模型的参与。我们提出智能体推理缓存（agentic reasoning caching），一种从LLM推理轨迹构建鲁棒的、可在CPU上执行的智能体推理缓存（ARC）的方法。ARC在一系列困难的数学和科学任务上与前沿LLM性能相当，完全可解释、可持续训练、对输入扰动鲁棒，且调用成本比源模型低16-291倍。
translation.brief: 解决LLM重复推理浪费的问题，通过从推理轨迹构建可在CPU上执行、可复用的智能体推理缓存（ARC）来高效应用已有解法。

papers.title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
papers.abstract: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in video generation in terms of visual quality and temporal consistency. However, generating videos with precise spatial structure, coherent motion dynamics, and controllable scene composition remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce Video-Coder, the first attempt to train a code-driven video generation agent, which autonomously writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene (Draft Video) that provides structure and motion signals to downstream video generators. To support this paradigm, we design a dedicated data pipeline and curate two high-quality datasets, Video-Coder-SFT-6k and Video-Coder-RL-2k, which contain diverse prompts and ground-truth reference videos. We further develop the Video- Coder Harness, a unified interactive environment integrating code execution, 3D scene rendering, and execution feedback for agent training and inference. We then train Video-Coder with SFT fol- lowed by harness-native agentic reinforcement learning with dual reward feedback, which combines execution-based and video-based rewards. Additionally, we design an annealing training strategy that gradually reduces the execution reward over time, allowing the model to rely more on the video reward in the later training stages. Experiments show that Video-Coder achieves significant gains, improving Minimax-H3 by approximately 7 points on PhyGenBench and 24 points on VBench-2.0. We hope this work can serve as an open foundation for coding agents in video generation, and we fully open-source our data, models, and code

translation.title: Video-Coder：通过强化智能体编码实现视频生成
translation.abstract: 近年来，视频生成在视觉质量和时序一致性方面取得了显著进展。然而，生成具有精确空间结构、连贯运动动态和可控场景构图的视频仍然具有挑战性。本文提出Video-Coder，首次尝试训练一个代码驱动的视频生成智能体，它自主编写并执行代码来构建动态3D场景（草稿视频），为下游视频生成器提供结构和运动信号。为支持这一范式，我们设计了专门的数据流水线，并构建了两个高质量数据集Video-Coder-SFT-6k和Video-Coder-RL-2k，包含多样化的提示词和真实参考视频。我们进一步开发了Video-Coder Harness，一个集代码执行、3D场景渲染和执行反馈于一体的统一交互环境，用于智能体训练和推理。随后我们采用SFT加harness原生的智能体强化学习训练Video-Coder，使用结合执行奖励和视频奖励的双重奖励反馈。此外，我们设计了退火训练策略，随训练进程逐渐降低执行奖励的权重，使模型在训练后期更多依赖视频奖励。实验表明，Video-Coder取得显著提升，使Minimax-H3在PhyGenBench上提升约7分，在VBench-2.0上提升24分。我们希望这项工作能成为视频生成领域编码智能体的开放基础，并将数据、模型和代码全部开源。
translation.brief: 解决视频生成中空间结构、运动动态和场景构图控制不精确的问题，通过训练智能体自主编写并执行代码构建3D草稿场景，并用SFT加双重奖励的强化学习进行训练。
